chapters.title: Chapter 601 Jealousy overload
paragraphs: Fiona, Diana, Vanessa, Maeve, Yennefer, Teresa, Yasmine.
Fiona didn't stop there, with a smile on her face she spoke: "Teresa, please introduce yourself and your relation with hubby."
"Oh!" Teresa was just standing there timidly, they were talking about her and for some reason Yennefer's temperament made her a bit nervous.
Nodding she spoke: "H- Hello, I am Teresa Arclis. I am husband's wife-"
Vritra tilted his head to the other side, that was the nail in the coffin, his coffin.
He glanced at Fiona who looked quite pleased, and decided to take his revenge later.
He would torture her so much later that she wouldn't be able to get out of bed.
"Ah, you call him husband?" Yennefer asked with a smile, though it was really chilly.
"Y- Yes..." Teresa answered, she looked around nervously, wondering what was happening.
She still didn't know a lot of things about Vritra.
"I see, isn't that just wonderful, husband? Right after I disappear, you found a replacement for me?" Yennefer's smile finally faded away and she felt angry at Vritra.
She died and he just brought in another woman, she felt bitter and jealous. Previously when she made a mistake, she still remembered how he just disappeared from her life.
How much it hurt her and now he was the one in the wrong.
"No, she isn't your replacement or anything, let me explain-" Vritra said, even though he was just forced into this marriage but from her view, she felt betrayed.
"Hmph, what's there to explain? So, that's how much all my love meant for you?" Yennefer's pretty face turned sad, as she turned, not even facing him.
"Hey, what are you all just standing there for? Help me!! What about that dream, wifey, mom..." Vritra said, looking helpless and the strange background noises weren't helping at all.
"You beasts, do it silently!!" Vritra cursed and the noises became low instantly.
"Hehe, of course hubby, but when are we getting our official ceremony?" Yasmine asked, chuckling lightly.
She had expected this, that's why she even told Teresa to just call him hubby as well.
"As soon as Yenni's body is back, I promise!" Vritra said seriously, he didn't like that feeling of Yennefer getting upset with him.
She had just returned, he wanted to talk so much with her, stay close.
"Haha, alright, that's enough teasing. Honey, I will handle it." Vanessa, his lovely mother, was the one to step up in the end.
"Thank you mom." Vritra sighed, then he looked at the nervous Teresa, who felt as if she had caused some trouble.
Vanessa and Yasmine pulled Yennefer away to explain everything.
Teresa timidly walked closer to Vritra and asked: "Husb- did I make a mistake?"
Unlike Yennefer's strong personality, she was quite vulnerable and meek, Vritra shook his head and patted her.
"No, it is none of our fault, it is just circumstances and fate playing tricks. Don't worry, Tess, Yenni is very caring and kind." He said.
Teresa nodded, as the newest member in the family, despite the warmth from everyone she still needed time to adjust.
Diana walked closer to her, since several barriers were present around Teresa so there was no danger of accidentally touching.
Then the goddess began to soothe her nervousness, taking care of her as if Teresa was her younger sister.
Vritra looked at Fiona, and walked towards her. Without a word, he spanked her buttock as she released a surprised sound.
"Ouch." She rubbed her butt, then laughed, hugging Vritra.
"Hehe, sorry, are you angry at me? I was just teasing you earlier, ahh~" she spoke coquettishly.
But Vritra squeezed her sore butt, his fingers sinking into the warm and soft flesh.
"Now you have done it, just wait for my revenge." Vritra spoke, of course he wasn't upset with her or anything.
It was just playful jokes between husband and wife, but he was certainly serious about the revenge.
After a few minutes, Yasmine returned while Vanessa was still busy talking with Yennefer.
"Hubby, how about we return to our home first? It isn't good to deal with family business out here in the open." The dragoness said.
Vritra nodded then turned towards Shitless and Onest in the distance.
"Can you take care of things here? I will leave behind Hellmancer just in case."
"Alright, pitiful one..." Shitless said, with an encouraging look.
"Yeah, it's fine. There isn't much left anyway." Onest said.
"Alright, let's go-" Vritra turned to his wives and spoke but then paused as his gaze drifted towards the stage.
Shen, Tiny and her soon-to-be husband, Jean, were still there while Sir Giant was unconscious.
He instantly disappeared and flashed beside Jean, the guy was flabbergasted.
"S- Spare me please SOB" he begged instantly, his face full of tears and snot.
And Vritra's aura was so terrifying that soon, he wet his pants, as a small pool of foul liquid formed around him.
Vritra moved back, not expecting such an exaggerated reaction.
"Well I just came to congratulate you two, haha you two look good together. Jean right, pfft what a great choice." He spoke in a mocking tone, then disappeared.
Jean lay sprawled, shivering while shocked at those words. Looking at Tiny not far away, his expression became ugly, he really didn't want to marry her.
"Let's go." Vritra reappeared and spoke to his wives.
And so, the group of eight headed towards their house. He watched as Vanessa and Yennefer talked, hoping that she would understand and wouldn't blame him.
But he really couldn't make excuses, understanding the reason behind her anger.
After leaving the Ford realm, they flew into the sky.
Right as Vritra was about to open a portal back to his house, he paused and looked down at the snow-covered land.
His eyes widened in shock at the unexpected sight.
Strange insects, beasts and even trees were present all over the snow, they seemed... mutated.
"What's going on?" all his wives paused as well.
Yennefer looked down, wondering if things had changed so much after her disappearance.
It didn't even seem like the planet she used to live on.
Noticing several figures in the sky, many mutant birds rushed towards them.
While many creatures on the ground were also attacking them.
With just a thought, all of their heads exploded as the strange-looking corpses fell to the ground.
"Hubby, this... seems to be related to these spores, and this drastic change is happening everywhere." Yasmine spoke as she scanned the surroundings.
The corpses on the ground were instantly devoured by other creatures, and instantly it seemed their strength had increased slightly.
It was as if a great apocalypse was about to befall this planet.
"This doesn't seem to be those trials, so what's going on? Where are these spores coming from?" Vritra focused and saw that the tiny spores also seemed to have changed.
Like living organisms, they were wriggling and buzzing, attaching to just anything.
The ordinary trees and animals all seemed to be affected by it.
Then what about humans and other races?
"Let's return home first." Vritra's expression turned serious as he spoke, he could only expect answers from the divine.
Without using the portal, they flew at high speed while observing the changes.
The more they saw, the more their expressions changed, the snowfall had already made everyone's life difficult.
But now, it was as if the end of the world had come.

chapters.title: Chapter 602 Disaster
paragraphs: Vritra stared wide-eyed at the surroundings, the sudden change shocking them all.
"I- Is this normal?" Yennefer stared at all sorts of strange mutated creatures, feeling that the world had really changed while she was away.
"Of course not, I am seeing all this for the first time too." Vritra replied, breathing in the cold air as he calmed down a bit.
They continued to fly, taking in all the changes; it wasn't just the beasts and plants that were impacted.
The group of eight suddenly paused as they heard a loud bang from inside a house, a strong scent of blood filling the air.
"..." After a moment they all saw a grotesque figure munching over human flesh, two torn dead bodies lying beside the mutated man.
One was a man while the other a woman, the three seemed to be a family; while faint frightened sounds could be heard from inside the house.
Vritra frowned, the world really seemed to be going to shit.
The mutated man had transformed into an ugly monster, hearing the faint sound, it suddenly turned to look towards the house.
Frantically running inside as the teens hiding inside screamed in dread.
But before the monster could reach them, its head exploded.
Vritra looked around, right now they were over a village and such scenes could be seen all over the place.
"Husband, this..." Teresa stared wide-eyed at the gruesome and cruel scene.
After going mad and turning into monsters, these people were even killing and devouring their own families.
They were like zombies, only more grotesque, powerful and deadly.

Teresa, the kindest and most unfortunate person to exist, felt her heart ache at this sight. She wanted to help them, but dealing with such mutant humans and beasts wouldn't be easy all over the continents.
"Let's continue, we need to find more before we can do anything." Vritra said with a grim expression.
But for now, he used dust manipulation and killed all mutated humans, but this method was certainly not effective.
More humans could mutate, the mutated beasts could also barge into the village.
All the people were already surviving with difficulty because of the cold, and now this.
On their way back, Vritra and his wives killed quite a few mutated creatures, they weren't even sure if they could be cured.
But protecting others was important now, even if they didn't care much about others, none of them could just stand and do nothing when so many innocents were being torn apart.
Before long they arrived at their House of Darkness, all of them were confused and shocked.
"Hubby, can you ask Divine about all this?" Yasmine asked, she now knew that Divine was actually her brother, but without her past memories she felt nothing towards him.
"I will try." Vritra nodded, he could tell that all over the planet, such changes were occurring everywhere.
'Divine?' he called out but received no response, making him feel annoyed and angry.
After calling out a few more times, Vritra just shook his head.
"We can find out about the cause and such later, first we should try to stop those monsters." Diana spoke, feeling powerless, not wanting to just stand by and do nothing.
"Since these strange mutations seem to be caused by those spores, first we need to stop them from coming in contact with any living creature." Vanessa pondered and spoke.
"Teresa, weren't you working on something like that?" Fiona looked at Teresa and questioned.
"Yes, though it is not complete yet." Teresa answered, a sad look on her face.
"Husband, at the base of Golden Moon, there is a device that could put everyone to sleep temporarily as long as enough energy is provided." Yennefer spoke at this moment.
After being a part of Golden Moon previously, she obviously knew a lot about it.
"Yeah, if we can delay this all even by a little, we would have time to prepare something." Fiona nodded.
"Okay, let's go there right away. Yenni come with me. Tess, how long will it take for you to prepare the protective barrier?" Vritra questioned seriously.
He doubted that the Divine Kage, the only powerful organization left, would help others.
"At least a day, and even then there will be a few requirements to use it." Teresa replied after thinking for a moment.
"Can that device put them to sleep for a day?" Vritra questioned, and Yennefer nodded.
"Okay, we will be going out then." Vritra held Yennefer's hand, though it was nothing like before.
"We will clear the surrounding area for now, oh right, why don't we also use all these guards? We have over four thousand lord rank knights." Fiona suggested.

"Okay, you take care of it, but since we don't know if these people could be cured, try to capture them alive for now." Vritra instructed and then turned to leave, giving control of the house and guards to Yasmine, Vanessa, Diana and Fiona.
"Honey, be careful." Vanessa called out from behind, despite knowing his strength she couldn't help but worry, all this was too absurd.
"I will be fine, mom." Vritra nodded towards his wives and then disappeared.
Teresa quickly got busy and the others did the same.
Vritra and Yennefer teleported close to the main base of Golden Moon but since all six seats were dead, the base was in quite chaos.
There were still many members left who hadn't gone to the marriage. Vritra didn't bother with them and followed Yennefer.
Using the Lost skill, none present could even see him even if he were to pass by them.
The location of that device was actually well hidden, soon the two entered a room where a metallic statue was present.
Yennefer quickly floated forward and instructed Vritra to operate it.
"Husband, start by moving its hand upwards, precisely by eleven centimetres and then tilt it to 30 degrees. The key is hidden here."
Soon, the faceless statue stood before Vritra with both hands stretched and pointed upwards.
At the same time, in thousands of locations, the ground trembled and then broke as high towers began to rise.
Vritra was surprised by all this arrangement, the Golden Moon really held quite a lot of power.
Within a few minutes, thousands of tall towers with inverted mushroom heads rose, appearing a bit like mobile network towers but bigger.
Vritra then asked: "What now?"
"Now we need to inject mana into this statue through its hand. But even a dozen lords' energy might not be enough to use all that, do you have any treas-"
Before Yennefer could finish speaking, Vritra placed his palms over the statue's and allowed the energy to rush out.
"Wait husband, this could be dangerous, you can't-" worry appeared on Yennefer's face as she tried to stop him but then paused.
She sensed an overwhelming amount of mana flowing into the statues, shocking her. She was yet to know about his power up.
All the towers started to buzz at the same time, releasing a high frequency sound.
The lords weren't affected by it, but all other humans, beasts and even plants which had grown consciousness started to faint.
Vritra maintained the connection for a few minutes, he wasn't short on energy. Only after the process was complete did he finally let go.
"Are you okay?" Yennefer stepped closer to Vritra, now that the immediate situation was resolved, she looked at his face longingly.
"I am." Vritra smiled faintly, sighing in relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 603 Reconstruction
paragraphs: All over the continents, everyone whether mutated or not suddenly started fainting.
Fiona and the others who were busy saving people understood that Vritra had succeeded, as they finally relaxed.
They quickly locked up all the mutated humans, beasts and trees.
Inside the room of Golden Moon, Vritra and Yennefer stood close, both happy to finally have each other back.
Releasing a long breath, Vritra calmed himself, as he turned and held both of Yennefer's hands, looking at her face tenderly.

"Yenni, my lovely wife, I am really glad to have you back. And I promise, never ever will I let you get hurt in the future, I am sorry that I failed to protect you." Vritra said, his expression a bit sad.
Her absence had weighed quite heavily over his heart, he was ready to do almost anything to just have her back.
"Don't blame yourself for it, that was my choice and even again I would make the same choice. You are far more important to me than anything, I can afford losing my life but not you."
While speaking she leaned forward, pressing her face against his chest.
"Hmm I love you, although you are already my wife but will you marry me?" Vritra asked as he took out a ring.
Both could feel each other's intense emotions, the love and obsession.
A beautiful smile blossomed over the empress's face, her heart full of sweetness.
She was the empress of Vritra's heart, a truly wonderful woman and the best wife.
"Yes, yes husband. I want to, even if you didn't ask I would have just abducted you and hehe" Yennefer chuckled, as memories of their first encounter returned.
She was really happy with her past self for making the decisions she did.
"But about this ring, can you hold onto it for now? I will take it back as soon as I have my body." Yennefer said, she really wished to wear it, and jump into his embrace.
Kiss him, and seal their love pact. But all that would have to wait for now.
"Okay I will, but just know, no one could ever take your place in my heart. I would never even think of replacing you with anyone." Vritra spoke, looking at his empress with a possessive look.
The two stayed in the room together for a bit longer, loving each and every moment they spent together.
Vritra and Yennefer then flew back together, holding hands while talking.
Vritra and Yennefer then flew back together, holding hands while talking.
"Yenni, I have already found a way to reconstruct your body, we should work on that first." Vritra spoke, while his head was filled with confusion about the sudden changes.
It seemed to be the beginning of something ominous, with their strength they could still control things but what if in the future, things just kept going wrong.
Vritra really wished Divine would explain things but for some reason he just wouldn't reply.

"Thank you husband, I... know about the situation with Teresa now. Although it was not your fault but I can only forgive you if you promise to marry me properly too, giving me an even grander ceremony."
Yennefer said, feeling that with him, she could face any challenges.
'I really thought I would never be able to see him again...' She didn't even want to remember that feeling, at that time she felt so hurt.
"Oh right, where is that demoness, don't tell me she left you?" Yennefer asked suddenly.
"No, she is undergoing an evolution right now and should be out soon." Vritra replied.
If these changes weren't related to the trial or games then who was responsible for all this?
Was it some god or demi god? Or did the evil organization of this planet also play some role?
He wondered and decided to first clean up the planet, these pests were better off dead.
While moving back Vritra sensed the souls of Oracle and the Divine Kage had all been devoured already.
Now they were dead.
As they arrived at home, Vanessa, Fiona, Yasmine and Diana were still outside, Teresa working in another room.
The two walked out of the room and walked through the corridor.
"Wow this house sure is big and... beautiful, when did you get it husband? Haa our own house..." she imagined enjoying life with him, spending day after day being his affectionate wife.
Her cold personality quickly melted whenever she was with Vritra, all that remained was tenderness and love.
"I got it recently, well there are a lot of things you don't know about and it will take some time to go over everything." Vritra said, as they passed by Maeve's room, the two paused.
"So this is where the fox is evolving?" Yennefer asked, and Vritra nodded.
The fluctuations of energy were quite powerful from inside, it seemed she would be out very soon.
"To construct your new body, we will be using the core of a planet. Although it will take a bit more time but you will definitely be at the demi god rank by the end of it." Vritra explained.
There was also an option to quickly make her body like how it went with Yasmine but then Yennefer would have to absorb energy like others.
Not to mention, the first option was better for her.
"Hmm I just want to be with you as soon as possible. I want your hugs, kisses, cuddles and..." she paused, her eyes filled with deep emotions.
Vritra couldn't help but chuckle, Yasmine had quite the libido and could last the longest but Yennefer was different from all his wives.
The most aggressive and thirsty, the most possessive.
While talking the two walked into a room, Yennefer looked around and asked: "So my husband, how do we start it?"
"You just need to..." Vritra paused, holding back a laugh as he pulled out a coffin and added: "lie down in this coffin."
"Uh what?!!" she was seriously shocked at these words, wondering if he was joking. No way would he want to send her back to a coffin after she just returned, right?
Looking at her expression, Vritra couldn't help but laugh, wanting to pull her into his arms.
His cold and haughty wife looked quite cute.
Then he explained and finally Yennefer understood everything, shaking her head.
Vritra directly connected the core to this coffin, and after making the arrangements, he looked at his wife.
"Ready to go in?" he asked.
"Hmm how long will it take?" Yennefer asked, she really wanted to spend more time with him.
"Probably a few days, I am not exactly sure." He answered, and after thinking added: "Don't worry though, now we will be able to talk directly even as your body is getting constructed."
Using the Nihil Anima he quickly formed a bond with her soul, now they could talk without any problem.
"Mhmm then wait for me, after I am out I am gonna punish you for getting another wife in my absence." Yennefer spoke with an intense gaze.
The two talked for a while longer, reluctant to separate but this was necessary as well.
So, after a few minutes, Yennefer finally entered the coffin.
Vritra covered the room with all sorts of barriers just to make sure of her safety and even used Null to increase the passage of time.
Otherwise it might even take months for her to return.
After all this was done, it was time to clean up all the dirty organizations.

chapters.title: Chapter 604 Cleanup
paragraphs: After Yennefer entered the coffin, Vritra decided to go out and clean up some scum. He also needed to see if they had any relation to the changes.
Just as he flew out of the house, he felt the glyph buzz in his inventory. Taking it out he found it was Shitless calling him.
While continuing to fly, he took out the glyph and answered: "Are you two done? Encountered any problem?"
The only problem now could be the Divine Kage, Vritra had only faced the number fifty previously.
He knew too little about that group, wondering if there were any demi gods among them.
Or what if they had even stronger attacks, so he didn't recklessly find them, for now other things needed his attention.
"Yup we are almost done, Oracle and others are already dead." Shitless said but his tone was a bit strange, then he added:
"But now that Oracle is gone, we shouldn't disrespect the dead so we are respectfully sending him off."
"Hmm well do as you see fit." Vritra said, hearing the faint sound of some liquid falling.
After some short talk and giving them further instructions, Vritra cut the connection and stored the glyph away.
He wondered if the monk had actually awakened some goodness inside him.
On the other side, Onest and Shitless had thrown all the dead bodies into a pit and put Oracle on top.
The not so poor guy had died with a terrified look on his face, who could have expected the respectful leader of such a powerful organization to die so horribly.
Shitless whistled and shivered slightly as he peed on Oracle's grave, sending off the dead to hell.
"Come on, don't be shy. Let's give them a bath with the holy fluid muahahaha" Shitless laughed, pouring out everything.
Onest looked weirdly at his bald companion but looking at the hateful Oracle he laughed too and joined.
Now the main evil organization on the Zoratian planet is Twilight, to regain their strength they had absorbed quite a lot of other small groups.
So aside from Twilight, barely any evil group existed now, but still finding all their bases wouldn't be easy.
Yet now that everyone had fallen asleep, those people would be alerted and now only the lords could move around.
After thinking for a moment, he decided to head to the world information centre that is managed by Maeve.
It was present on the continent, so Vritra arrived there within moments.
Most of the members were asleep too though a few were still awake.
Vritra quickly arrived inside their base, although his appearance at first startled the group.
But they were all well aware of Vritra's identity, so they instantly became respectful.
"Sir, is Golden Moon planning something big? I heard all the seats were killed at the marriage banquet of the Fords." The person looking over the organization in Maeve's absence spoke.
"No, it was done by me. Anyway, I want you to tell me about all the bases of Twilight, any helpful information, I need to find all of them." Vritra said solemnly.
"Oh okay, I will provide you with everything we know." The man who was called Crow and had met Vritra before replied quickly.
His strength too had grown quite a bit in the span of the past few years and since he knew Maeve, so he received a high position.
Vritra waited as Crow hurriedly went out and began to work, since most of the people were unconscious, the task took a bit longer.
In nearly twenty or so minutes, Crow hurriedly brought back all the information, all stored inside a glyph.
"Sir, just press it against your forehead and you can find all the information." He said.
"Alright, good job." Vritra nodded and tried it right there, pressing it against his temple.
Closing his eyes, he instantly felt quite a bit of information entering his brain.
There was information about important members, their hideouts and more.
"Alright, I will go check that out." Vritra said and disappeared.
What followed was complete annihilation, Vritra showed absolutely no mercy.
Arriving at each base, he would start killing them outright, even if they were in a state of unconsciousness.
From the bloody aura on their bodies, it was obvious they had killed quite a lot of people.
Moving from one place to another, he killed all the ones he could find. It was the lord ranked ones who were difficult to find, many were outside.
He even used his soul wraiths to search around. The information from Crow even included the members who had just recently been recruited.
The world information centre had truly become the information library of the planet.
Pausing in the sky, he felt that dealing with the lords would be difficult as they had hidden in all sorts of places.
"Hmm I guess I will have to widen the search area, only the lords could provide me the information I require." He mumbled and instantly activated dust manipulation.
In the next moment, thousands of human-like dust figures took form, all looking like mannequins.
Vritra poured vast amounts of energy into them, increasing the strength of each to lord rank and then controlled them mentally to move in all directions.
This way, he could find the hidden members of that evil organization.
"Right, where is Red?" he wondered. That man was the one who started it all, he even dared to bring that fake who looked like his mother.
Just like Oracle, Red too deserved a very painful death.
While Vritra was doing that, all his wives were busy with their own tasks.
Now that everyone was asleep, capturing the monsters became even easier.
But they could tell that this was just the first wave of destruction, things would only become more chaotic in the future.
For now their strength was enough to deal with it, but who knew how things would develop.
Maybe starting the trials was the only way now.
And for that Vritra first had to steal Jack's fate and then kill at least one demon lord.
After several hours, Yasmine, Vanessa, Fiona and Diana all returned to the House of Darkness.
Feeling mentally exhausted after all the events, still the death count wasn't low, but because of them a lot more people survived.
Before long Vritra returned too, he had killed thousands of members of Twilight and other organizations and captured many lords.
"Hubby, did you find anything?" Yasmine asked as soon as Vritra returned.
"No, but I am going to question members of Twilight now. Let's go." He said and the four women were instantly teleported into the book of dimension with him.
In front of them sat a group of lords, a total of eighteen men.
Red was among them too. In the end Vritra had found the rat escaping away from the continent.
He must have heard the news of Vritra's return and fled in advance, but too bad for him, Vritra still caught him.
"These pigs!" Diana instantly cursed upon seeing them, she was well aware of all their crimes.
"Alright let's start by setting up an example." Vritra said as he turned to face the group, he asked no questions and instantly teleported two guys away from the group.
These were all powerful lords yet now they looked extremely frightened and kept begging.

chapters.title: Chapter 605 Ill
paragraphs: Without saying a word, Vritra just began to torture two of the lords, giving them no chance to even speak.
He created tiny dust monsters, using them to crawl inside their bodies from all over.
Their skin was torn as the tiny monsters, which looked like ants, suddenly brightened up and became extremely hot.
The eyes of the two were slowly torn to pieces, their screams made all the others shiver with fear.
But without paying any attention, Vritra continued to increase the level of torture.
The most frightened in the group was of course Red, who knew very well that this guy was none other than Vritra, that terrifying demon.
'Fuck fuck and I thought I had managed to survive, how the hell did he return from the dead? Ughh I should never have participated in that war, please someone save me!!'
He screamed in his head, terrified as the torture made him remember how ruthless Vritra was.
Before long the two men were dead, their bodies had turned into something unrecognizable.
And what terrified them even more was that just as their souls were escaping, even that was devoured by a terrifying chimera.
'Isn't that the chimera that Oracle used in that war? How did he get it?' Red thought fearfully, further making him believe that this guy was none other than Vritra.
"Alright, so who wants to go next?" Vritra asked as he looked at the group.
"P- Please we are ready to answer all your questions so just ask and spare us. We have never offended you." One of the lords in the group said fearfully.
"Yeah well that's true, you never offended me. But he did, and you are all going to suffer just because of him."
Vritra said as he suddenly pointed towards Red, who shivered as cold sweat ran down his body.
Everyone glared at him instantly, wanting to beat him up.
"Anyway, what I want to know is, do any of you know anything about that sudden change? Those spores, that transformation?" he asked and patiently looked over them, before adding:
"The one to answer will not suffer."
"..." They all fell silent for a moment, looking at each other.
"S- Sir we really don't know anything about that, our Twilight isn't behind any of that." One of the men finally spoke, and the others nodded instantly.
"I don't believe you, if you don't answer then one of you will die each time I repeat the question."
Vritra said and threw one in the distance, as once again screams filled the area.
"So now, any of you know?" Vritra asked, his arms crossed over his chest.
"...Believe us, we k- know absolutely nothing, we are just as clueless as you. D- Didn't you see many of our members had already become those monsters?" another added.
"Wrong answer." Vritra shook his head and threw another member away.
Now two men were getting tortured.
"Now, tell me." He repeated the question and waited.
The process repeated for a while, not one of them could answer him. Because of fear, some did make up answers but they couldn't fool Vritra.
After seventeen of them had died, Vritra finally turned to look at Red, who was trembling.
"Yo Red, I heard you have been doing good in the Twilight, don't you want me to join your group anymore?" Vritra asked with a faint smile on his face.
"Uh- N- No sir, who am I to make you join my group hehe that was just a misunderstanding. I never meant to o- offend you, it was all because of that Oracle-"
Red muttered, like before there was still no skin over his body.
"Heh throwing the blame on the dead, not bad. Oh right, where is that clone man of yours?" Vritra asked, that person could be a bit useful.
"H- Him? I know where he is, c- can you spare me if I tell you?" Red asked pitifully, he really had no way out here otherwise.
"Negotiation? haha" Vritra chuckled, then he instructed Psyche to take possession of his body momentarily.
"Wha- ughh" Red instantly grimaced, as Psyche took control of his body.
"Master..." Psyche spoke.
"Check his memory and find the location of that clone guy." Vritra said, while thinking.
'It seems these guys really have nothing to do with this evolution. Sigh this doesn't seem to be natural either, haa Divine why won't you answer.'
"Master I have found it." Psyche said and told Vritra about it.
And Vritra instantly sent this piece of information to Onest, telling him to steal this ability.
Previously, Onest could temporarily copy others' abilities but once he became a lord he could even steal others' abilities.
And the ability to clone even the abilities and memories was actually quite good.
"Alright, I am on it." Onest excitedly replied from the other side.
As Psyche left, Red screamed in terror, fully aware of the type of fate that awaited him.
"Alright, let me torture this pig a little, you should go out now." Vritra looked at his wives who were standing silently and said.
Vanessa and the others glared at Red.
"We should also take our revenge against him." Yasmine said as violent flames burst out, enveloping Red's body, burning him.
Fiona, Diana and Vanessa also began to attack him violently, showing no mercy at all.
"Just leave him alive, even if barely." Vritra could feel their suppressed anger, so he didn't stop them.
After several minutes of attacks, when it really felt Red was about to die, Vritra stopped them and soon after cursing him they left.
"Now, how would you like to die?" Vritra smiled as he stared at the barely alive figure before him.
"S- Spa... me-" Red spoke in a broken voice, feeling so much pain but even suicide was not an option.
Without wasting any words, Vritra poured some healing potion and waited until he was healed and started the second round of torture.
Again and again, he would heal him just to break him even more brutally.
Over two hours had passed and finally Red died, suffering such extreme torture, he regretted his choices again and again.
Begging for quick death.
"Sigh now how do I deal with the trouble outside?" Vritra rubbed his forehead and left the dimensional book.
Upon arriving outside he found five of his wives standing together.
Teresa was here too.
"Tess, are you done?" Vritra asked, this beautiful wife of his was truly such a genius.
"Yes, husband. I am done, these things can not only stop the ice but even the spores. Unless something drastic happens, we can control the damage." Teresa replied with a smile on her face.
She seemed really tired.
"You have worked really hard, are you hungry?" Vritra patted her head, more than the device he was concerned about her.
"Mhmm a little bit, haa let's set it up first." Teresa said weakly and explained how he could use it.
Vritra took the disc-like device which seemed like a toy and was amazed at her capability once again.
If he could provide enough energy, this thing could cover the entire planet and stop the snow and spores, even removing the ones that had already fallen to the ground.
"Okay, let me set this up and then we will eat toge-" Vritra walked towards the window as he spoke but suddenly Teresa fainted, her soft body falling towards the floor.

How did he get it?' Red thought fearfully, further making him believe that this guy was none other than Vritra.
"Alright, so who wants to go next?" Vritra asked as he looked at the group.
"P- Please we are ready to answer all your questions so just ask and spare us.
We have never offended you." One of the lords in the group said fearfully.
"Yeah well that's true, you never offended me.
But he did, and you are all going to suffer just because of him."
Vritra said as he suddenly pointed towards Red, who shivered as cold sweat ran down his body.
Everyone glared at him instantly, wanting to beat him up.
"Anyway, what I want to know is, do any of you know anything about that sudden change?
Those spores, that transformation?" he asked and patiently looked over them, before adding:
"The one to answer will not suffer."
"..." They all fell silent for a moment, looking at each other.
"S- Sir we really don't know anything about that, our Twilight isn't behind any of that." One of the men finally spoke, and the others nodded instantly.
"I don't believe you, if you don't answer then one of you will die each time I repeat the question."
Vritra said and threw one in the distance, as once again screams filled the area.
"So now, any of you know?" Vritra asked, his arms crossed over his chest.
"...Believe us, we k- know absolutely nothing, we are just as clueless as you.
D- Didn't you see many of our members had already become those monsters?" another added.
"Wrong answer." Vritra shook his head and threw another member away.
Now two men were getting tortured.
"Now, tell me." He repeated the question and waited.
The process repeated for a while, not one of them could answer him.
Because of fear, some did make up answers but they couldn't fool Vritra.
After seventeen of them had died, Vritra finally turned to look at Red, who was trembling.
"Yo Red, I heard you have been doing good in the Twilight, don't you want me to join your group anymore?" Vritra asked with a faint smile on his face.
"Uh- N- No sir, who am I to make you join my group hehe that was just a misunderstanding.
I never meant to o- offend you, it was all because of that Oracle-"
Red muttered, like before there was still no skin over his body.
"Heh throwing the blame on the dead, not bad.
Oh right, where is that clone man of yours?" Vritra asked, that person could be a bit useful.
"H- Him?
I know where he is, c- can you spare me if I tell you?" Red asked pitifully, he really had no way out here otherwise.
"Negotiation? haha" Vritra chuckled, then he instructed Psyche to take possession of his body momentarily.
"Wha- ughh" Red instantly grimaced, as Psyche took control of his body.
"Master..." Psyche spoke.
"Check his memory and find the location of that clone guy." Vritra said, while thinking.
'It seems these guys really have nothing to do with this evolution.
Sigh this doesn't seem to be natural either, haa Divine why won't you answer.'
"Master I have found it." Psyche said and told Vritra about it.
And Vritra instantly sent this piece of information to Onest, telling him to steal this ability.
Previously, Onest could temporarily copy others' abilities but once he became a lord he could even steal others' abilities.
And the ability to clone even the abilities and memories was actually quite good.
"Alright, I am on it." Onest excitedly replied from the other side.
As Psyche left, Red screamed in terror, fully aware of the type of fate that awaited him.
"Alright, let me torture this pig a little, you should go out now." Vritra looked at his wives who were standing silently and said.
Vanessa and the others glared at Red.
"We should also take our revenge against him." Yasmine said as violent flames burst out, enveloping Red's body, burning him.
Fiona, Diana and Vanessa also began to attack him violently, showing no mercy at all.
"Just leave him alive, even if barely." Vritra could feel their suppressed anger, so he didn't stop them.
After several minutes of attacks, when it really felt Red was about to die, Vritra stopped them and soon after cursing him they left.
"Now, how would you like to die?" Vritra smiled as he stared at the barely alive figure before him.
"S- Spa... me-" Red spoke in a broken voice, feeling so much pain but even suicide was not an option.
Without wasting any words, Vritra poured some healing potion and waited until he was healed and started the second round of torture.
Again and again, he would heal him just to break him even more brutally.
Over two hours had passed and finally Red died, suffering such extreme torture, he regretted his choices again and again.
Begging for quick death.
"Sigh now how do I deal with the trouble outside?" Vritra rubbed his forehead and left the dimensional book.
Upon arriving outside he found five of his wives standing together.
Teresa was here too.
"Tess, are you done?" Vritra asked, this beautiful wife of his was truly such a genius.
"Yes, husband.
I am done, these things can not only stop the ice but even the spores.
Unless something drastic happens, we can control the damage." Teresa replied with a smile on her face.
She seemed really tired.
"You have worked really hard, are you hungry?" Vritra patted her head, more than the device he was concerned about her.
"Mhmm a little bit, haa let's set it up first." Teresa said weakly and explained how he could use it.
Vritra took the disc-like device which seemed like a toy and was amazed at her capability once again.
If he could provide enough energy, this thing could cover the entire planet and stop the snow and spores, even removing the ones that had already fallen to the ground.
"Okay, let me set this up and then we will eat toge-" Vritra walked towards the window as he spoke but suddenly Teresa fainted, her soft body falling towards the floor.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 I LOVE YOU~
paragraphs: Vritra was just walking towards the window when he noticed Teresa fainting.
"TESS!!" Before her body could fall, he softly caught her in his arms, feeling anxious as he called out her name again and again.
Carrying her to the bed, he laid her down gently and touched her forehead.
"She has a fever?" Vritra was surprised to find the burning hot temperature of her body.
Teresa is at the lord rank, so how could she be ill with such a mundane illness?
Her breathing was fast and as he looked closer, tiny freckle-like patterns could be seen over her cheeks and arms.
"What is this?" he frowned, worry filling his heart, he couldn't care less about saving others when his wife is in danger.
Yasmine, Fiona, Diana, and Vanessa rushed closer and observed the symptoms.
"She certainly seems to be ill, could it be related to those spores?" Yasmine asked, being aware that this was her sister, their bond had deepened even faster.
"Spores? But among all the lords we have seen, not one was affected in the least bit." Fiona said in a concerned tone.
"Not to mention, she has always been protected by so many barriers created by honey, I don't think even a single spore had touched her." Vanessa mumbled.
Vritra massaged her palm, he sat beside her, checking for any other symptoms.
"But did you forget her famous name?" Diana said as everyone thought and remembered.
The Fate Stealer, the most unfortunate and kindest witch.
"You think it is related to her misfortune in her fate?" Vritra asked, his brows furrowed.
"Yeah, from what I have heard, she easily attracts trouble. So I too believe her condition might be related to the sudden changes." Yasmine said, then she suggested:
"Should we try making her drink healing potions?"
"I don't think they would be of any help for now." Diana said, as her knowledge in potions had increased, she obviously knew a lot about various diseases and bodily functions.

"If my observations are right then she should wake up after a few hours, but if this is not cured then her sleeping period will keep increasing and her body will continue to grow weaker." She added, though she couldn't be a hundred percent sure.
"..." Vritra felt even more anxious, how could they cure something they knew nothing about.
The origin or source of those spores is completely unknown, they didn't even know if it was natural or someone's doing.
'Divine...' Vritra desperately called out but the answer was silence each time, he felt so angry.
Especially at himself for not being able to protect his family.
"Is there... nothing we can do now?" he asked helplessly, pulling Teresa closer into his arms.
"Haa no, it isn't something we can control, all we can do is try." Diana replied, she too feeling helpless.
Over seven hours had passed when Teresa's eyelids finally showed a reaction.
Vritra, who had kept her in his arms all this while, instantly noticed it.
Finally Teresa opened her eyes, then she looked around in confusion.
"Tess, how are you feeling?" Vritra asked gently.
"What happened?" she touched her head, as if feeling pain.
"You suddenly fainted." Yasmine said, checking her condition.
"Fainted? I don't know either but I feel weak all over..." Teresa spoke weakly.
She looked down at herself and noticed the speckle-like pattern present over her arms.
"Weak... will it help if she absorbs energy from that planet core?" Vritra asked as he remembered the core.
Without waiting for a response, he pulled the energy from the core which was in the next room and directed it towards Teresa.
"Try absorbing it and tell me if you feel better." Vritra said, hoping for anything to work.
"Mhmm." Teresa nodded, her face looked very pale. As she began to absorb the energy, the pain lessened quite a bit and she felt more energized.
"I feel a little better." Teresa said after a moment, she fell into deep thought, connecting the dots.
A look of sadness appeared on her face after a moment, then she asked: "Could it be because of my fate? I- I am afraid even you all might be affected because of me-"
"Shh just focus on resting for now, don't have any useless thoughts. We can certainly find a solution for it." Vritra said confidently, though internally he was extremely anxious and worried.
Teresa could tell that it must be because of her fate that she had attracted this disease, it must also be related to the spores.
"Husband, have you set up that device?" remembering something, Teresa asked.
"No, not yet." Vritra shook his head, smiling faintly.
"I am feeling better now, go ahead and use it, it will greatly help everyone." She said.
Vritra nodded, after a few minutes he finally flew, his heart heavy.
Mindlessly he flew higher and began to set it up while his mind was filled with all sorts of questions.
Is there nothing he could do to help her?
Vritra opened his status panel, staring over all his skills which now seemed completely useless.
He continued to read and reached the end but couldn't find anything useful, but then he paused, his eyes moving back up.
And his gaze locked onto one particular line.
"This might actually work, but will it be fine?" he wondered. Choosing this option might actually save Teresa but could put himself in danger.
And he wasn't sure if it could be a long-term solution or if it would even work at all.
But if it meant saving Teresa, his beautiful and kind wife, Vritra was ready to take the risk.
After quickly setting things up, he injected a vast amount of energy.
Soon an invisible barrier began to spread all around, not only was it stopping and melting the ice but it even stopped the spores, throwing them out of the planet.
While also pulling the ones that had fallen to the surface.
Vritra poured more and more energy, it was actually taxing, to cover the entire planet he had to empty more than three fourths of his mana.
The whole process took over five hours, but as he looked around, Vritra observed as the snow began to disappear.
The land cleared and even the spores stopped.
"Her talent is truly awesome, haa such a genius." Vritra shook his head, both sisters are geniuses in different fields.
He looked around for a bit and after making sure everything was fine, Vritra decided to leave.
This barrier could remain for at least a month and then he would have to create it again unless Teresa could somehow modify it to last longer.
Flying quickly he approached his house, all the women were still seated around Teresa.
"Husband, is she fine?" suddenly, Yennefer's voice sounded in his mind.
Yennefer didn't yet know much about her but now that the two were part of the family, she knew she would have to get along.
"Not really, none of us know what started all these changes or how to deal with it all." Vritra answered.
"Hmm can you tell me in short the things that happened after I disappeared?" Yennefer asked, Vanessa had already told her many things but there was still a lot she was curious about.
"All right." Vritra nodded and slowed his speed as he began to explain right after his supposed death.
He hid nothing, telling her everything.
"Oh, the Divine isn't responding now?" Yennefer asked, surprise evident in her tone.
"No, I am sure he will have a way to help her and Tess is his sister, I don't know why he isn't responding." Vritra said.
"This is indeed problematic, have you thought of something yet?" Yennefer questioned, she was well aware how far Vritra could go when it comes to his family.
"Yeah, a little something." Vritra answered vaguely as he descended.
They talked for a little longer and soon he was back inside his room.
"Is there any change?" Vritra asked.
"No, we are observing her situation. Though absorbing that core is certainly helping a little." Diana said.
But it can't cure her, only hold off the symptoms.
"Can you all leave me alone with her for a while?" Vritra asked with a solemn look.
His other wives wanted to know if he had found anything but they just nodded and left the two alone.
Teresa lay on the bed with her eyes closed, constantly absorbing the energy.
Upon hearing his voice, she weakly opened her eyes and looked at him. Teresa was even worried that if they came too close, this disease might transfer to them.
"Husband, we don't know if this disease is in-" Teresa was speaking but Vritra pressed a finger over her tender lips and interrupted her.
"Shh don't speak." He said and sat down beside her and gently began to caress her head.
"How do you like your life now? Do you regret getting married to me?" he asked.
"..." Teresa lay silently, making Vritra chuckle.
"All right, you can speak." He said, giving a kiss over her forehead.
"How could I ever regret it? This is the best thing that happened to me. I have enjoyed each moment after getting married, I... love you." Teresa said, feeling a little shy.
"Initially I was so against this marriage, but I never thought my secret bride would be such a wonderful woman. I am really glad that things happened the way they did.
I like your kindness, your shy and innocent demeanour, your smile, your scent. Haha your baddie look, I like everything about you." Vritra spoke slowly.
Speaking such words otherwise might have felt awkward but now, they both could feel each other's emotions.
Teresa still felt shy but was overjoyed upon hearing his sweet and warm words, all the pain and headache disappeared instantly.
"I love you, Tess." Vritra spoke as he leaned and pressed his lips against her moist black lips.
[The Husband of Fate Reaver Activated!]

chapters.title: Chapter 607 Darkness
paragraphs: [Stealer of Fate Activated!]
Suddenly a message popped before Vritra, as he activated the title he had received upon marrying Teresa.
Instantly, his consciousness plunged into a mess of glowing threads, each connected to her.
There were also threads that connected Teresa to him, these were the threads that dictated her future, her misfortunes.
Teresa sensed something amiss but with Vritra's lips pressed against hers, she couldn't even speak.
Unable to understand what exactly Vritra was doing.
'Haa there are so many bad occurrences in her life.' Vritra could naturally sense what each thread represented.
With his high value of mental energy, he only felt slightly dazed as everything recorded in his mind.
Without wasting any time, he began to steal all of her bad luck, everything she was born with or had stolen before.
Quickly a large number of threads disconnected from Teresa and began to connect with Vritra's body.
Sensing this very familiar feeling, Teresa's eyes widened, she could now tell what Vritra was doing.
But how was he able to steal her fate?
No, before that, she had to stop him.
Her hands immediately moved to his shoulder as she tried to break the connection but Vritra didn't budge.
Her eyes were filled with tears, she didn't want to inflict all her pain, her sufferings, her misfortunes on her husband.
Suddenly a cool sensation spread throughout her body, making her body go limp for a moment.
Teresa almost fell unconscious but the sensation of his lips remained, as she closed her eyes.
Vritra didn't separate until he had removed every thread of fate which was meant to bring misfortune.
Of course not all of them could be removed, some natural ones would still stay there.
Finally, their lips separated, as the connection broke.
[You have stolen the fate of Stealer of Fate!]
A message flashed in Vritra's mind as he felt dizziness, he turned his face to the other side and closed his eyes.
Within moments, Teresa's senses returned and the pain in her body rapidly disappeared.
The strange disease she had developed actually disappeared, only leaving her feeling weak.
The world appeared blurry before her, as she blinked a couple of times.
But suddenly, a world full of colours appeared before her. Teresa blinked her eyes in confusion.
How could her blindness be gone?
Then she looked at Vritra, her heart instantly filled with a sorrowful feeling.
"H- Husband..." she called out softly and tried to sit up but felt too weak.
It would take some time for her to regain her strength completely, but now, other than the temporary weakness there was nothing wrong with her body.
The disease and even the blindness had disappeared.
"Husband" she called out again, pulling his arm as Vritra turned to face her.
There were speckle-like patterns over his face and arms but he hid them quickly, not wanting Teresa to see that.
It would only make her feel worse.
His red pupils had dulled, losing the lustre they had previously, and the world was consumed by darkness.
If not for his senses, he wouldn't be able to see anything.
"I am fine." He caressed her forehead, his pupils focused right where Teresa was but he couldn't see her.
This was how she had lived all her life. While she must have been completely blind when young, only after her strength grew was she able to use her senses.
"H- How did you- No, why did you... why did you do that?" Teresa's voice was almost choked, her heart aching.
She wouldn't want even strangers to suffer, even going as far as taking their fate.
So how could she not be sad as all the bad things shifted to the one person she had come to love the most.
"Yeah it is selfish of me, but I just can't see you suffer. I also know how this will make you feel but you don't have to worry at all." Vritra spoke with a reassuring smile before continuing:
"Not only can I steal fates but I can also give them to someone else, so I can just give all this to someone. I can handle this."
Hearing his words, Teresa felt a bit better. If it meant for Vritra, she wouldn't hesitate to harm anyone.
Vritra continued to speak soothing words as Teresa completely relaxed, her trust in Vritra was more than anything.
If he said so then she was sure he could do it.
"..." After finally calming down, Teresa finally noticed that her eyesight had returned.
She stared at Vritra's face, his image was never as clear as now.
"Husband, you look so good... you are so good to me." She mumbled weakly, pulling his arm.
Vritra smiled, then leaned towards her and gave her a soft kiss.
After talking for a little longer, Vritra left her alone to rest as Teresa began to absorb the energy from the core.
After Vritra closed the door behind him, his expression changed.
Since he was a demi god, the disease didn't affect him as much as Teresa but it still left him feeling dizzy.
"Are you okay? Did you really have to harm yourself for her?" just then Yennefer's worried voice sounded in his mind.
She really wished she was outside to stop her reckless husband from doing that.
"Yeah, I am fine, and yes, this was necessary. Now that she is mine, I would do anything in my power to protect her just like how I wouldn't let any harm near you." He said firmly.
"Sigh..." Yennefer just sighed, she knew perfectly well how much he could do for his wives.
This was why she was worried earlier.
Vritra stopped his senses as the world became completely dark, he really couldn't see anything.
"Well it's a new sort of experience." He chuckled and tried walking forward only to bump into a wall.

Yennefer could only shake her head and asked: "Do you really have a way to push this fate to someone else? If so, then hurry up and... just throw it on that classmate of yours, that you have captured."
"Of course I don't, if I hadn't lied, do you think Teresa would have calmed down. She is too kind for her own good." Vritra said as his senses returned and he could finally make out his surroundings.
"What-?! Husband, you are way too reckless, among us only you have the strength to deal with the sudden disaster, if you were to fall ill won't all of us be in danger anyway?
And what about stealing Jack's hero fate?" Yennefer spoke in exasperation.

"Hmm well I can find the solution somehow. How could I hesitate when her life was in danger. As for Jack, maybe I will let Tess steal his fate." Vritra mumbled unsurely, but what if she stole his bad luck too.
So he was a bit hesitant.
"Wait wait, didn't you mention that Teresa had stolen the fate of a maid and she would be unable to bear a child in the future?
You didn't steal that as well, did you?" Yennefer asked with a bad feeling, of course like Yasmine and others, she too wanted a child with him.
"Uh... I think I did, haa we will find a solution, don't worry." Vritra said helplessly.
"You did?!! I am telling Yasmine and the others right now!" Yennefer said and tried to connect with his other wives.
Soon, they all knew what he had done.

'Haa there are so many bad occurrences in her life.' Vritra could naturally sense what each thread represented.
With his high value of mental energy, he only felt slightly dazed as everything recorded in his mind.
Without wasting any time, he began to steal all of her bad luck, everything she was born with or had stolen before.
Quickly a large number of threads disconnected from Teresa and began to connect with Vritra's body.
Sensing this very familiar feeling, Teresa's eyes widened, she could now tell what Vritra was doing.
But how was he able to steal her fate?
No, before that, she had to stop him.
Her hands immediately moved to his shoulder as she tried to break the connection but Vritra didn't budge.
Her eyes were filled with tears, she didn't want to inflict all her pain, her sufferings, her misfortunes on her husband.
Suddenly a cool sensation spread throughout her body, making her body go limp for a moment.
Teresa almost fell unconscious but the sensation of his lips remained, as she closed her eyes.
Vritra didn't separate until he had removed every thread of fate which was meant to bring misfortune.
Of course not all of them could be removed, some natural ones would still stay there.
Finally, their lips separated, as the connection broke.
[You have stolen the fate of Stealer of Fate!]
A message flashed in Vritra's mind as he felt dizziness, he turned his face to the other side and closed his eyes.
Within moments, Teresa's senses returned and the pain in her body rapidly disappeared.
The strange disease she had developed actually disappeared, only leaving her feeling weak.
The world appeared blurry before her, as she blinked a couple of times.
But suddenly, a world full of colours appeared before her.
Teresa blinked her eyes in confusion.
How could her blindness be gone?
Then she looked at Vritra, her heart instantly filled with a sorrowful feeling.
"H- Husband..." she called out softly and tried to sit up but felt too weak.
It would take some time for her to regain her strength completely, but now, other than the temporary weakness there was nothing wrong with her body.
The disease and even the blindness had disappeared.
"Husband" she called out again, pulling his arm as Vritra turned to face her.
There were speckle-like patterns over his face and arms but he hid them quickly, not wanting Teresa to see that.
It would only make her feel worse.
His red pupils had dulled, losing the lustre they had previously, and the world was consumed by darkness.
If not for his senses, he wouldn't be able to see anything.
"I am fine." He caressed her forehead, his pupils focused right where Teresa was but he couldn't see her.
This was how she had lived all her life.
While she must have been completely blind when young, only after her strength grew was she able to use her senses.
"H- How did you- No, why did you... why did you do that?" Teresa's voice was almost choked, her heart aching.
She wouldn't want even strangers to suffer, even going as far as taking their fate.
So how could she not be sad as all the bad things shifted to the one person she had come to love the most.
"Yeah it is selfish of me, but I just can't see you suffer.
I also know how this will make you feel but you don't have to worry at all." Vritra spoke with a reassuring smile before continuing:
"Not only can I steal fates but I can also give them to someone else, so I can just give all this to someone.
I can handle this."
Hearing his words, Teresa felt a bit better.
If it meant for Vritra, she wouldn't hesitate to harm anyone.
Vritra continued to speak soothing words as Teresa completely relaxed, her trust in Vritra was more than anything.
If he said so then she was sure he could do it.
"..." After finally calming down, Teresa finally noticed that her eyesight had returned.
She stared at Vritra's face, his image was never as clear as now.
"Husband, you look so good... you are so good to me." She mumbled weakly, pulling his arm.
Vritra smiled, then leaned towards her and gave her a soft kiss.
After talking for a little longer, Vritra left her alone to rest as Teresa began to absorb the energy from the core.
After Vritra closed the door behind him, his expression changed.
Since he was a demi god, the disease didn't affect him as much as Teresa but it still left him feeling dizzy.
"Are you okay?
Did you really have to harm yourself for her?" just then Yennefer's worried voice sounded in his mind.
She really wished she was outside to stop her reckless husband from doing that.
"Yeah, I am fine, and yes, this was necessary.
Now that she is mine, I would do anything in my power to protect her just like how I wouldn't let any harm near you." He said firmly.
"Sigh..." Yennefer just sighed, she knew perfectly well how much he could do for his wives.
This was why she was worried earlier.
Vritra stopped his senses as the world became completely dark, he really couldn't see anything.
"Well it's a new sort of experience." He chuckled and tried walking forward only to bump into a wall.
Yennefer could only shake her head and asked: "Do you really have a way to push this fate to someone else?
If so, then hurry up and... just throw it on that classmate of yours, that you have captured."
"Of course I don't, if I hadn't lied, do you think Teresa would have calmed down.
She is too kind for her own good." Vritra said as his senses returned and he could finally make out his surroundings.
"What-?!
Husband, you are way too reckless, among us only you have the strength to deal with the sudden disaster, if you were to fall ill won't all of us be in danger anyway?
And what about stealing Jack's hero fate?" Yennefer spoke in exasperation.
"Hmm well I can find the solution somehow.
How could I hesitate when her life was in danger.
As for Jack, maybe I will let Tess steal his fate." Vritra mumbled unsurely, but what if she stole his bad luck too.
So he was a bit hesitant.
"Wait wait, didn't you mention that Teresa had stolen the fate of a maid and she would be unable to bear a child in the future?
You didn't steal that as well, did you?" Yennefer asked with a bad feeling, of course like Yasmine and others, she too wanted a child with him.
I think I did, haa we will find a solution, don't worry." Vritra said helplessly.
"You did?!!
I am telling Yasmine and the others right now!" Yennefer said and tried to connect with his other wives.
Soon, they all knew what he had done.

chapters.title: Chapter 608 Fishing
paragraphs: Somewhere far far away,
A person sat in a completely white space with absolutely nothing around, a cloth made of light wrapped around his body.
Even with the physique of a human, he didn't look like one.
His skin glowed with a holy feeling and he emanated a powerful pressure.
In front of him, on the other side of a table, sat a woman. Though both the woman and the table were mere images, they weren't actually present here.
The man stared up into the sky, seemingly in a daze.
After a moment, a smile appeared over his face, he couldn't help but chuckle. "You were right." he spoke as his gaze returned to the blonde-haired woman, whose body was too blurry.
"..." she didn't say anything but continued to stare absentmindedly into the sky.
"Just nine years were enough for you to understand him this well? Anyway, now that you have won another bet, I will fulfil the promise." He spoke.
"How can I not when he is mine. Anyway, hurry it up, I can't wait any longer." The woman's emotionless gaze finally returned to the man, as she stated in a hurrying voice.
"Haha you have already waited for several hundred years, what could a few more years mean. Anyway, are you really sure? This could bring trouble even for you." He asked, a small smile on his face.
"Yes, when have I ever cared about danger when it came to him." She spoke, her gaze drifting back to the sky.
A look of longing and obsession flashed in her eyes momentarily before she became emotionless once again.
"That's... true, whether it be that powerful skill Mutamorphis or all other skills, you have truly showered him with opportunities, like a true sugar mommy." He laughed.
"Divine, this will be the last thing this avatar of yours will be doing. Don't you want to-" she spoke but Divine interrupted.
"It is fine, I am always around my sisters, how could I ever let them die again? Even I can't control their fates but I have already done enough." He said as his gaze returned to the sight of Vritra.
He was relieved and happy, he could completely entrust the safety of his sisters to such a man.
"Alright then, I will be taking my leave. This will be a big and dangerous journey for them, make sure they are well prepared. The woman said and her body began to disappear.
"Of course, I wouldn't want my brother-in-law to go unprepared in such a dangerous place." Divine muttered.
Soon he was left alone, now that he had seen enough, it was finally time to participate.
Back on the Zoratian planet, Vritra was bombarded with questions from his wives.
They were clearly not happy, they all cared for Teresa but even more for Vritra. Yasmine was even more upset upon hearing that he could not even become a father now.
She was trying so hard to have his baby, it was for her own sister but still how could she accept something like this.
"Hubby, you have to immediately find a solution to this, I don't care about the condition of the world, let it burn, let it get destroyed, but I can't accept this." Yasmine spoke firmly.
"Honey, you shouldn't have made such a big decision just like that without even considering the consequences." Vanessa said.
"Tsk it's all because of her, I am going to-" Fiona had only started to accept
Teresa as family but now her dislike increased greatly.
"Stop it is not her fault, it was my decision completely." Vritra stopped Fiona, his head aching as all his wives surrounded him.
Even Maeve and Yennefer's voices were ringing in his head.
He didn't know how to calm all of them, now that he had used up his one chance to steal fate, he can't even do it again.
Vritra truly didn't know what to do but just then a different voice sounded in his mind.
"Hey there, how has life been?"
It was none other than Divine himself.
Vritra was a bit surprised but he quickly told them that he needed to talk with Divine and disappeared from between them.
Appearing far away in the sky, he finally felt a bit better.

"You bastard, where have you been all this time? I have been calling you for so long, you insect ass." Vritra cursed, all his frustrations coming out now. "Ah sorry, I was unable to reply, you see I was really low on energy. Anyway, it seems things are problematic, did you use that fishing rod you got before?" Divine asked suddenly.
"No, I haven't. But before that, you have to hel-" Vritra was speaking but Divine interrupted him.
"Huh, why didn't you? Go ahead and try it, only then will we talk. Don't waste any time, I don't have much energy." Divine said, making Vritra even more
angry.
But for now he could only follow his instructions.
He quickly took out the fishing rod and asked impatiently and in an annoyed tone: "What now? What can it even do?"

"Just do what one would do with a fishing rod, try to catch the fish." Divine said and hurriedly added: "But there needs to be water for it to hunt, hmm why don't you try fishing in that stream of water in the Null ability?"
"Null?" Vritra paused and thought about it, indeed when he activated Null he
did see an endless stream of water flowing.
[Null Activated.]
Without asking any further questions, he directly activated the skill and
instantly found himself in the dark familiar space.
On one side was the flowing river while a couple of other things were present
as well.
Ignoring other things, he just focused on the river, moving closer, he positioned
himself.
Initially, it was impossible for him to stay there but now that he is a demi god and his comprehension of Null has increased to 100%.
He felt no pressure or pain.
With little knowledge of fishing, he copied the movement he had seen before
and threw the hook forward.
The hook instantly fell into the endless stream, which obviously wasn't made of
water.
He waited for a moment and instantly felt a powerful tug, without hesitation,
Vritra pulled it with all his strength.
WHOOSH
Instantly a figure was pulled along the thread, landing swiftly beside him.
But as Vritra saw it, his eyes widened in shock.
As before him, the person standing was none other than himself.
"What... is the meaning of this?" Vritra stared in bafflement, this person was
certainly himself.
But he just stood there silently without seeming to possess any life.
Before Divine's reply, Vritra felt a strange sensation.
His body, organs, bones, each of his cells began to vibrate suddenly, so did the other person.
Their figures were pulled together and suddenly merged, becoming one. After a moment, Vritra's body stabilized, all the freckle-like patterns were gone.

The blindness was gone, the threads of fate he had just stolen were gone, even the energy he had used to keep this skill activated was back. Vritra was shocked and at a loss for words, it was like he had just been created
anew.
Even the clothes on his body appeared new, the change was just too big.
Vritra looked down at the ordinary-looking fishing rod and then at himself. This treasure might be way better than he had expected, it could not only alter
his disease and physical form but even fate itself.
"Divine, just what is this thing?"

chapters.title: Chapter 609 Argento
paragraphs: "Well this is a special treasure that could help you get to your peak no matter how much you have suffered. So unless you are one shot killed, it would be impossible for you to die." Divine answered, then added:

"There are a couple more functions to it, like you can steal anything from any inventory, glyph, or whatever storage. And the best thing is, you can fish others' fate with it. Well, you will understand it more as you use it."
"...Oh!" Vritra was certainly surprised, this thing was far better than he expected.
He deactivated the Null and returned to the real world, once again feeling the cold air.
The disease, blindness, everything was really gone.
Putting the great treasure away, he asked solemnly: "So now, can you tell me about these spores and the sudden change? What is going on?"
"Haa where is my thank you?" Divine spoke in a self-pitying tone.
"What? You still want thank you? Why don't you come here, I will give you a thank you."
With a frown, Vritra spoke, feeling angry. He really wished he could slap him a few times.
This bastard dared to test him, he was clearly waiting until Vritra had taken away Teresa's ill fate.
Only now did he respond, he was clearly testing Vritra.
"Okay okay, I guess I should thank you for taking care of my sister." Divine laughed, then he fell silent.
There was a brief pause, then his serious voice sounded: "And just as you thought, someone outside your planet is responsible for the spores and strange mutations."
"Was it some god? Are they still targeting us?" Vritra knew how gods were targeting Yasmine and Teresa, but this attack wasn't directly targeting them.
"No, the gods can't do something like this, at least not openly. It was done by another planet." Divine said in a serious tone, and he had rarely been serious before.
"Another planet? Are they trying to decrease the competition in advance? Was it the planet with whom our trial will be happening?"
Vritra questioned as several questions popped in his mind, waiting for him to continue.

"Yes, they are indeed trying to decrease the competition, but it wasn't that planet, they don't have the means to do something like this. It is a planet which is already in their 3rd Game." Divine answered.

"3rd game? We haven't even been through the trial, so why? Shouldn't the future games content be hidden?" Vritra's frown deepened and anger filled him. "They must already know that you will win the trial, and the next three games. So, in the fourth game, the two planets will be against each other, so they are weakening this planet in advance.

And yes, such things should be hidden, but you know those shady gods. Not only did they provide the information, they even helped cause trouble for the Zoratian planet, without doing anything themselves."
Divine spoke, his voice brimming with rage.
"Haa so is there a way to stop it all? Can't we report or something?" the shield created by Teresa isn't a permanent solution.
She herself got ill without ever coming in contact with a spore, which means that such diseases will soon follow in the next waves.
"Report? To whom? The gods themselves are the administrators here, and they overlook each other's mistakes unless it is too big" Divine said.
"So we just wait till the trials have started? But most of the people will end up dead and my family will also be in danger. There must be some way."
Vritra spoke, feeling his anger rise at the god and that planet responsible for it all.
"There is, let's turn this mistake into a blunder. Make it so big that the god who helped them will himself be punished heavily." Divine spoke, his tone growing ruthless.
"And how do we do that?" Vritra was going to choose this option no matter how dangerous it might be, rather than just entering trials and later on facing them.
"By entering their 3rd game, but let me remind you. It will be very very dangerous, especially for you because it's been almost six months since the game started.
Although the starting point of everyone is the same, the people, beasts and all would already have gotten stronger while you will start only now" Divine warned.
'Six months? Isn't that around the time these spores started falling, is that a coincidence? Or their game related to all this?' Vritra wondered, but this didn't
matter now.
"Yes, I will participate in this game of theirs. Can you tell me more about it?" Vritra felt a bit relaxed now that he knew the cause of the problem and
knowing that there is also a solution.
"From a planet called Argento, a group of ten players was sent to a different
planet where the apocalypse had just started.
Their goal was just to survive till the end of it and kill a few selected targets." Divine gave a rough idea, then he continued:
"But if you were to go now, then aside from surviving till the end, you also have to kill all ten of them and reach the tower."
"Hmm I understand, how long will this game last and do I have to go alone?" he asked, the more he knew about it the better.
"It was originally three years, but six months have already passed. And no, it's your choice completely whether you want to bring anyone along, at most 10.
Also, you would be gone for almost a year." Divine answered, he was serious during the entire conversation.
Vritra fell into thoughts, bringing his wives along will be dangerous but he can't leave them all here for a year.
He would feel assured if they are with him, so he quickly made up his mind.
"Okay so when is the time to go?" Vritra asked, a determined look in his eyes. If they dared to mess with him, then he would beat them at their own game,
literally this time.
"Whenever you are ready but hurry it up, there are a few more things you should know, but I will explain them when you are ready to leave." Divine said.
"Okay, after all of them have reached the demi god rank, we will leave!" Vritra spoke while going over Divine's words.
It seemed their current strength might not matter once they are in the game, and everyone starts anew.
After exchanging a few more words, their conversation ended and Divine went silent while Vritra flew towards his house.
He was both happy and angry.
Right as he arrived inside the house of darkness, his wives instantly surrounded
him and began to complain.
"Wait wait, look I am perfectly fine now. I don't have the disease, the blindness, the bad luck..." then he looked at Yasmine and added: "And I can become a
father."
Yasmine and his other wives looked at him sceptically: "You aren't saying that just to protect Teresa, right?"
Vritra rolled his eyes, feeling exasperated at such an exaggerated reaction.
"Of course I am not, I wouldn't lie about this." He spoke with an honest
expression.
"Really?" Yasmine narrowed her eyes, still not believing his words, she still felt
he might be trying to protect her sister.
"You can tell us the truth, we will still support you." she added, clearly testing
the waters.
"Fine, you want proof right? Let's do it until I have knocked you up." Vritra
picked Yasmine up suddenly and entered one of the rooms.
