Rich looked at his surroundings for a moment. They were standing in the open, yet there was no snow or spores around.
"My aunty did it, right?" he asked. He doubted anyone had the capability to create something like that.
Teresa was even more of a genius than the creator of the glyphs.
It was just too bad she was so unlucky and vulnerable.
"Yes, Teresa indeed created the device that helped everyone." Vritra nodded.
"Is she alright? My auntie has always been unlucky and easily gets sick, but since she was always locked up in her room, I asked her to create a special glyph for me." He quickly took it out.
The glyph was a faint green colour, then he continued.
"Whenever my aunt is in danger or she is ill, I am the first who gets informed. I was so worried about her, is she fine?" Rich asked with a worried look.
Vritra smiled. He really is different from others in his family.
"Yes, she is perfectly fine now. Actually better than ever. She is just resting now." Vritra said, not explaining much.
Rich nodded, heaving a long sigh of relief.
"Thank you, that's all I wanted to know. Then I will be taking my leave now."
Just as he turned around, Vritra thought of something. For what he had planned, Rich would be better at arranging it all than the monk and Onest.
"Wait, there is something I need your help with." He called out and Rich turned.
"Just tell me, I will do my best." He said.
And Vritra explained it to him.
"H- Huh? Whom are we preparing this for?" There was confusion and surprise on Rich's face.
"You will know later, just tell me how much money or resources you need. You can use these two for whatever tasks you want." He said.
"...Alright." He nodded, and the two discussed it a bit more.
Soon he left the place, since time was less and there was too much to prepare.
"Sir Shitless and my friend Onest." Vritra called out, as the two men looked at one another and a bad feeling crept into their hearts.
"Y- Yes? Do you need us for something?" Shitless asked while taking slow steps backward.
"There is something important you two should know." He said and then explained a few of the things Divine had told him.
"Oh, so you are going to crash into their game, be careful." Onest said seriously.
"Those bastards, beat them all for us, kill them!" Shitless cursed as well.
"Yes, soon, we will be leaving the Zoratian planet and enter the game." Vritra said.
"Hmm, alright, while you are gone- wait, we? You don't... mean us, right?" the monk asked in bafflement.
Being evil is fine, but that sounded far too dangerous. The chances of survival were way too low.
"Yes, how can I leave you two here and let you enjoy? You two have to go there with me. With so much danger, I would need cannon fodder and maybe you can even act as my bait." Vritra said honestly.
"N- No, I think we will just be a burden on you. Take this mugger, he runs really fast. I can pray for you while staying here." Shitless pushed Onest ahead and took another step back.
"You Baldy-"
Vritra interrupted them.
"I have already decided, and we are all in, in this plan."
After giving a few friendly threats to his brotherly friends, Vritra left the two depressed guys alone.
"Let me write my will- wait, I don't have any money to pass on- wait, I don't even have any family to pass my no money." Shitless said, sighing.
"...Although you are bald, stupid, and useless, but it was still nice- moderately ni- relatively n- it was not bad knowing you." Onest said solemnly.
The two went to their rooms to prepare.
As Vritra got busy preparing a couple of things, time passed quickly.
Although the disaster had momentarily stopped, people were still filled with grief. Many had lost their lives after all.
Many of those who had mutated were still locked up. Vritra hoped that they could be healed.
He even went to study these guys but could do nothing about them.
Just like that, three days passed.
All his wives were still in the process of absorbing the energy, but one of them was finally about to come out.
Vritra stood before the door of Maeve's room. She had finally evolved.
His other wives would just reach the demi god rank, but Maeve would have a major upgrade in her physique and bloodline.
"That fox got out before me, sigh." Yennefer sighed.
Over the past few days, Vritra talked with Yennefer and Yasmine even while he was far away, so he could hold on despite missing them.
'Yenni, you still don't like her?' he asked, while sensing the fluctuation of energy from inside the room.
"No, of course not, but I never thought I would be sharing my husband with other women, six women at that." Yennefer spoke in exasperation, then she added, "But no more women, okay?"
"Yeah, it's not like I am searching for a woman or any woman is waiting to take me away." Vritra said, shaking his head.
Even in the cases of Vanessa, Yasmine, Yennefer, and Teresa, he wasn't chasing them but somehow still ended up together.
He did pull Fiona and Diana into his life himself though. As for Maeve, it was a mix of both.
Just then, the energy fluctuations stopped and faint sounds of clothes rustling and falling sounded.
Maeve wore a new beautiful set of clothes.
And finally, the door opened.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 Important Meeting
paragraphs: As the door opened, Maeve's beautiful figure came into view. She was wearing a black dress, a stark contrast to her glowing milky skin.
She seemed to have grown even more beautiful, a fluffy tail moving left to right as she walked forward.
Vritra looked over her body, her thick thighs and soft heavy breasts. Her voluptuous figure seemed even more ripe now.
And her face, even the succubus might not be her competition.
Her beauty, except for Teresa, wasn't lower than anyone else.
"Welcome back, foxie." He smiled, taking a step forward and patting her head.
Her strength had grown tremendously, and among all his wives, she was the first to become a demi god.
Without a word, she wrapped her arms around his body, snuggling into his embrace and breathing in his scent.
"Mhmm Master, I missed you." She mumbled, rubbing her cheek against his chest.
"You have done well, now, should we go and check how much stronger you have gotten?" he asked, wrapping his arms around her waist and pulling her closer.
Her warm and soft body felt incredibly good to hold.
"How?" Maeve looked up at his face. Rather than wasting time on some fights, she would love to stay with her master.
While she was away, all his wives had been with him, even fighting that fierce battle that left the four women exhausted.
"Wait, are we trying that baby making fight? Let's do it right now, master." A big smile appeared on her face as she stood on tiptoes and pressed her lips against his.
Her tongue instantly moved to entangle with his, while her hands moved in haste, hurriedly removing his clothes.
Vritra was surprised at her eagerness. Her scent filled his nose as her tongue wrapped around his, her taste flooding into his mouth.
He gave a light slap to her soft butt and pulled his mouth away, the demoness's face already flushed red with lust.
"Wait, not the baby making fight, let's do that later. Right now, we have to make a trip somewhere." Vritra said, straightening his disheveled clothes.
"Oh, where are we going?" Maeve licked her lips, though she would have loved to continue.
"Somewhere very familiar to you." Vritra smiled, taking her hand as he pulled her out of the room.
The sky was completely dark, and occasional screams could be heard from the distance.
Few humans could be spotted, but all of them were tied like slaves or getting beaten.
A few other species such as elves and werewolves could also be spotted, but they were rarer.
A stench of blood filled the air and a bloody moon was visible in the sky.
Several figures flew across the air, hurrying towards an important meeting.
"Lord, why do you think this sudden meeting was called for?" one of the demons with a body as small as a football questioned.
"It seems to be something important or Lord Sloth wouldn't have called us in such a hurry." The demon lord ranked 67 replied, his body made entirely of thin blue lines.
It was as if he was entangled, and he would be nothing more than a very very long thread.
"Oh, it seems many other demon lords have been called to this meeting." The small servant flying along the demon lord muttered.
"Yeah, do you think we are finally going to attack the humans? I heard even the snow and spores have stopped falling somehow. Now should be the perfect chance." The 67th demon lord muttered.
Because of the snow and spores, they weren't able to leave this realm for several months.
Previously, many lords used to live in different realms, but ever since the war, Sloth grew in power and influence rapidly.
And he had done something miraculous. He united all 100 of the demon lords, becoming the king of demon lords.
Now all of them had shifted to this one realm and obeyed Sloth completely.
He was very lucky to have survived that war against that demon, but that also benefited him a lot.
Many demon lords had died in that war, all of that was absorbed by Sloth alone.
Before anyone knew it, he had grown so big that none of the demons were his match.
So in the end, they all submitted to him, and now this whole demon realm was under the rule of Sloth.
"Whoa, it's my first time seeing all 100 demons together, a- and the king of demons will be here as well? I heard his body is very big and he could eat anything." The small demon mumbled.
"Shh. Don't utter a word from here on out. If you make a mistake, then all it takes is one command and we would all be wiped out, even our entire groups." The demon lord warned seriously.
Soon after they landed, after looking around, he found someone he recognized and immediately called out:
"Lord 69, did you know why King Sloth called us here?" Lord 67 asked.
Since Sloth didn't want to bother learning all their names, he just replaced the names with numbers instead.
"No, I just received the message and hurried here. Hmm, are we finally attacking humans?" he had the same thoughts.
They looked around. It was a large hall which was specially made to call such important meetings.
All the other demon lords were rushing inside in a hurry, so without wasting any time, they too moved in.
Upon entering, they found themselves in a spacious hall, with exactly one hundred chairs arranged in front of a very big throne.
It was big enough for at least thirty of them to sit.
While murmuring among themselves, the lords took their seats while their servants stood beside them.
BOOM
Just then a loud sound rang out, then another and another.
They all became silent and turned their gazes towards the throne. King Sloth was here.
And soon after, a very large piece of fat, his height reaching over twenty feet, walked with slight difficulty.
His face appeared similar to a pig, and it was none other than Sloth, the father of Piggy who had died long ago.
"..." Everyone became nervous upon seeing him. His body had become far too fatty, his belly so big as if a house was built inside.
After a few steps, he paused, then looked at the lords seated at the front with a frown.
"O- Oh right, sorry King Sloth." Over ten men hurriedly stood up and walked forward.
After slight hesitation, they gripped his belly and pulled it up.
Then with a proud look, Sloth walked towards his throne while over ten demon lords carried his belly.
With a loud thump that made the entire hall shake, he sat down as the others slowly put down his belly.
"Return to your seats." Not even his jaw could move as he spoke. His cheeks had become like two different bellies.
"Greetings, King." Everyone stood up and greeted.
Sloth nodded in satisfaction. He was quite happy that he had participated in that war all those years ago.
He was the only survivor and had grown to this extent.
After clearing his throat, he questioned:
"Now tell me, why exactly did you all call me here in such a hurry? I even had to leave my meal behind. Sigh, I am getting too thin, so it better be worth it or I..."
As he spoke, everyone's expressions turned to confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 A Mass Kidnapping
paragraphs: As Sloth spoke, everyone's expressions turned to confusion.
Lord 11 stood up and asked respectfully: "King Sloth, wasn't it you who called us all here for the meeting? All of us had received orders directly from you."
"Yes lord, why would we disturb you? We handle most things ourselves, we even called everyone back to this realm from outside since you said so." Another demon lord said.
They were all confused, even the demons that had hidden among humans and other races were called back in a hurry, so the demon realm was now very flooded with demons.
"What?! Are you all playing a joke with me, did you already forget my fury or should I eat one of you to remind you?" Sloth hit the armrest in rage, making it explode.
The demon lords instantly fell silent, it didn't seem Sloth was joking either.
If neither they nor the king had called this meeting then who exactly called all of them here and how?
"What's going on? You all better not play tricks or I will-" just as Sloth was threatening, the sound of steady footsteps echoed.
All gazes turned towards the entrance where a silhouette appeared.
"Who is it?" Sloth narrowed his eyes, though because of the fat, he could barely even open them.
After a couple of seconds, a beautiful fox demon appeared before everyone.
"Hello everyone, it was me who called you all here." There was a faint smile on her face as she gazed around at all the demons.
There was once a time when she was being forced into marrying that pig because of Raelion's whore mother.
But now, her strength had grown to the extent that she could kill all of them within moments.
She was really happy to have Vritra in her life, without him, she might already have ended her life rather than marrying that Ziggy.
"Who are you- Oh I think I remember you, aren't you the girl from Raelion's family, I remember one of my sons fancied you back in the day." After a moment, Sloth recognized Maeve.
But all demons stared in entrancement at the extremely gorgeous demoness, they had never ever seen such a beautiful entity.
The measure of her beauty far surpassed any lords.
Many had seen her before, although she was very beautiful but the demoness now was too intoxicatingly beautiful.
"Whoa is she really that uh Maeve? When did she become so beautiful?" one of the demon lords muttered in amazement.
"I think I am falling in love, she's too hot!"
Everyone stared at the demoness as she made her way into the hall.
"Your name is Maeve huh, so was it you who called this meeting? What was your purpose- No before that, I heard you are responsible for the death of one of my sons.
That crime is punishable by death, but if you agree to marry me then I can forgive you." Sloth too couldn't keep his barely open eyes away from the stunning demoness, her aura was too seductive.
The fox demoness looked playful, cunning and too alluring.
Upon entering the hall, Maeve looked around and finally her gaze landed on the big piece of fat who had just proposed marriage.
Her expression changed instantly to one of disgust.
"You pig father and son, did someone take away all the mirrors from your house or has a mirror that could contain your size not been made yet?
Your stench has made this realm too smelly." She pinched her nose, even looking at that large pig made her eyes feel dirty.
She looked at the other demons, ignored the shocked, lustful and angry pig and spoke: "Yes, it was indeed me who called for this meeting.
And I am giving you ten seconds, all of you surrender and sit on your knees."
BOOM

The other armrest exploded as well, the fat on Sloth's body trembled as he spoke in anger: "You rude girl, you feel insulted by the idea of marrying this king?! Good good, now you have angered me, at any cost, you will be married to me now."
"Hahaha did you hear what she just said? She wants us all to kneel and surrender? With just her?"
"She even said it so seriously, anyway, what a pity that pi- cough our king will get this beauty, I would have given up everything to marry her."
All the demons began to laugh, not taking her threat seriously at all.
While several of them even stood up, to please the fat king, they decided to capture her and present her to him.
They would be happy to even get a chance to touch her a bit, seeing her slender milky arms, they gulped.
"Well, little girl, just give up. There is no point in-" over ten of them had rushed forward, with similar thoughts.
Even getting to touch her hand would be a lifelong achievement for them.
Maeve's gaze fixed on the fat demon, she didn't even feel angry at their disrespectful words, they were nothing more than bugs.
And what's the point of getting angry when they could easily be crushed to death.
"I gave you all a chance." She shook her head.
Then as over a dozen demon lords charged at her, Sloth shouted to make them stop, knowing their thoughts.
Maeve's charms were just so high that because of their lust they seemed to have forgotten everything.
Just as Sloth was about to attack, a pinkish fog rushed in all directions around Maeve and then...
BOOM BOOM BOOM
The heads of the demon lords in the hall exploded one after another, like a chain reaction.
All hundred demon lords had their heads exploded, creating a bloody mess, as pieces of brain matter and bones flew in all directions.
Except for Sloth, all the other demons' heads had exploded.
Of course they hadn't died yet.
"W- Wha-?!!" Sloth froze in shock and fear, how could she be so powerful.
As the cloud of lust finally subsided, he finally remembered something important.
Whose woman was Maeve exactly? Wasn't it that demon who had supposedly died in the war?

chapters.title: Chapter 619 Instant Karma
paragraphs: On the other side of the portal, Jack was running around and screaming madly, but there was no one else.
He was kidnapped by Vritra and it had been days, he had been completely forgotten it seemed.
"You bastard, fight me if you dare, stop playing these underhanded tricks." He screamed, punching and kicking the air.
He was sure Vritra might have just used some trick to fool Fiona too, but he was going to do whatever it takes to make her come to her senses.
Just then, a portal opened and three women walked out.
"!!!" At first scared, Jack was instantly overjoyed.
"Fiona, goddess a- and is that Vritra's mother?" he wondered, but then laughed happily. "You are here for me, right? You have come to save me? SOB I knew it, I do hold a special place in your heart."
Fiona's expression changed instantly to one of disgust, she took a step back.
"Why is he here?"
"Fiona, it's me, Jack. Goddess, you remember me, right? You are here to rescue me, right? D- Don't tell me you also like me?" he was stunned by his own deductions at first.
But then he laughed and said: "Well, it's bad luck, I just love Fiona too much, but once we are together, then I might give you a chance."
It seemed him being a hero and growing so fast had made even the goddess fall for his charm.
"Wow, would you look at this kid. One could even say he was born to act in a condoms advertisement.
And this right here is exactly the regret of a generation, can't imagine how much pain your mother had endured after birthing you." Vanessa said, sighing.
"Whoa, that was nice." Diana praised.
"Heh, I am learning from honey."
The three women laughed as they watched Jack's expression, he was startled and humiliated.
"H- How dare you!! You think you can say whatever, I am going to-" he just raised his right hand to scare Vanessa.
BOOM
But in the next moment, his entire arm exploded into a bloody mist.
"If I were you, I would be careful not to mess up any more than you already have." Vritra's voice sounded. They all looked back and he stepped out of the portal.
After a moment of silence, Jack clutched his shoulder and began to scream in agony, blood spurting out wildly.
"Hmm, hi Jack, I didn't expect to meet you in the marriage." Vritra smiled as he paused beside his three wives.
"Ughhh W- Who the hell are you? And Fiona, he isn't even Vritra, why are you with him? Wasn't Vritra alive?" Jack at least hoped to get revenge on this new guy using Vritra.
"Haa, how stupid, look who can't take a guess." Vritra shook his head and after a moment his appearance changed back to the past one before returning to normal.
"I am Vritra." He announced.
"W- What? It can't be, you must be pretending to be him. He was clearly dead." Jack's hand was already healing, he looked towards Fiona, only she could save him now.
"Well, whatever you think, it doesn't matter. Anyway, Fiona is my wife." Vritra pulled her closer, giving a soft kiss on her tender red lips.
"Nooo, get away from her, Fiona, he is clearly fooling you!! You have to believe me, don't tell me he is pretending to be me. Fiona, I am the real Jack."
Jack screamed in desperation, watching his long time crush and love getting kissed by another guy.
"Ha, go to hell. There will only be one man in my heart, and that's my darling. Stop your delusions, I have never liked you and had firmly rejected all your proposals."
Fiona said in annoyance, kissing Vritra's lips just to prove her point.
"Goddess, y- you can see everything clearly, right? He is the hatefu-" Jack was just shouting when Vritra suddenly pulled Diana closer and kissed her lips too.
"She is my wife too, heh." Vritra then gave the signal.
And instantly, Maeve, Yasmine, and Teresa entered, stopping beside him.
"All of these wonderful and gorgeous women are my wives." Vritra looked at Jack, the other guy was really about to go mad.
'Well, that's about enough mental trauma for coveting my wives.'
After a few more moments, Maeve and the others left, leaving the two alone.
"J- Just let me live, what do you want? Y- You can have Fiona and the others, just don't kill me." Jack begged. As long as he survives, he could certainly get stronger.
And then, he would kill Vritra and-
But his thoughts were interrupted.
"Well, don't worry, I won't kill you. I am just going to do a little fishing here." As he spoke, Vritra took out a fishing rod.
Then he tossed the hook towards the confused Jack. The hook was instantly sucked into the space right above his head.
There were countless tiny threads connected to him and Vritra just had to steal one.
Although it was his first time trying this, he was able to quickly find the right thread.
His title Husband of the Fate Reaver was the reason why he could see those fate threads and why he wasn't affected by Teresa's ability.
"Alright, I caught it." Vritra pulled the string back hurriedly as the thread was torn forcefully.
"Aaaaaaah" Jack screamed, feeling as if his head itself was being torn.
Vritra pulled it with sudden force and finally got the fate of the hero. The moment he touched it, it automatically merged with him.
And Jack felt as if suddenly he had lost something very, very important.
"What have you done?!! S- Something is missing!!" he screamed.
Vritra didn't really care, he threw a tiny pin made of dust which instantly destroyed Jack's mana core.
He grimaced in even more pain as blood poured out of the wound, his eyes, nose, and mouth.
Vritra touched a drop of blood, and...
[Blood lock activated.]
"As I promised, I am going to let you go. So, just enjoy your life from now on."
Before Jack could mutter any nonsense, Vritra just threw him out into the real world.
He hadn't even closed the portal when suddenly another portal opened on the other side of Jack, surprising Vritra.
And in the next moment, dozens of tentacles rushed out.
"You damned Baldy, I am going to fuck you to death, how dare you leave me here and turn me into a noble sacrifice!!" Suddenly the monstrous voice of Shorty sounded from inside.
Then Shorty, who seemed to have mutated, became visible.
Jack was pulled inside instantly as his screams rang out.
After seeing this scene, Vritra just shook his head and greatly slowed down the power of Blood Lock.
Now that he had lost his hero halo, karma struck immediately.
"Haa, another thing has been taken care of. Now only one thing remains." He mumbled and disappeared from the realm.
Yennefer had only killed around a quarter of the demons yet, she was really torturing them to death.
Vritra didn't really mind, but he called them all closer, so Yennefer paused momentarily and flew near him.
"Well, after Yennefer is done, we will be going to a special place. So be prepared, my wifeys, something special awaits you." He said, rubbing his palms together, creating suspense.

chapters.title: Chapter 620 Happy Married Life (FINAL!!)
paragraphs: From Fiona to Vanessa, all seven of the ladies floated side by side as they all stared at the beautiful floating castle in front of them.
It was decorated so lavishly, it made the women's eyes sparkle.
Before long, a gust of wind pushed them inside, and none of them resisted it.
Before they could see anything, all of them found themselves standing in separate rooms, and in front of each was a beautiful dress floating.
Seeing the dresses, all of them had already guessed the surprise Vritra had planned for them.
Each of the dresses was selected by him personally, each different from the other and extremely beautiful.
Without wasting any time, they all began to change.
Vritra got dressed as well, his outfit somehow matching all of his wives'.
After he was dressed, he walked up to the altar, where a priest was standing.
"How do I look?" Vritra asked, looking at Shitless, Onest, and Rich.
Rich was still speechless. He was confused at first, but Teresa's husband had really made him prepare for this grand wedding.
Where he was going to marry other women.
Rich didn't know how to react to this or if Teresa would be fine with this.
"Pitiful one, you look awesome. Even slightly better than me, hehe, but why did you call this priest here? Did you forget I can do all that too?" Monk Shitless asked.
"I can't make you overwork, we will be needing your help a lot once we enter the game, right?" Vritra said, and Shitless nodded proudly.
"Um, A- Art, about my aunt..." Rich spoke, wondering how to say it.
"Don't worry, it's fine." He said, not explaining any further.
After a moment, all their gazes drifted forward as the seven women, each dressed beautifully, walked towards the altar.
The chairs for guests were filled with the soul wraiths and the guards from their house of darkness.
They all clapped hurriedly as the seven brides approached the altar, each of them had a big smile on their faces.
They were finally getting such a grand wedding ceremony.
Vanessa looked at Vritra. She was marrying her son. The time of doubt had long passed, she was quite excited.
They were tied for life anyway.
Shitless, Rich, and Onest took their seats, the ceremony was about to start.
'Finally, I am marrying my hubby properly.' Yasmine felt overjoyed, she couldn't stop herself from smiling, gazing up at her husband.
He looked perfect, so wonderful, making her want to just jump up and kiss him.
All his wives had their own thoughts, each very happy.
Although Teresa had already gone through a marriage ceremony with Vritra, it wasn't proper with all the drama.
And he didn't want to leave her out, so while he was at it, Vritra was marrying all seven of them.
"Wifey, are you willing to marry me?" Vritra stepped forward, helping Yasmine climb up the altar.
Then he held a ring, with no special ability, but just a beautiful diamond ring with a red colour.
Looking into her eyes, he proposed directly. Kneeling and all that had no meaning and felt too cringe.
"Yes hubby!" Yasmine laughed as she extended her hand and Vritra put on the ring. She hugged him and walked to one side and stepped onto a wooden board.
"Mom, will you marry me?" he asked, taking a different ring with a pink diamond.
"Yes, honey, I do." Vanessa said, as Vritra put on the ring. She too hugged him tightly before moving to the wooden board beside Yasmine.
"Fiona, are you willing to be my wife?" Vritra asked, a new ring appearing in his hand.
It seemed as if a flame was constantly burning inside the diamond.
"Darling, I want to!" Fiona jumped into his arms, then got the ring on her finger.
She too moved towards the wooden board, stepping on it excitedly.
"Diana, are you willing to be mine?" Vritra asked as he looked softly at the goddess. The new ring appeared colourless, but very beautiful with intricate patterns inside.
"Yes dear, I want to be your wife!" Diana exclaimed happily, as the ring slid perfectly onto her finger.
After a tight hug, she went to stand beside the others.
"Yenni, are you ready to give yourself to me for eternity?" he asked, extending his hand where a ring with a blue diamond waited.
"Yes yes, husband, I am already yours!" Yennefer spoke, a beautiful smile blossoming on her face.
After Vritra put on the ring, she pulled him into a tight embrace.
"Wait, I have something else for you." He said, as the empress turned to look at him.
As his fingers uncurled, a familiar bracelet appeared and Yennefer became teary eyed.
"How did you find this?"
Vritra put it around her wrist and kissed her forehead, he was wearing the matching bracelet.
These bracelets held a special meaning to her, they previously belonged to her parents.
As she accepted Vritra as her husband, she gave it to Vritra.
"I just found it." He said, patting her head.
"Thank you husband, I love you..." while hugging him, she took a deep breath, calming herself.
This was a happy event and she didn't want past memories to spoil it, she had already annihilated all the demons anyway.
After a few moments, she too stood on the wooden board.
If going in this manner, then it was Maeve's turn, so the demoness was ready to step up.
Her fluffy tail moving left to right in excitement, she looked incredibly beautiful in her wedding gown.
"Tess, without any pressure or arrangements, are you still willing to be a part of my life?" he asked, holding a ring.
The diamond shone with several colours, just like the new colours filling Teresa's life.
She looked at the ring, and then back at Vritra, feeling emotional and happy.
"Yes yes, I want to be yours forever." She said, as tears rolled down her rosy cheeks.
Vritra first put the ring on her finger, then gently wiped the tears, lovingly caressing her cheek.
"I don't like tears in your eyes, just smile, you look even more beautiful that way." He mumbled, hugging her soft body.
"Mhmm" she nodded. After staying in his arms for a few more moments, she walked towards the others.
"Hmm, did I forget something? Looks like we are done here-" Vritra said as he looked around.
While the stunned demoness stood in front of him.
"M- Master, me?" Maeve felt sad instantly, was he not going to marry her?
Vritra chuckled as he saw her reaction. Taking her soft hand, he gently pulled her onto the altar.
"Haha, how can I forget my cute and naughty foxie?"
Maeve was pulled into a tight hug, her body finally relaxing in his arms. She pouted, her heart almost shattered because of his joke.
"Sorry, will you forgive me?" he asked, stepping back and lightly pinching her puffed up cheeks.
"Master, I-" she was speaking but Vritra pressed a finger against her lips.
"Shh, tell me, do you accept me as your husband?" he asked.
Maeve smiled happily and nodded her head.
"Yes!"
"Okay, I got your forgiveness, now what about my second question?" Vritra said and chuckled seeing her surprised look.
He decided not to tease this beautiful demoness anymore.
"Yes master, I want you to be present in every moment of my life!" Maeve said joyfully, hugging him tighter.
She didn't really mind her master husband's teasing.
Vritra took out another diamond ring, the diamond shining with a dark light.
Maeve extended her hand as he slipped the ring onto her finger.
Then she too walked towards the others.
Vritra gazed at his beautiful wives, taking a deep breath, feeling quite happy and lucky.
The guests all clapped and cheered as beautiful fireworks started in the sky, announcing the start of the marriage.
Vritra stood in front of the seven women as the priest began the ceremony.
He was too surprised to see Vritra marry so many women, and praised the young guy in his heart for such wonderful taste in women.
The ceremony proceeded as they took their vows.
"Yasmine, Vanessa, Fiona, Diana, Yennefer, Maeve, and Teresa, are you willing to take Vritra Arclis as your husband?" the priest asked.
"Yes!" all of them said almost instantly.
"Vritra Arclis, do you take them as your wives?" the priest asked.
"Yes!" Vritra said, just as excited as all his wives.
"You are now married, you may kiss the brides!" the priest said, smiling.
Vritra moved and paused before Yasmine, the two looked into each other's eyes.
The sky was already lit with fireworks, even more magnificent than before.
Then leaning forward, their lips pressed in a soft kiss that lasted a few moments before parting.
After which he moved towards Vanessa, kissing his mother gently.
Then Fiona, Diana, Yennefer, Maeve, and Teresa.
He kissed all his wives one by one, finally completing the marriage.
The hearts of all of them were filled with happiness, getting married like this felt so special.
None of them could ever forget this day, the melodious laughter of all seven women sounded like music.
It was like a new start to all their lives, and they were all excited.
"Well, let's start the feast!" Vritra announced as dozens upon dozens of dishes began to magically float in the sky.
Vritra led his wives towards a table set up specially for them, while talking and laughing, they ate.
Although the guests were just those emotionless guards, it still did not lessen the fun.
After eating, Vritra stood up and gestured: "My gorgeous wives, now allow me to give you another small surprise!"
"What else have you planned, master?" Maeve asked, even she didn't know anything.
"You will know soon." He said. With a snap of his fingers, a vehicle decorated beautifully appeared before them.
"My ladies, please get inside." He said, and right away they headed away from the castle.
Only Shitless, Rich, and Onest were left there to enjoy.
The car flew and soon arrived in front of their house.
"Whoa, dear, when did you decorate the house?" Diana looked out of the window and questioned.
"This was the surprise? It looks beautiful, honey!" Vanessa said, leaning in and kissing Vritra.
"No no, the surprise is inside, let's go." Vritra said as they got out of the car and headed inside.
The women were really surprised as they walked in deeper, it was like the whole house had been renovated.
Now matching the vibe of the house of newlyweds, their photos were placed on the walls, even the photos from the wedding just now.
All the women looked at Vritra in confusion and surprise, but they very much loved everything.
They soon arrived in their bedroom, once again shocked at the arrangement.
Vritra had put in so much work, focusing on every little detail and decorating it lavishly.
Their hearts were filled with warmth and happiness, the newlywed feeling becoming stronger.
"This, here, is your surprise!" Vritra said as he slid the curtain present around the bed.
Instantly, several sexy and gorgeous lingerie sets were revealed, each was so erotic.
"Welcome to a new wonderful married life!!"

"Sorry, will you forgive me?" he asked, stepping back and lightly pinching her puffed up cheeks.
"Master, I-" she was speaking but Vritra pressed a finger against her lips.
"Shh, tell me, do you accept me as your husband?" he asked.
Maeve smiled happily and nodded her head.
"Yes!"
"Okay, I got your forgiveness, now what about my second question?" Vritra said and chuckled seeing her surprised look.
He decided not to tease this beautiful demoness anymore.
"Yes master, I want you to be present in every moment of my life!" Maeve said joyfully, hugging him tighter.
She didn't really mind her master husband's teasing.
Vritra took out another diamond ring, the diamond shining with a dark light.
Maeve extended her hand as he slipped the ring onto her finger.
Then she too walked towards the others.
Vritra gazed at his beautiful wives, taking a deep breath, feeling quite happy and lucky.
The guests all clapped and cheered as beautiful fireworks started in the sky, announcing the start of the marriage.
Vritra stood in front of the seven women as the priest began the ceremony.
He was too surprised to see Vritra marry so many women, and praised the young guy in his heart for such wonderful taste in women.
The ceremony proceeded as they took their vows.
"Yasmine, Vanessa, Fiona, Diana, Yennefer, Maeve, and Teresa, are you willing to take Vritra Arclis as your husband?" the priest asked.
"Yes!" all of them said almost instantly.
"Vritra Arclis, do you take them as your wives?" the priest asked.
"Yes!" Vritra said, just as excited as all his wives.
"You are now married, you may kiss the brides!" the priest said, smiling.
Vritra moved and paused before Yasmine, the two looked into each other's eyes.
The sky was already lit with fireworks, even more magnificent than before.
Then leaning forward, their lips pressed in a soft kiss that lasted a few moments before parting.
After which he moved towards Vanessa, kissing his mother gently.
Then Fiona, Diana, Yennefer, Maeve, and Teresa.
He kissed all his wives one by one, finally completing the marriage.
The hearts of all of them were filled with happiness, getting married like this felt so special.
None of them could ever forget this day, the melodious laughter of all seven women sounded like music.
It was like a new start to all their lives, and they were all excited.
"Well, let's start the feast!" Vritra announced as dozens upon dozens of dishes began to magically float in the sky.
Vritra led his wives towards a table set up specially for them, while talking and laughing, they ate.
Although the guests were just those emotionless guards, it still did not lessen the fun.
After eating, Vritra stood up and gestured: "My gorgeous wives, now allow me to give you another small surprise!"
"What else have you planned, master?" Maeve asked, even she didn't know anything.
"You will know soon." He said.
With a snap of his fingers, a vehicle decorated beautifully appeared before them.
"My ladies, please get inside." He said, and right away they headed away from the castle.
Only Shitless, Rich, and Onest were left there to enjoy.
The car flew and soon arrived in front of their house.
"Whoa, dear, when did you decorate the house?" Diana looked out of the window and questioned.
"This was the surprise?
It looks beautiful, honey!" Vanessa said, leaning in and kissing Vritra.
"No no, the surprise is inside, let's go." Vritra said as they got out of the car and headed inside.
The women were really surprised as they walked in deeper, it was like the whole house had been renovated.
Now matching the vibe of the house of newlyweds, their photos were placed on the walls, even the photos from the wedding just now.
All the women looked at Vritra in confusion and surprise, but they very much loved everything.
They soon arrived in their bedroom, once again shocked at the arrangement.
Vritra had put in so much work, focusing on every little detail and decorating it lavishly.
Their hearts were filled with warmth and happiness, the newlywed feeling becoming stronger.
"This, here, is your surprise!" Vritra said as he slid the curtain present around the bed.
Instantly, several sexy and gorgeous lingerie sets were revealed, each was so erotic.
"Welcome to a new wonderful married life!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 621 The Game Begin!!
paragraphs: The day had finally come!!
It was time to leave the Zoratian planet and enter the third game the planet Argento was present in.
Vritra and his wives didn't have too much time after their marriage, the more they delayed, the higher the difficulty would be.
All of them got dressed and ate until they could no more, then Vritra led his wives into the hall.
The seven women stood before him, and soon Shitless and Onest, the two cannon fodders, arrived.
"Alright, are you all ready to leave?" Vritra asked, gazing at their faces. All his wives nodded with determined expressions.
"U- Uhm pitiful one, do we still have a choi-" the monk raised his hand and asked.
"No, anyway, there are a few things that we need to know before going there." After speaking, Vritra asked Divine to start speaking and share his thoughts with the others.
"The planet you will be heading into is very similar to your Earth. Well, in a way, Earth too is a future game location anyway.

Your strength and abilities will be locked there, unless there is absolutely no other choice, do not reveal your strength. Otherwise, not only will you be thrown back here and lose, but you will even receive penalties in the future." Divine spoke in a serious tone.
Then he added: "Also try not to die. If any of you die, then there is no chance of bringing that person back.
Their soul will immediately be consumed by the game itself."
"As I mentioned before, you have to kill the participants from Argento Planet and reach the tower. Anyway, be careful there, don't trust anyone, be as brutal as possible.
The mutant monsters might not be the only danger there." Divine warned.
"Is that all?" Vritra asked, taking the game very seriously.
"Yeah, for now. I will explain things further once you are there." Divine said.
All of them understood that after the game starts, their strength would be reset to ordinary.
The group discussed a few things among themselves, even Divine couldn't share every little detail now.
"Alright, we are ready!" Vritra said. They couldn't even bring the items in their inventory or carry anything.
"Soon you will be sent into the game. Try your best to survive, it will be very difficult, but your growth will still be fast."
Just as Divine finished speaking, the area around the ten of them began to shake, the world became blurry.
Their bodies started to glow and break apart into tiny particles as they slowly disappeared from the Zoratian planet.
Inside an apartment, the place seemed ransacked, with broken glass and items thrown all over the place.
It seemed to have been ransacked not too long ago, and ten corpses lay on the ground, a pool of blood forming in the hall.
The blood was still warm.
Suddenly, the bodies started to glow and within moments they disintegrated along with the blood.
And ten figures replaced them, the group looking around in confusion.
Right after arriving, Vritra quickly noticed the changes in his body.
Their appearances had not changed, but their strength and abilities had completely disappeared.
'I feel so weak, I have really become a completely normal human.' Vritra shook his head, this made him feel more anxious.
"This place... it has been turned upside down, looks like someone looted it." Yasmine observed the surroundings, sharing her thoughts.
"Onest, lock the door first. We need to understand the situation here first. Since it's already looted, I doubt those people will come here again." Vritra said.
"Haa this place sure is cold." Fiona rubbed her palms together, shivering slightly.
"Hmm it's still snowing outside." Diana looked towards the window and noticed the thick layer of snow covering everything.
If he didn't know better, he would have really believed he was back on Earth.
There were electronics such as a TV, refrigerator, and more, everything seemed so familiar.
Vritra noticed they were somewhere around the twelfth floor.
He checked his inventory and there was nothing, then he spoke: "Let's first search this place to find any weapo-"
While speaking, his gaze shifted towards the window on his side and goosebumps rose all over his body, his heart almost stopping for a moment.
Hurriedly, he pulled Yasmine and Maeve, who were standing beside him, behind the wall and gestured for everyone to stay silent.
The others quieted down and stuck close to the wall, they also faintly sensed something just now.
They were at the twelfth floor, and just now, right outside, he saw an eye as big as himself, looking into the apartment.
A terrifying bloodlust permeated from that grotesque eye, all ten of them could be killed instantly.
THUMP THUMP
The sound of the large monster walking away echoed.
He waited for a bit longer then peeked out, the twisted and broken mutated creature had really gone away.
The outside was filled with snow.
"Hoo what the hell was that? Things have already mutated to this extent here?" Vritra wiped the sweat from his forehead.
Maybe because he was just an ordinary person now, his reactions too had changed greatly.
Previously, he wouldn't have been so afraid, but now, seeing that terrifying mutant almost made him freeze.
"Haa anyway, let's check this place for any sort of weapons we can find and clothes too, we will have to soon move out of this building."
Vritra said as they all got busy searching around silently.
And after a few minutes, they gathered back in the hall.
"I found this steel pipe, it's broken on one side and looks quite sharp." Onest said, swinging the meter-long pipe around.
The feeling of powerlessness made them all feel uncomfortable.
"I found a broken knife."
All of them had found something, but of course these weapons wouldn't be of much help.
"These will work for now. Oh wait, how do we actually grow strong here?" Vritra asked, he had forgotten such an important question.
He was holding a metal baseball bat.
"By killing the mutant creatures. As you kill some, you will awaken different abilities. Your mutant progress will continue to increase." Divine answered instantly.
Vritra felt a bit better that Divine had not disappeared again, and the leveling didn't seem different from before.
"Alright, it's time to head outside and check it out. We also need to find food and warm clothes, this place is really cold." Even he felt the cold creep into his bones.
Vritra walked up to the door and opened it as quietly as possible.
Then he peeked across the hallway, his first plan was to search other apartments.
In his corridor, there were exactly four houses, two on each side.
And two of them had their doors open as well, probably already looted, just like the one they were present in.
The hallway had bloody footsteps printed, going in and out of three of the apartments.
Only the fourth apartment didn't have footsteps of anyone leaving.
But then his gaze focused on a figure at the end of the hallway.
A height over eight feet and grotesquely growing muscles, even upon seeing it from behind, Vritra knew it was a mutant zombie.
It just stood there, facing the wall, its body covered in wounds and blood.
"Damn, just our luck. It seems pretty strong." Vritra thought and then remembered the status.
Closing the door shut, he called out in his head.
'Status?'

chapters.title: Chapter 622 Upgrade?
paragraphs: [Name]: Vritra Arclis
[Species]: Human
[Mutation Progress]: 0/100 (Unawakened)
[Stats]
(Strength: 1.1)
(Agility: 1.2)
(Endurance: 1.2)
(Spiritual: 1.2)
{Note: 1 stat is average.}
To Vritra's surprise, the status panel actually popped up. He read it over and was surprised.
'Human? The people here are humans too wait, I have become one too? Anyway, I need to increase my stats it seems.' He thought and spoke.
"Check your status panels."
They had all forgotten about it too. Vritra again peeked out and wondered if he could see the stats of the mutant too.
[Stats]
(Strength: 7.7)
(Agility: 5.0)
(Endurance: 7.8)
(Spiritual: 1.0)
"That mutant is almost eight times stronger and tougher, and it's faster too. Killing it will be impossible." Vritra deduced.
He was yet to form a general idea of strength difference based on stats.
But without any ability, killing that would be near impossible.
Then his gaze moved to the only closed door among the other three apartments, and Divine's words reverberated in his mind.
'Be as brutal as possible, and mutants aren't the only danger.'
Looking over the floor and the bloody footprints, it was clear that the people inside had killed and looted.
So any hesitation instantly disappeared from his heart.
Vritra took Vanessa's weapon, which was a broken iron rod.
"Honey, what are you planning?" Vanessa asked in worry. For now, they could do nothing.
Their stats were mostly even lower than 1.
"Just trying something." Vritra held the baseball bat and rod in one hand and picked up a leg of the broken table.
Then he opened the door again.
After glancing around and making sure no one else was in the dim hallway, he threw the wooden leg in the opposite direction of the mutant.
Then he hurriedly closed the door.
Vritra waited and heard no further sound. It seemed that mutant wasn't attracted by noise.
Releasing a long nervous breath, he opened the door and slowly walked towards the locked door in front.
Inside the other apartment, four burly men with several cuts over their bodies sat on the ground, enjoying rice.
"Damn Lukas, you shouldn't have killed her right away, we could have had our fun." The man with a bandana on his head spoke. It had been so long since they ate rice.
"That old woman? Seriously?"
Lukas, a man who seemed the youngest, spoke in disgust.
"Oh come on, beggars can't be choosers. How long has it been since we found a woman. Damn, we were lucky to find rice and survivors in this place."
Another person added, sighing in disappointment.
"That isn't important, we have to leave without attracting that smiling motherfucker. That's one scary mutant."
The fourth man added, shivering as he remembered seeing it.
Thankfully that mutant couldn't hear, or they would have been dead by now.
"Let's finish quickly and leave, I will use my stealth skill to hide our pres"
Just as Lukas was speaking, they heard the sound of some object falling on the other side of the hallway.
"What was that?" the bandana man frowned and suddenly
KNOCK KNOCK
There were urgent knocks on the door, then sounded a pleading tone.
"P- Please help me, I am begging you, open the door, that monster SOB is going to kill me..." it was the sound of a young woman crying.
The four men were all alerted and they looked at each other with lust evident in their eyes.
"I am going to take her first, you can have her later!" the oldest among the group suddenly stood up.
But the bandana man, with his mutant ability that increased his physical strength, bringing his stat to 5, easily pushed him back.
"No way, I will be the first. You will have to wait for your turns hehe just know I won't be done in a few hours."
The bandana man smiled as the cuts on his face stretched.
"Haa the woman will barely be alive after you are done, you are too strong." The fourth guy shook his head.
But none of them could defeat him in a fight, so they could do nothing.
The bandana man chuckled lightly and approached the door, but before opening it, he decided to check just in case.
There are all sorts of mutants after all.
Closing one eye, he peeked out of the peephole but then frowned upon seeing only a bald guy near the opposite door.
He tried to look around and saw no woman.
Right at this moment, Vritra who was hiding beside the door, plunged the metallic rod into the peephole.
BANG
SWISH
The rod pierced through the bandana man's eye as he screamed in agony instantly, but unfortunately Vritra failed to kill him as he moved back quickly.
"What's wrong?" Lukas and the other three jumped to their feet and were shocked to see the ugly state of his face.
One eye was completely gone.
"Ughh FUCK!! Those bastards, they are trying to ambush us!!" the bandana man screamed and roared, intense killing intent filling his heart.
The group of four forgot everything as intense feelings of revenge filled their hearts. Who would dare attack them.
Since Vritra was also outside, they neglected any danger and all rushed forward to attack, opening the door.
While Vritra turned at full speed, running towards the opposite apartment, but before entering, he threw one wooden leg towards the mutant.
BANG
The wooden leg hit the mutant right across the head as it flinched and growled.
Vritra had already locked the door by the time the mutant had turned around. He put heavy materials in front of the door.
As they all moved back.
While right at that moment, the opposite door opened and the four rushed out, ready to butcher the ambushers.
"S- Something is wrong, I- I can sense something..." the oldest guy suddenly felt a headache, his ability which could sense danger instantly working.
GRAAARRRR!!
Lukas, the bandana man, and the other two paused right outside the door as they heard the terrifying roar, their bodies turning stiff.
"F- Fuck we were tricked!!"
They finally realised, but it was too late. They tried entering their house, but the mutant easily tore away the door.
Breathing heavily and his heart pumping, Vritra heard the sound of the monster and bodies getting blasted and torn.
The terrified screams of the four men only lasted for a few moments, and once again things became normal.
Then the repulsive sound of the mutant eating the humans sounded.
And soon after, the mutant walked away after feasting on the four corpses, leaving behind a heavy stench of blood and flesh.
Vritra waited a bit longer and relaxed a little.
"Haa it's gone to the lower floors now." He said in a low voice.
All his wives had grim expressions. How were they supposed to face such things when everyone was already so ahead in evolution?
"Just wait here, we will go check that place out. There shouldn't be any more danger.
But the scent of blood might attract some mutants soon." Vritra said as he walked out, followed by Shitless and Onest.
As soon as they entered the other apartment, their expressions became appalled.
The four corpses lay twisted and broken, the internal organs spread all over the place.
"...Hurry, search the place." He said, before moving towards one of the more intact corpses.
He knelt down to inspect the corpse and see if the owner was carrying anything useful.
But the moment his hand touched the corpse, messages upon messages popped before his eyes.
[A mutant corpse has been detected!]
[You have acquired the Divine Sin Wheel!]
[Divine Sin Wheel is undergoing an upgrade...]

The terrified screams of the four men only lasted for a few moments, and once again things became normal.
Then the repulsive sound of the mutant eating the humans sounded.
And soon after, the mutant walked away after feasting on the four corpses, leaving behind a heavy stench of blood and flesh.
Vritra waited a bit longer and relaxed a little.
"Haa it's gone to the lower floors now." He said in a low voice.
All his wives had grim expressions.
How were they supposed to face such things when everyone was already so ahead in evolution?
"Just wait here, we will go check that place out.
There shouldn't be any more danger.
But the scent of blood might attract some mutants soon." Vritra said as he walked out, followed by Shitless and Onest.
As soon as they entered the other apartment, their expressions became appalled.
The four corpses lay twisted and broken, the internal organs spread all over the place.
"...Hurry, search the place." He said, before moving towards one of the more intact corpses.
He knelt down to inspect the corpse and see if the owner was carrying anything useful.
But the moment his hand touched the corpse, messages upon messages popped before his eyes.
[A mutant corpse has been detected!]
[You have acquired the Divine Sin Wheel!]
[Divine Sin Wheel is undergoing an upgrade...]

chapters.title: Chapter 623 Shadow
paragraphs: [A mutant corpse has been detected!]
[You have acquired the Divine Sin Wheel!]
[Divine Sin Wheel is undergoing an upgrade...]
All of a sudden, several messages popped before Vritra, freezing him momentarily.
He halted his search and waited.
[Divine Sin Wheel has been upgraded!!]
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a Corpse +24}
'It seems the Sin Wheel has really changed, I haven't received any notifications from others' reactions either.' Vritra noticed this only now, since normally he ignored those messages.
He wondered how the gacha part would have changed.
Then he glanced at the three broken corpses. Without wasting any time, Vritra touched whatever remained of their bodies.
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a Corpse +21}
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a Corpse +20}
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a Corpse +21}
{Sin Points: 86}
"And how many do I need to rotate the wheel... can I still purchase the attributes?" he wondered.
"You can rotate the wheel with different numbers of sin points like 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, 1000 and so on. Of course, the more points you use, the better the rewards.
Oh right, try asking it something, and you will even receive the answer." Divine said, actively helping him.
"Hmm, how many sin points do I need to purchase the attributes?" Vritra asked.
{0.5 random attribute point = 1,000 Sin Points}
"So two thousand sin points for 1 attribute point? Damn, that's expensive. Divine, can't you lower it?" Now that he could directly speak to the manufacturer, Vritra showed his displeasure.
"It is not as simple as you think. If I could, I would rather just give you everything directly. There are many things to take into consideration.
But if your luck is good, you can still obtain them with less sin points through the gacha." He replied helplessly.
Vritra just shook his head. As he focused, an ethereal wheel appeared before him.
Although he couldn't see what prize he would get, it seemed there was no longer a better luck next time.
Even in the worst case scenario, he would still get something.
After thinking for a moment, he spoke: "Draw prize for 20 sin points."
{Used 20 Sin Points.}
The wheel spun quickly and soon it stopped at an item.
{Congratulations, you have obtained 10 bottles of energy drinks!}
"Energy drinks?!" He was surprised. So he could obtain food this way. This was not bad.
"Wait, I still have my inventory?" The drinks had directly been teleported into the inventory.
This was good.
"Draw 50 sin points reward." Vritra made up his mind and said it. He wanted to try it out.
{Congratulations, you have acquired 1 Agility attribute point!}
Instantly a warmth filled Vritra's body, and the change was noticeable.
His agility, reaction speed and more had suddenly increased to twice.
"Nice, that's worth 2000 points." Vritra tried moving his hands around, and he could feel the difference.
"Pitiful one, we couldn't find much in this place. There was only some leftover food. Also these few knives and machetes." Shitless and Onest showed the weapons they found.
"Hmm, bring them back to the other apartment. I will be there in a moment." Vritra spoke.
"Alright, it seems finding food here will be difficult." Onest sighed. Although they had eaten enough in advance, soon they would start to feel hungry again.
After the two left, Vritra mumbled: "Draw 10 sin points reward."
The wheel spun and...
{Congratulations, you have obtained 10 bottles of water!}
{Sin Points: 6}
'I guess I need to earn more sin points, just touching corpses will be enough.' He thought, before walking towards the window and glancing outside.
The whole place was covered by a thick layer of white, and snow was falling heavily.
They were on the twelfth floor and there were a couple more floors above them.
He could see quite a few mutants outside, many even frozen in the snow.
But the distant sight shocked Vritra.
"So that's the tower I am supposed to reach in two and a half years?"
It wasn't very clear, but it seemed very tall, disappearing up into the sky, and it was huge!
BANG
Just then, he heard a noise from the other apartment. Frowning, he turned and ran back.
They had locked the door, so he knocked after looking for any sign of mutants.
After a few moments, the door opened. As Vritra rushed inside, he saw Maeve standing in front of a cockroach.
It was actually the size of a football. Blood dripped from the rod in Maeve's hand as she panted lightly.
She had just smashed the head of the large mutant insect, but its wings were still shivering.
BANG BANG
Maeve struck it a couple more times and it finally died.
Only then did she relax.
"Where did it come from?" Vritra walked closer.
"It suddenly, haa haa, drilled a hole from the top and jumped down." Maeve said. It really scared her for a moment.
Maeve suddenly felt warmth spread across her body, and different messages flashed before her.
"I, it seems I have awakened!" The demoness exclaimed. Her stats had increased by 0.2 each.
"Oh, did you awaken some ability?" Vritra asked, as he squatted and touched the dead cockroach.
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a Corpse +19}
"Yes, it seems to be related to shadows." Maeve said. Not much information was given.
"That's good, you did well, foxie." Vritra stood up and patted her head after wiping his hands.
He looked up at the hole and was sure there must be more mutant cockroaches above.
"Looks like we are going to have to clear this building and increase our strength before leaving this place." Vritra mumbled.
"But that ugly monster should still be outside. We are still no match for it." Fiona spoke.
"Well, we have our baits, right, Shitless and Onest?" Vritra said, patting the monk's shoulder.
"Yes, huh wait..." Onest realized who the bait in question was.
Vritra laughed seeing their reaction, then he added: "I will be going out to check the other apartments on this floor first."
"Be careful, dear." Diana said, knowing they couldn't be of help to him.
"Hmm, just wait here." Vritra said as he stepped towards the door.
"Wait master, can I come along?" Maeve, who was trying out her ability, suddenly spoke, then added: "I can hide us, like this."
In the next moment, her entire body was covered by a dark shadow, and as she moved into a darker corner, she really wasn't visible.
"Alright, but be careful." Vritra said seriously.
And then the two headed out. The corridor was still clear.
They quickly moved towards the third house and searched it.
"Seven corpses!!" Vritra was surprised to see the corpses of an entire family.
He sighed before quickly collecting the sin points.
There wasn't really anything else in the house. They were all probably killed by those four men.
{Sin Points: 147}
Then they headed to the other apartment, but there were no corpses.
After walking out, Vritra glanced up, weighing his options.
Going up would be dangerous, but they couldn't stay cooped up here.
If his stats could increase and everyone awakened, then their progress would be much faster.
"Foxie, we are going up. Stay close and ready." Vritra said as he slowly approached the stairs.
His increased agility wouldn't be of much use against those monsters.
They climbed up as silently as possible, but then the two froze.
The corridor had at least ten zombies roaming around.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 The Nest
paragraphs: The corridor was flooded with more than ten mutated zombies, all of them looking grotesque.
Vritra checked their strength and even the weakest had most attributes over 3.
Only the spiritual attribute was low for them all.
"We will be moving slowly, if things go wrong then run inside that apartment and hide." Vritra said, tightly gripping the handle of a blade.
The zombies weren't attacking each other for some reason.
Maeve nodded, covering herself and Vritra with shadows as their figures became harder to see in the dimness.
It was time to go stealth mode, he picked a torn shoe from the ground and silently approached.
The zombies really didn't notice them, but he stopped at a distance of 3 meters, fearing that they might smell the two.
Then he threw the shoe towards the other end of the corridor.
THUD
It created a loud noise as the zombies were alerted, they turned and ran in that direction.
Vritra took several long strides and, with all his might, stabbed the knife at the closest zombie's head.
SWISH
The sharp blade cut through the skin, but seemed to have gotten stuck midway into the skull.
'Tch...' Reacting quickly, he punched the knife's back several times as the zombie let out a strange noise before going limp.
It all happened so suddenly the zombie had no time to react.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +53}
[You have slain a mutant creature.]
Instantly a warmth flowed through his body, for a moment making his mind dizzy.
[You have awakened.]
[All stats have increased by 0.5.]
[Stats]
(Strength: 1.6)
(Agility: 2.7)
(Endurance: 1.7)
(Spiritual: 1.7)
{Sin Points: 200}
Vritra felt the jump in his strength, his muscles became a little more refined.
And a cool sensation filled his mind, making him feel relaxed and heightening his senses.
He was curious about the skill he had received but staying out in the open could be dangerous.
Vritra grabbed Maeve's hand and pulled her towards one of the apartments.
The door was slightly ajar, he pushed it open and glanced inside, then the two walked inside slowly.
"Master, it seems no one is here." Only after making sure did Maeve pull back the shadows.
She was getting used to her skill, though it was still too weak.
"We should be above the house beside the one everyone is present in." Vritra mumbled before looking at his status panel.
[Skills]:
[Evomorph]: Based on the situation and your needs, your body could evolve in various ways.
[Blood Manipulation]: The ability to control blood.
"Dual abilities?" Vritra smiled faintly, the first one was similar to Mutamorphis but seemed like an upgraded version.
While the second one was completely new, and seemed quite powerful.
Even his mutation bar had increased to 0.5, which also seemed to represent the amount of energy he could use.
"Master, there is nothing in this house, it has already been looted." Maeve had roughly gone through the entire house again, but found nothing.
"Here, have some water." Vritra pulled out a water bottle and handed it to Maeve.
"Thank you master." Maeve smiled sweetly before taking the bottle and drinking some water.
"Wait, where did you get the water from? You still have inventory?" the demoness paused suddenly and asked.
"I will explain it later, let's check the next apartment." He spoke, he could barely hear faint noises from the other apartment.
Opening the door, he glanced out and saw zombies on the corner of the corridor.
"Let's go, master~" Maeve said as she enveloped herself and Vritra with the shadows, she was starting to feel tired now.
They silently moved to the next apartment, thankfully the door wasn't locked.
They swiftly entered and saw a nest of cockroaches, this place was really their home.
And it stank so bad.
"M- Master, this place looks dangerous." Maeve whispered, paused right at the door, it was mostly luck that she managed to kill that cockroach before.
Vritra pulled out the baseball bat from his inventory as he held his breath.
"Just stay hidden for a bit." Right away he charged forward, coming out of the shadows.
At the 5th floor of the building, all houses were full of bandit-like men.
They were staying in 2 corridors and planned to ransack all the apartments.
They had cleared up to the ten floors, killing most survivors and looting whatever they could find.
"Where is Lukas's team? Why haven't they reported back yet?" A man with a body made of some metal spoke in a hoarse tone.
"Ron, do you think we should go up and check? What if they encountered some powerful mutant or found some good loot and just decided to steal it."
The thin limping man beside the leader called Ron spoke.
Lukas's team had gone up just to inspect the area and find the situation there.
"Hmm, send another two teams, I don't want any useless casualties so select appropriately." The leader said with a frown, there were a few women seated around him.
But aside from getting to see the beauties he couldn't really do much because of his mutation.
"We shouldn't stay in this region too long, this belongs to the Firebulls and there is also that big guy." The limping man said fearfully.
"Boss, I found these two men, they said they want to join us." Another man knocked on the door.
"Keep them if their ability is useful otherwise kill them."
The limping man walked away to carry out the orders.
Up on the thirteenth floor, Vritra smashed the heads of the cockroaches. Most weren't strong enough, and the few only had high endurance.
Before long, Vritra had killed around twenty of them and messages kept popping before him.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +51}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +56}
He kept a few alive and killed the rest, this was such a lucky encounter.
Then he spoke towards the hole on the floor: "Diana, Mom, I am throwing the injured cockroaches down, kill them and awaken."
"Alright."
After getting the confirmation from below he began to throw them down.
He threw exactly eight of them.
BANG
BANG
Several sounds rang out, and all the cockroaches were killed.
"Throw their bodies towards my hand." Vritra stretched his hand into the hole.
The others didn't know why, but they still followed his instructions.
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a dead body +19}
{Sin Point Gained: Touched a dead body +20}
'Can't miss these points.' he smiled faintly, before standing back up.
"We will be there soon, stay safe and learn more about your skills." He said, thankfully awakening wasn't difficult.
Finally he glanced towards his sin points.
{Sin Points: 2104}
"Nice!" a smile appeared as he gazed at his points, it seemed divine had sent him to a relatively safer area.
A place where it wouldn't be difficult to obtain sin points.
Now he could either use them to purchase 1 attribute point or open a lot of small rewards.
After slight hesitation, he decided to use the wheel for 50 Sin Point rewards.
It wasn't too low, and he could rotate the wheel a total of forty-two times.
If he could get at least 1 attribute, it would be worth it and he could get a lot of supplies too.
"Draw 50 Sin Point rewards, use all the points!!" he said.

{Congratulations, you have acquired 10kg rice!}
{Congratulations, you have acquired 1 strength attribute point!}
{Congratulations, you have acquired 100 apples!}
A total of forty two messages popped before him exactly, as Vritra read them all patiently.
He had obtained quite a big amount of food items, but a few of the things pulled his attention.
"Two attribute points, 1 strength and 1 spiritual! Hah I made a big profit." Vritra smiled, clearly opening small lottery was better.
Otherwise in 2,000 sin points he could only buy 1 attribute point.
"Maybe the increase in my luck is still there..." he thought but quickly shifted his attention to his status panel.
Just now he had killed quite a bit of cockroaches which had also increased his attributes a little.
[Stats]
(Strength: 3.8)
(Agility: 3.8)
(Endurance: 2.7)
(Spiritual: 2.9)
{Sin Points: 4}
Killing those mutants increased his stats by around 1 to 1.2, only spiritual stat increased by just 0.2.
'What even is the benefit of this stat? Just heightening my senses?' he wondered, then moved his focus towards the remaining rewards.
'These items alone will last us for some time, now we don't have to worry about food and water at least. Hmm now what's that?' he focused on one of the items in his inventory and pulled it out.
"A smoke bomb?" Vritra stared at the smoke bomb with slight surprise, then put it away.
It would certainly come in handy later on.
'Divine, my strength could increase quickly as I can gain attributes through the wheel and by killing mutants, but won't my wives be too slow?
At this rate, they won't even be able to protect themselves.' Vritra thought, once they face real danger, Vritra might not even have strength to protect himself.
"That's true, if they continue the normal way, they will be even behind the people who have been evolving for over 6 months now." Divine agreed, before adding:

"And for that you need to form a party with all your family members, that way even if they don't kill the mutants and just help they would still receive some benefits. And don't worry, it won't hinder your growth."
'Alright, I will try that once we go down.' He finally felt better.
"Foxie, we are done here. Time to leave." Vritra said as he turned to look at the patiently waiting Maeve.
"Master, are we going down or continue?" she asked, eager to increase her strength.
"...Let's scout the area first, and then we will head down." He replied, they at least should be aware of the danger.
After a few moments, two figures covered by shadows left the apartment, they perfectly merged with the dark surroundings.
There were two more apartments on the other side, Vritra decided to check them out.
The door of the first opened directly, and inside, he found torn up human bodies.
There were just tiny pieces left after zombies ate them up.
He touched the piece of flesh, but received no sin points, they were too broken it seemed.
Then they moved to the last apartment of the floor, and found that its door was locked.
'There are people inside?' Vritra focused and could hear faint sounds of breathing.
The people inside were clearly scared, so Vritra just left, walking towards the stairs.
They climbed up and peeked into the corridor, finding it too dark to see anything clearly.
'This doesn't look like normal darkness, this floor seems dangerous.' Vritra thought, maybe some very powerful mutant resided here.
"Continue, there are no zombies on this floor." Two teams, consisting of a total of 8 men, made their way up, checking each floor.
Soon they had arrived at the twelfth floor, and didn't see any sign of danger.
Only one powerful zombie was present on the 11th floor which they avoided for now, thankfully it was deaf.
"Check the apartments here." The man leading the two teams spoke, it was none other than the limping man.
The underling of Ron, his ability was just perfect for such scouting missions and for hiding.
A bubble surrounded the group of 8, making it impossible to even see them and hiding their presence.
"Yes lad." They quickly spread into various small teams.
The limping man's nickname was Lad, everyone listened to him since he was literally Ron's right hand man and was very cruel.
"These two apartments are empty." Two of the groups returned.
"Lad, we found the four corpses of Lukas and others in that apartment, it seemed they were done in by the deaf zombie." Another person reported.

"Looks like they have already looted this place, I guess we need to take care of that zombie first. Let's go bac-" Lad looked at the bloody footprints moving in and out of all the apartments and was about to turn.
"Lad, that apartment door is still locked, there might be survivors inside." One of the men excitedly interrupted.
"Oh, did they come here after Lukas's team was wiped out or were they behind it?" Lad was sure Lukas and others wouldn't alert the deaf zombie.
So they might have been ambushed.
"Let's go check." He said as the eight of them stepped towards the locked door.
KNOCK KNOCK
"Is anyone inside? We are from the military, we are shifting the survivors to a camp. There, we also have food, if you want to join then come out otherwise we are going to leave."
Lad spoke in a heavy voice.
If possible they would like to kill them silently.
"N- No thank you, I have already been UGHH bitten by the zombie, there is no hope for me. You should leave." A pained voice came from inside, surprising the group.
But Lad wasn't one to be fooled, he knew all sorts of tricks.
"Just open the door and let us see, it might be solved by amputation. We also have a vaccine in testing.
It might be shocking but I possess the ability to suck out the virus, my ability has saved many lives, where were you bitten?" Lad said, feeling that he was close to winning.
"Oh, suck it out? It's on my dick, can you suck out the virus?" the voice from inside said, holding back the laughter.
Lad's face turned red in anger, that bastard inside was clearly trying to make fun of him.
Inside the house, Shitless, Onest and the others were feeling anxious. Although they had just awakened, their strength was still too weak.
How much time had even passed since they arrived here? Barely an hour or so.
They were clearly at a big disadvantage here, and the numbers on both sides matched perfectly.
The chances of their winning was extremely high.
Lad on the other hand understood that the other person could not be fooled.
"You bastard, open the door before I break in and kill you. If you open, you might still have a chance at surviving!" he shouted.
But no response came, cursing, he understood that a battle was inevitable.
"Break this door and kill anyone inside, not the women of course." Lad ordered, folding his arms over his chest with a mocking expression.
He wanted to see the person inside. But even after several seconds no one followed his order, so he turned to look and was shocked.
