chapters.title: Chapter 626 Wall
paragraphs: As Vritra and Maeve were returning, they both heard the voice of Lad, and soon arrived at the 12th floor.
'Are they with the four I got killed earlier?' Vritra's expression instantly turned chilly.
Gesturing towards Maeve, the two quietly walked towards the group.
Their bodies merged with the darkness, even as they stood behind the group no one noticed them.
A knife appeared in Vritra's hand, as he took a step towards the member at the back of the group.
[Blood Manipulation Activated!]
One of his hands clutched his mouth as the sharp knife stabbed into his throat, the action was very swift.
The blood didn't spray out thanks to his skill.
Without creating even a little noise, Vritra killed him, as he slowly pulled the knife out and laid his body down.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +50}
Moving quickly, he repeated the same action with another man, pulling him back as the knife quickly pierced into his throat.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +52}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +49}
Quickly seven messages popped before him as Vritra stealthily killed them, messages after messages appearing before him.
In a direct fight, things would have been very difficult, but now they didn't even get to activate their abilities, making it far too easy.
Plus the noises created by the zombies muffled the faint sounds.
"Break this door and kill anyone inside, not the women of course." Lad ordered, and after a moment he turned back, only to see a shadowy figure.
"Wha-" filled with fear, he was about to run but the knife quickly descended onto his head.
CRACK
The knife pierced through the skull and plunged into his brain, killing him instantly.
Vritra's figure finally came into view, his hands covered with blood.
Pulling the blade out, he cleaned them against the clothes of one of them and then put it into his inventory.
"Onest, it is me, open the door." Vritra spoke as Onest peeked out and heaved a sigh of relief.
He opened the door, and saw the eight corpses.
"Throw them down along with the four corpses in that room." Vritra said as he walked into the apartment.
{Sin Points: 412}
All his stats had increased by 0.4 or 0.5, though spiritual only increased by 0.1.
"Darling!" Fiona jumped into his arms as soon as Vritra entered.
"Dear, you didn't get hurt did you?" Diana asked as she helped Vritra clean his hands.
"I am fine, you all awakened?" he asked, looking at his wives.
Onest and Shitless returned quickly after dumping the bodies out.
"Yes we did." Yennefer spoke, wiping a drop of blood from his cheek.
"Tell me, what are your abilities?" he asked curiously.
Fiona was the first to speak: "Our abilities are mostly similar to back on the Zoratian planet, I received the ability to control a special flame."
"I can control all elements." Yennefer spoke, she didn't have to work on mastering her skills.
"I got the ability to create explosions and some sort of spiritual attack ability." Yasmine spoke, it was actually similar to her ability from her previous life.
"I can create illusions and manipulate anyone's mind." Vanessa spoke, it was similar to her hypnosis ability.
"I got the ability to heal, debuff and use poisons." Diana said, from her expression it seemed the goddess was eager to test out her abilities.
"My ability is some wall? Maybe it is some defensive skill." Teresa spoke, the description wasn't even clear.
After listening to all his wives, Vritra repeated their new skills. They were mostly the same as before, but now Diana could also use poisons.
While Yasmine got her previous ability. And Teresa's ability was the strangest.
He decided to check it out later on, then glanced at the two remaining people in the room.
"Well my ability is high speed and hmm kind of auto dodge ability." Onest spoke.
"My skill is able to turn my entire body into metal, that's all nothing else, absolutely nothing." Monk Shitless spoke, but he was definitely hiding something.
"Come on, just tell me. We have to know each other's abilities for battle, and there are no strangers here." Vritra said.
"Sigh..." Shitless sighed, after looking around he nodded.
After a moment he showed both his transformations, first he transformed into a metal man.
Then he reverted and transformed into a familiar figure, Shit Sonia.
"Pfftt hahaha You liked it so much that even here you can't let go of Sonia?" Vritra and the others couldn't help but laugh.
Shitless missed his Bullo, at least he wouldn't laugh. And this damned identity just wouldn't leave him.
"COUGH Anyway, my ability is blood manipulation and evolution or something, anyway we will first be clearing this building before heading out."
Vritra spoke, this Sonia will be useful in the future.
"First, let's form a party." Vritra explained and a message appeared in front of them all.
As soon as they pressed yes, all of them became Vritra's party members.
"There are quite a few zombies above, let's clear them up first then we will deal with the humans below." Vritra said, and after some basic preparations, all of them walked out.
With his current stats and the abilities of everyone else, he was sure they could kill those zombies.
Leaving the apartment, they quickly climbed up and saw exactly thirteen zombies.
"Mom, try to hypnotize the zombies and make them walk here, and Diana, debuff them." Vritra spoke, they were hidden in the darkness.
Maeve's ability was really very helpful here, without it, moving around would be far too dangerous.
The goddess could only poison someone by touching them, but debuffs could be done from a distance.
Vanessa nodded, as she focused, but with her current strength she could barely manipulate one zombie.
Thankfully their spiritual attribute was low.
One of the zombies turned and started walking towards them.
Diana also used her ability as a faint red halo appeared around the zombie, making it weaker.
Vritra and Maeve silently walked a bit closer, while the others remained hidden near the stairs.
[Blood Manipulation Activated]
As soon as it was in range, Vritra struck its brain with the knife, then using its own rotten blood to wrap around its mouth to stop it from letting out any scream.
Yasmine had also launched a spiritual attack at the zombie right at that time, stunning it.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +51}
Without any further instructions, Diana and Vanessa continued, pulling one zombie at a time and weakening it.
This actually made hunting them pretty easy.
After a few minutes, out of the thirteen only one zombie remained alive.
Vritra pulled the knife out of another zombie's head as he looked at the single zombie.
"Tess, try your wall skill on that zombie." He said, that zombie was rather weak, he had left it alive just for this.
Tess pointed her hand towards it and activated her skill.
Instantly the zombie was surrounded by an almost invisible cubic room, its body froze.
But after a few moments it was able to move, the zombie screamed but no sound could be heard outside.
It struck the wall and needed two punches to break it.
'Oh, this is good.' Vritra thought as his gaze then focused on the zombie.
[Blood Manipulation Activated!]

chapters.title: Chapter 627 Clearing the building
paragraphs: [Blood Manipulation Activated!]
Vritra focused on the weakened zombie who had noticed their group and was running towards them madly.
But suddenly it froze. It looked as if countless worms were wriggling under his skin on the head and then...
BOOM
The zombie's head exploded with a light sound, sending blood and brain matter all around.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +48}
{Sin Points: 1056}
Again, Vritra's increased by a little. If he continued like this, then his growth would easily catch up to others.
Soon, he planned to draw rewards again.
"This floor is cleared up. Only one apartment is locked and probably has survivors inside." Vritra spoke, then continued:
"There is that strong deaf zombie below and complete darkness on the floor above. We gotta clear them up.
And there could be other humans from that group here. We have to wipe them out too."
They all listened to the goals, then Diana asked, "Is there any way to sense how many mutants are there in the darkness?"
"Let's check that place out first." Vritra said as they headed up. By killing these zombies, not only his, but the stats of others had increased too.
Soon, the group paused before the pitch black corridor. Nothing was visible nor audible. It was like nothing existed ahead.
"Yenni, try lighting it up." Vritra said, while holding the machete in his hand.
"Yes, husband." Yennefer nodded, before pointing her hand forward as a strong light burst out.
But it only slightly pushed the darkness, ultimately failing to do anything.
"Tess, try to push the darkness with the 'Wall'." Vritra asked, while using blood manipulation to sense any living thing ahead.
"Mmm." Teresa nodded, forming a wall in front of them fitting the corridor perfectly, then she began to push forward.
"It works!" The darkness was getting pushed back.
Maeve quickly covered Teresa and the others in shadows, while Fiona, Diana, and the others got ready to launch attacks.
Once reaching near the middle of the corridor, Vritra gestured for them to stop. He took a step forward and entered the darkness.
Then quickly moved back.
"We will come back here later. It's still too strong."
The mutant inside could have wiped them out, but thankfully it was busy munching on something right now.
They walked down hurriedly.
"So, are we going to target that zombie first?" Yasmine asked.
"Nah, but the humans." While speaking, his gaze turned to Monk Shitless.
"W- What?" he was startled and wanted to run away.
Down on the fifth floor, all the members of Ron's group had gathered.
"Lad led two teams above earlier and none of them have returned. We have already lost twelve men. I think we should run away. The firebull will be here soon anyway."
One of the members said.
"Sigh. Who asked that stupid lad to go up himself? He was supposed to be the brain of the team, that pervy greedy bastard." Ron cursed, slamming his metal fist against the table.
"Yeah, we can't be careless. There might be something dangerous above. Let's get out of here while that giant mutant is away." Ron said, looking at his group.
Only around thirty two of them remained now.
BANG BANG
Suddenly someone banged on the door. All the men became alert, ready to engage in a battle.
"Check who it is." Ron ordered as he got up, moving closer to the door.
One of the men nodded and peeked out through the peephole. "B- Boss, it's a woman, and a beautiful one at that."
"Open the door, but be careful. There are mutants with all sorts of abilities." Ron warned.
As the door opened, all of them saw a beautiful woman who carried a bag and looked somewhat dishevelled.
"H- Help, my husband was killed above by a mutant. That mutant is very dangerous." She spoke while sobbing lightly.
But all the men in the room were already looking at her with lustful expressions.
The eyes of the one who had just opened the door glowed for an instant as he got hypnotized by Vanessa.
The man looked outside and then back at the woman.
"Of course, lady, we can help you, but what are you going to do for us?" he asked lustfully, then snatched away her bag.
"Let's see what you are carrying."
"N- No, that's the last of my food stock. SOB, please don't!" Sonia begged.
"Haha, water and even food, we got luck!!" He instantly took a water bottle and drank from it.
"Hey wait, what if it is poisoned-" someone warned, but the man had already drunk it.
"I am fine, there is no poison. Here, all of you can have some." He began to hand over the supplies to hesitant people.
They looked at him and waited, but even after a few minutes he was perfectly fine.
So many of them began to eat and drink happily. The supplies were really hard to find.

"Ughh, what just happened?" He suddenly clutched his head and looked around in confusion.
"CATCH HER! NOW!"
Ron shouted as all of them charged after Shitless.
The fastest and strongest among them was Ron, so within moments he had already caught up to her.
But right as the monk reached the stairs, a shadow wrapped around him and he disappeared.
"Where is she? Locate her!" he shouted, but right then a loud bang was heard and then the scream of a zombie.
Then the sound of hurried footsteps and moments later, the deaf zombie appeared.
"Fuck!" Ron cursed as he engaged in battle with the zombie.
Their stats were pretty evenly matched, and because of his metal body, Ron had a slight advantage.
While the other men began to support him from behind.
'Perfect!' Vritra smiled. His plan worked perfectly. He wasted no time and moved behind the group.
Most of them were already poisoned and started to weaken, their senses slowing down.
And with Diana, Vanessa, and Yasmine's support, Vritra began his attack.
While Fiona and Yennefer kept launching attacks from behind.
Onest jumped into the group to attract their attention, but no one could even touch him.
Vritra slashed with the machete, cleanly cutting off the head of one man, and went on a killing spree.
He moved like a blur among the crowd, slashing around as pieces of their bodies flew everywhere.
Messages kept popping before him, and with his wives' support, this became too easy.
One man who was not poisoned turned around to counterattack, but suddenly his eyes exploded in a bloody mess and then he was beheaded.
Before long, all of them were killed. Only Ron and the deaf zombie remained.
'W- What? All of them are dead?!!' Ron glanced back and his heart ached upon seeing all his underlings lying in a pool of blood.
He had spent so many supplies on them, and they couldn't even kill one guy.
Hatred and rage filled his heart, he was going to kill every single one of them, the women and man, all of them.
Despite being careful their whole group was wiped out just like that.

Vritra focused on the weakened zombie who had noticed their group and was running towards them madly.

BOOM

We have to wipe them out too."

"We will come back here later.

They walked down hurriedly.
"So, are we going to target that zombie first?" Yasmine asked.

"Lad led two teams above earlier and none of them have returned.

The firebull will be here soon anyway."
One of the members said.
"Sigh.

chapters.title: Chapter 628 Earthquake
paragraphs: Heavy punches descended on the zombie as Ron tried to kill it.
His heart was full of regret.
He should have listened to Lad and left this place before.
But suddenly, his body began to slow down and a sharp pain struck his mind.
Diana used a debuff, Yasmine launched a spiritual attack, Vanessa made him feel sluggish and confused.
Suddenly, the blood in his body started to churn, making his heart beat way faster as an intense feeling of fear filled his heart.
'I have to run!'
He gave up the idea of revenge and just wanted to flee.
But just as he turned, he was surrounded by an invisible wall that made him freeze momentarily.
BANG
That was enough time for the deaf zombie.
Its wild punches descended on Ron as cracks formed over his metal body.
Only his skin was metallic.
His insides were still the same as ever.
A blood red fire bird flew and suddenly struck his face, burning his eyes as Ron screamed, madly punching at the zombie.
"Perfect hehe." Fiona smiled, sending more fire birds.
All of them coordinated, as they made the fight more brutal.
And before long, both the zombie and Ron were badly injured, their figures bloody.
"Alright, that's enough. Gotta steal the kill now."
Vritra smiled as he threw out a knife that plunged straight into the zombie's mouth.
He rushed forward and plunged the machete into the frozen zombie's head, destroying its brain.
Finally, he turned to look at the injured Ron, who could barely stand.
"Hello there, sorry for the intrusion. You see, we are new here." Vritra spoke as he walked closer.
"Y- You COUGH bastard, why did you... ugh we d- didn't even do anythi... t- to you"
[Blood Manipulation Activated!]
Now that Ron was so weak and his defenses gone, the blood suddenly turned into blades and plunged into his own brain, killing him.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +96}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +98}
Vritra was quite happy with his gains.
He quickly looked at his stats.
{Sin Points: 2826}
[Stats]
(Strength: 7.8)
(Agility: 7.8)
(Endurance: 6.7)
(Spiritual: 4.2)
"Nice! I wonder how many attributes I could gain from the wheel." He thought and decided to go back up.
This place was covered in blood, so mutant creatures might swarm here soon.
After returning to their original apartment, Vritra looked at the illusory Sin Wheel.
"Hmm, I think the 100 points lottery will have a higher chance of getting attributes.
Alright, let's draw the 100 points lottery with all my points."
He thought and instantly 2800 points were gone, in return for 28 rewards.
[Congratulations, you have obtained 1 Free attribute!]
[Congratulations, you have obtained 100 litre Petrol!]
[Congratulations, you have obtained 100 steak meal kits!]
Quickly, exactly 28 messages popped up before him. Most were various supplies.
"I got 2 spiritual, 1 agility, and 1 free attribute point, ha that's 4 points worth eight thousand!"
Vritra was quite happy with the rewards.
This was certainly better than 50 points, and even the supplies were in bigger quantity.
The spiritual and agility attributes were added automatically, making him feel refreshed.
His mind had that comfortable cool feeling.
The free attribute point remained. After thinking, Vritra decided to keep it for now.
"Alright, after we kill that darkness mutant above, we will be leaving this building." Vritra said.
"Hubby, let's eat now. I am starting to feel hungry. I had almost forgotten hunger once my strength grew." Yasmine spoke happily.
Even their strength grew after killing all those men.
It was not as fast as Vritra because of the wheel, but they were faster than the people of this planet.
The mood was light as Vritra took out the supplies he had collected and shared them with others.
In case they separated by accident, everyone would have some amount of essentials.
All of them still had inventories, thankfully.
They took their time eating, chatting normally, and just enjoying this time.
Once they were out of the building, things would be very dangerous.
After eating, they all headed to the dark corridor.
With their current stats and combined abilities, it wouldn't be hard to kill that creature.
Teresa pushed the darkness back, and Vritra charged in directly, while others supported him fighting from behind or alongside him.
At the centre, a strange mutant was revealed.
Its torso was pressed against the ground and it had limbs like a spider, as it looked at them with countless eyes.
It pounced at them, the limbs stabbing like spears while exhaling darkness that seemed to make their minds shaky.
The battle was still quite dangerous, as they all used their abilities, going all out to defeat it.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +124}
HUFF HUFF
All of them panted heavily. The energy in their bodies was nearly exhausted.
That was the strongest mutant they had killed so far.
It alone had increased his stats by 0.3.
"Hoo, finally we are done. Let's go up and check that place as well."
There was one more floor, and upon checking it they didn't really find anything.
Even the corpses were too torn, while there wasn't a sign of any zombie.
"Looks like there is nothing left in this building. It is time to head out." Vritra said solemnly.
Their goal was to move towards the tower.
First, they climbed onto the terrace, and now the tower was a bit clearer.
Though the terrace too was covered in snow.
"That looks pretty far." The goddess spoke. No wonder they got quite a lot of time.
And in such snow, no vehicle could move on the road.
"Hmm, we should still avoid that giant mutant. We are no match for it." Vritra said as they turned to leave.
But amidst the fog he noticed something.
Vritra focused, and with his heightened senses he could see farther than the others.
Somehow the buildings in the distance were shaking wildly, as if there was a strong earthquake.
And somehow, one by one, all buildings were starting to shake violently.
BOOOOM
A building suddenly tilted and then fell, as a big cloud of mist rose, the big building turning into rubble.
As the earthquake got a bit closer, Vritra suddenly noticed that there was actually something under the ground, and it was very very huge.
"RUN!" He shouted and grabbed the hands of his wives closest to him, rushing towards the other corner of the terrace.
All of them were stunned but quickly followed Vritra.
By now they too noticed the strong earthquake.
Moments later, their building and the ones surrounding it began to shake fiercely.
After a moment, a couple of buildings even rose slightly before falling while creating loud noise.
Vritra and the others almost lost their balance as the building began to fall towards the left, but thankfully he had reacted quickly.
His agility was already over 9. He quickly glanced over his family, then at the surroundings.
[Adding 1 Free Attribute Point to agility.]
And now it was over 10. As if reaching a milestone, there was a sudden jump in his speed.
Moving at full speed, he grabbed Fiona and Diana's hands before throwing them towards the ceiling of the other building.
Thankfully the others seemed to be holding on.
Whatever was wriggling under the ground wasn't close to that building.
Vritra quickly tossed everyone to the other side before they even knew what was happening.

chapters.title: Chapter 629 Mutant Flood
paragraphs: Throwing everyone to the other side, Vritra quickly jumped away as the building continued to fall.
They landed safely on the heavy snow, but that building too started to shake violently.
"What's going on?" holding onto the wall, Vanessa asked.
"There is something underground. This can fall as well, we need to get down!"
Vritra said as he looked around and saw a few frozen corpses.
"Fiona, Yenni, heat them up." He said.
The two women didn't waste any time as flames burst out, quickly melting the snow around as over ten corpses lay in the water.
Vritra moved forward, quickly collecting the sin points before using blood manipulation.
{Sin Points: 388}
Instantly, blood flooded out of their bodies, forming a long thick rope.
Throwing it down to the other side, he shouted, "Use this and jump down, this building might fall anytime."
Shitless and Onest jumped down first. Vritra had even created handles over the rope, so they just needed to hold onto them.
Cracks formed over the building and a few screams could be heard, but there was nothing they could do.
Right after landing, they started running away, moving towards the open area.
But of course, such a big commotion was sure to attract the attention of a lot of mutants.
From under the snow, from the buildings, from the distant streets, the mutants began to pour out, running around crazily.
Some other people who had jumped out of buildings were quickly swarmed and torn to pieces.
"Fuck!" Vritra looked around, and soon he saw a ladder going up a building which was ten floors high.
"Let's go there first." He said as they changed directions. Many of the mutants had already noticed them by now.
Though the ladder was going up only to the second floor.
ROAARRRR
A deafening roar sounded as many mutants were tossed away.
Then an overgrown mouse was revealed, its fur looking sharp like blades and its limbs had grown long, increasing its agility.
Within moments, hundreds of mutants had noticed them as they swarmed in their direction.
Vritra, Yasmine, and the others kept launching attacks as they ran, but the tsunami of mutants just kept getting bigger.
They were just a hundred or so metres away from that ten floor building when it suddenly started to shake from left to right.
GRAARRRRR
And with an explosive sound, suddenly the building was pulled off the ground as the giant mutant came into view.
Because all buildings had fallen off, its path was blocked, so it just threw away an entire building.
All ten of them paused, their hearts beating wildly. Behind was the flood of mutants, and in front was that gigantic creature.
'Fucking hell, 6 months head start is too big of a cheat. What can I do? What can I do?' he looked around in distress.
"Husband, I can create a hole under the ground." Yennefer spoke. She could control the earth attribute after all.
"Alright, create it, as deep as you can. Just save some energy to cover it up later." Vritra said, then he took out the 100 litre petrol he had won earlier.
It was filled in steel drums, all of them placed close to one another. Vritra used the machete as he cut into one of them, letting the petrol flow out freely.
The gigantic zombie noticed the big crowd of mutants and then the humans. For some reason, those mad mutants weren't eating one another.
Taking a long step, it too headed in their direction, while the flood of mutants had almost caught up.
"Jump in!!" He shouted as the ten of them jumped into the hole which was only around four metres deep, but Yennefer was still working.
"Fiona, light it up! Yenni, close it!" Vritra instructed as they kept going down.
Yennefer focused as the surface began to close up. Before the hole's surface was fully shut, a fire bird flew up, going high before finally falling.
The space was covered with darkness, and they heard hundreds of footsteps from above. The wave of zombies was already on top.
For a moment, things fell silent and then...
BOOOOM!!
The ground shook as a big cloud of fire rose. Nearly all the mutants above were blasted to pieces or burned to death.
Even the gigantic mutant had its arm and shoulder blown off as it stumbled and fell back.
Inside the hole, everyone worked to keep the top from falling as Yennefer brought them further down.
Then she created a big space on the side as they stepped there, finally relaxing a bit.
And the hole was instantly covered up. Yennefer was completely exhausted, her beautiful face covered with sweat.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +59}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +53}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +74}
In front of Vritra, a series of messages began to pop up, surprising him greatly.
All the others noticed a warmth spreading in their bodies as well.
Their attributes were increasing quickly as well. Yennefer's energy recovered a bit.
"Yenni, are you alright?" Vritra touched her cheek before hugging her, their hearts still pounding wildly.
"Yeah... just a little tired. But is that thing dead too?" she asked. The sight of that giant mutant was quite frightening.
"I doubt it, this alone won't be enough to kill that." Vritra said, but was happy to have gotten so much from this moment of crisis.
He glanced over all the messages and yes, there was none for the giant one. That thing was still there.
{Sin Points: 16,368}
[Stats]
(Strength: 16.1)
(Agility: 17.9)
(Endurance: 16)
(Spiritual: 9.2)
{Free Attribute: 0}
Vritra too felt the warmth spread across his body, his stats increasing by a big leap.
Now only the spiritual attribute remained under 10, but an even bigger gain were the sin points.
After thinking for a moment, he spoke, "Draw 200 point lotteries with all the sin points."
BOOOM
ROAARRRRRR
Suddenly, they heard a loud roar from above the ground. The giant mutant was stomping the ground, trying to kill them.
"Yenni, can you continue?" he asked. They had to move away immediately.
Yennefer nodded, taking a deep breath before getting started. Her stat was almost at 10, so it became a little easier.
As the ethereal wheel rotated before him, messages began to pop up one by one quickly.
And before long, all 81 of the rewards came out as Vritra again felt an increase in his stats.
Aside from a large amount of supplies, he got some attribute points as well.
'2 Strength, 4 Agility, 3 Endurance, 4 Spiritual and 3 Free attributes, that's great!' he exclaimed as the points except free ones added automatically.
His agility was already over 20 and strength at 17, but for now he didn't add the free attributes.
His mind was also filled with a cool sensation. The spiritual attribute was already over 10.
But for now, he didn't really know its use.
"HUFF. We should be far away for now." Yennefer was left with a tiny bit of energy as she panted heavily.
Vritra quickly supported her as one of his arms circled around her waist.
"Thank you, Yenni." He said with a smile, giving her a bottle of water.
Now they had to go up after the giant was gone.
GRRRRRR
The ground started shaking...

Vritra said as he looked around and saw a few frozen corpses.
"Fiona, Yenni, heat them up." He said.
The two women didn't waste any time as flames burst out, quickly melting the snow around as over ten corpses lay in the water.
Vritra moved forward, quickly collecting the sin points before using blood manipulation.
{Sin Points: 388}
Instantly, blood flooded out of their bodies, forming a long thick rope.
Throwing it down to the other side, he shouted, "Use this and jump down, this building might fall anytime."
Shitless and Onest jumped down first.
Vritra had even created handles over the rope, so they just needed to hold onto them.
Cracks formed over the building and a few screams could be heard, but there was nothing they could do.
Right after landing, they started running away, moving towards the open area.
But of course, such a big commotion was sure to attract the attention of a lot of mutants.
From under the snow, from the buildings, from the distant streets, the mutants began to pour out, running around crazily.
Some other people who had jumped out of buildings were quickly swarmed and torn to pieces.
"Fuck!" Vritra looked around, and soon he saw a ladder going up a building which was ten floors high.
"Let's go there first." He said as they changed directions.
Many of the mutants had already noticed them by now.
Though the ladder was going up only to the second floor.
ROAARRRR
A deafening roar sounded as many mutants were tossed away.
Then an overgrown mouse was revealed, its fur looking sharp like blades and its limbs had grown long, increasing its agility.
Within moments, hundreds of mutants had noticed them as they swarmed in their direction.
Vritra, Yasmine, and the others kept launching attacks as they ran, but the tsunami of mutants just kept getting bigger.
They were just a hundred or so metres away from that ten floor building when it suddenly started to shake from left to right.
GRAARRRRR
And with an explosive sound, suddenly the building was pulled off the ground as the giant mutant came into view.
Because all buildings had fallen off, its path was blocked, so it just threw away an entire building.
All ten of them paused, their hearts beating wildly.
Behind was the flood of mutants, and in front was that gigantic creature.
'Fucking hell, 6 months head start is too big of a cheat.
What can I do?
What can I do?' he looked around in distress.
"Husband, I can create a hole under the ground." Yennefer spoke.
She could control the earth attribute after all.
"Alright, create it, as deep as you can.
Just save some energy to cover it up later." Vritra said, then he took out the 100 litre petrol he had won earlier.
It was filled in steel drums, all of them placed close to one another.
Vritra used the machete as he cut into one of them, letting the petrol flow out freely.
The gigantic zombie noticed the big crowd of mutants and then the humans.
For some reason, those mad mutants weren't eating one another.
Taking a long step, it too headed in their direction, while the flood of mutants had almost caught up.
"Jump in!!" He shouted as the ten of them jumped into the hole which was only around four metres deep, but Yennefer was still working.
"Fiona, light it up!
Yenni, close it!" Vritra instructed as they kept going down.
Yennefer focused as the surface began to close up.
Before the hole's surface was fully shut, a fire bird flew up, going high before finally falling.
The space was covered with darkness, and they heard hundreds of footsteps from above.
The wave of zombies was already on top.
For a moment, things fell silent and then...
BOOOOM!!
The ground shook as a big cloud of fire rose.
Nearly all the mutants above were blasted to pieces or burned to death.
Even the gigantic mutant had its arm and shoulder blown off as it stumbled and fell back.
Inside the hole, everyone worked to keep the top from falling as Yennefer brought them further down.
Then she created a big space on the side as they stepped there, finally relaxing a bit.
And the hole was instantly covered up.
Yennefer was completely exhausted, her beautiful face covered with sweat.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +59}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +53}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +74}
In front of Vritra, a series of messages began to pop up, surprising him greatly.
All the others noticed a warmth spreading in their bodies as well.
Their attributes were increasing quickly as well.
Yennefer's energy recovered a bit.
"Yenni, are you alright?" Vritra touched her cheek before hugging her, their hearts still pounding wildly.
"Yeah... just a little tired.
But is that thing dead too?" she asked.
The sight of that giant mutant was quite frightening.
"I doubt it, this alone won't be enough to kill that." Vritra said, but was happy to have gotten so much from this moment of crisis.
He glanced over all the messages and yes, there was none for the giant one.
That thing was still there.
{Sin Points: 16,368}
[Stats]
(Strength: 16.1)
(Agility: 17.9)
(Endurance: 16)
(Spiritual: 9.2)
{Free Attribute: 0}
Vritra too felt the warmth spread across his body, his stats increasing by a big leap.
Now only the spiritual attribute remained under 10, but an even bigger gain were the sin points.
After thinking for a moment, he spoke, "Draw 200 point lotteries with all the sin points."
BOOOM
ROAARRRRRR
Suddenly, they heard a loud roar from above the ground.
The giant mutant was stomping the ground, trying to kill them.
"Yenni, can you continue?" he asked.
They had to move away immediately.
Yennefer nodded, taking a deep breath before getting started.
Her stat was almost at 10, so it became a little easier.
As the ethereal wheel rotated before him, messages began to pop up one by one quickly.
And before long, all 81 of the rewards came out as Vritra again felt an increase in his stats.
Aside from a large amount of supplies, he got some attribute points as well.
'2 Strength, 4 Agility, 3 Endurance, 4 Spiritual and 3 Free attributes, that's great!' he exclaimed as the points except free ones added automatically.
His agility was already over 20 and strength at 17, but for now he didn't add the free attributes.
His mind was also filled with a cool sensation.
The spiritual attribute was already over 10.
But for now, he didn't really know its use.
"HUFF.
We should be far away for now." Yennefer was left with a tiny bit of energy as she panted heavily.
Vritra quickly supported her as one of his arms circled around her waist.
"Thank you, Yenni." He said with a smile, giving her a bottle of water.
Now they had to go up after the giant was gone.
GRRRRRR
The ground started shaking...

chapters.title: Chapter 630 FireBull
paragraphs: GRRRRR...
"Damnit, at least let us catch a breath!!" Onest cursed as the ground suddenly started to shake.
"Is it that thing again?" Vritra frowned. Whatever was crawling underground was huge, at least as big as that giant mutant.
He glanced back at Yennefer and it was obvious she could not continue.
Judging from their movements, they should be somewhere under a road right now.
And if they were lucky, then there should also be a sewer underground.
"Hold onto the top handles." As he spoke, bloody handles appeared connected to the ceiling. It was the same blood he used as rope earlier.
All of them jumped up and clung to the handles which were firmly stuck to the ceiling, then Vritra raised his right hand.
BOOM!
With all his strength, he struck the ground, making everything shudder.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Without stopping, he punched again and again as suddenly the ground crumbled and he fell.
The handles slowly slid down, turning into long ropes as the others began to move down.
THUD
Vritra landed on his feet in the dimly lit sewage. He rose to his feet and looked up as the others also landed safely beside him.
"This much should be fine-!!" Sighing in relief, Vritra turned around and froze upon seeing a big group of people who were also frozen in shock.
They seemed to be in the midst of eating. A few were frozen with a spoonful of something almost in their mouths.
"Uhm hello there, don't mind us, we are just passing by." Vritra waved at them. There were over forty men and women. If a frontal battle did break out, they wouldn't be at any advantage.
His stats had increased quite a bit, but just among this group there were a few with higher stats.
And who knows what abilities they possessed.
"Who are you?" All on the other side suddenly jumped to their feet, looking at the group threateningly.
But seeing the seven beautiful women, most of them were dazed.
Could such beautiful women exist in reality?
Only Teresa had her face covered. Her appearance was still enough to make men go crazy.
"We are not evil people. We slipped into a hole and fell. And we are very strong, especially this guy, none of them can kill him. I dare you to try!" Shitless shouted, pointing towards Onest.
"B- Boss, you must be joking. How can I show my strength before you? If any of you have the strength, then try putting a dent in his bald head." Onest retorted.
The others looked at them cautiously. They parted as a tall and robust woman walked out wearing leather armor.
She was eating a big piece of meat, which seemed to be some creature's leg.
"This is the territory of the Firebull. Who are you all? Speak before we wipe you all out." She said, her gaze scanning them all.
Vritra looked around, trying to find some way out.
"We were running from a giant monster and ended up here. We have no intentions to fight."
"..." The woman stared silently at them, then spoke, "You have two choices, either fight or surrender."
Vritra frowned. Even with his current stats, defeating that woman would be impossible. Her stats were already close to 30.
'It seems the bandits I killed before were living too safely and didn't kill many mutants. This woman might have a strong ability too.' he thought before asking:
"What does surrendering mean? What do you plan to do with us?"
There were so many people. They were all eating mutant beast meat. They had probably run out of other supplies.
"This is not a bandit group. We won't harm you or those women, but as you know, to fight those dangerous things we need more hands.
So I want you all to be cannon fodders for me." She spoke, without hiding anything.
"And what about food and water?" Vritra asked, weighing his options.
"We have enough to feed a few more mouths, but it's just mutant meat for now. We are going to raid another group soon, and I heard they still have supplies." She added, throwing a bait.
"Oh really?! If we participate in this raid, will you hand some food to us as well?" Vritra asked with fake excitement in his voice.
"Yes of course, so make your choice. By killing you, we could still feed our pet." She said while pointing towards a cage with a locked mutant snake.
"I just have one condition. None among you tries to harm anyone in my group. I don't want any man to go anywhere near my women." He spoke firmly. For now, he could only follow them.

"Alright, that's perfectly fine. I don't like rape and all. They'll all behave, don't worry." She said with a grin before speaking, "I am called the Bull. Are you their leader? What's the condition above?"

"Yes, I am Adam, and things have turned really bad up there. There is that large mutant and something under the ground that's crawling around and throwing off buildings. There was also a group of humans who were killing and looting everything." He replied with a sigh.
"Hmm, looks like this is the perfect chance to make our move and catch them off guard. Everyone, prepare for battle. We will attack them tomorrow." Bull shouted before looking at Vritra.
"And you, don't try anything or the outcome will be tragic for you all."
Vritra just nodded, not showing any emotions.
Now that this new group had surrendered, many men could no longer hold back from running forward and speaking to the women in the group.
"Hello, what's your name?"
"Haha, look how much food I have, and I don't mind sharing it."
"Hello pretty ladies, why don't you-"
"Fuck off!" Vritra glared at the men. The blood in their bodies suddenly started to boil over.
They were frightened and quickly moved back despite wanting to pick a fight.
"What the hell dude, this is the apocalypse. How can you alone hoard so many beauties? With your low strength you can't even protect them. You should know what's better for you."
Like starved beasts, these men really seemed to go mad upon seeing the seven extremely beautiful women.
"Sigh. Onest, Shitless, take care of him." Vritra didn't even bother as he walked further away from the group with his wives.
"Alright, pitiful one." Shitless and Onest surrounded the startled guy.
He punched at Onest but couldn't touch him, and then punches descended on his face from both sides.
"Hubby, this group is clearly going to get us killed in their fight. They probably plan to use us as meat shields." Yasmine spoke.
"And I doubt even a poison trick could work here. They are clearly so cautious of us." Diana said, because of the several events they were driven into a corner.
"This group is pretty big. Further in the sewer there were more people. There must be over eighty of them." Vritra estimated. Fighting against them all currently would be suicide.
"We can only wait for some chance it seems, master. Maybe later we can sneak away." Maeve suggested.

"We will see about that later. For now, we need to just protect ourselves from them. Sigh, these men have become worse than animals because of this apocalypse." Vanessa cursed. She had always hated all men except Vritra.

chapters.title: Chapter 631 Abilities
paragraphs: "Keep an eye on them." The leader said as she walked away. Of course, she didn't trust those people either.
She found it hard to get any information about them just by their appearances.
In any case, they would be dead in the battle the next day, so there was really no need to overthink it.
While eating the meat, she walked into her makeshift tent.
On the other side, Vritra and the others were feeling tired too. Their bodies had weakened compared to before.
"Let's set a tent here, we will stay here for now." Vritra said with a sigh. He really needed to increase his strength faster.
Among the various rewards, there were also a few tents. Taking them out, they quickly set up the two tents.
One for Shitless and Onest, while the other was for Vritra and his wives.
"P- Pitiful one, do I really have to share a tent with this mugger? What if he tries to steal something?" the monk complained.
"Huh? Shitless, what do you even have that's worth stealing? Or don't tell me you are really becoming shit, Sonia?" Onest replied.
Vritra rolled his eyes and let the two banter. Looking at his wives, he gestured.
"This isn't too bad." Looking around, the goddess spoke.
There were mattresses on the ground, though it was still a little cold.
"Let's rest a bit, who knows what we will be facing tomorrow." Vritra said as he lay down.
All his wives followed, lying down on both sides of him.
"Hubby, should I keep watch?" Yasmine asked. Those people couldn't be trusted after all.
Seeing so many women at once, many wouldn't be able to control their emotions.
"It is fine, Divine will wake me up if there is trouble, right Divine?" Vritra said.
"Haa, this guy. Fine, I can do that much for everything you have done." Divine sighed. He was reduced to being a guard.
Pulling over the several layers of blankets, they closed their eyes. At least all of them were together.
Thankfully, because of Bull's promise, none of the men came to cause trouble for them.
Early in the morning, they quickly freshened up and changed into another set of warm clothes.
At least Vritra wasn't lacking in supplies with all the draws.
"Hey, you! Boss is asking you to go meet her." Before long, a guy walked up to them and spoke.
But his gaze kept moving towards the beautiful women. Stepping forward, Vritra blocked his view.
"Alright, I will be there. Now get lost!" Barely a few people could retain their kindness and conscience in the apocalypse.
"How dare you! You are just a captive here, how dare you talk to me like that!!" The man felt his pride hurt. He wanted to beat Vritra up in front of his women.
"Leave it. If Bull knows she was late because of you, you will be in trouble. And I doubt he can keep himself safe for long, let alone these women."
Another guy said with a chuckle as the two walked back.
"Tch, I will wait a little."
'Wait, where did these guys get such nice tents? Or did we overlook them?' he wondered, but didn't dwell on it.
"Darling, do you have a plan?" Fiona frowned. She didn't like anyone disrespecting her husband or family.
"Yeah, I will go there to meet that Bull woman. Stay on guard." Vritra said seriously.
After giving a few instructions, he walked away.
All eyes were drawn to Vritra as he passed by the tents and headed towards the biggest one.
"Wait, state your name." One of the guards asked, looking hostile.
"...Adam." Vritra replied. He just needed to hold on for a bit longer.
"Alright, go in." He said with a haughty look.
As Vritra walked in, he saw Bull and other men standing around a round table.
"Adam, you are here. Good, all team leaders are here as well." She said, almost as if he was an important part of the group.
"So what instructions do you have for me?" he asked, stepping forward in front of Bull.
"Oh, straightforward? Not bad. Now that I can see you clearly, aren't you quite handsome? How about becoming my boytoy? I have quite a lot of food." She said.
Her voice was more manly than most men.
"No thanks." Vritra shook his head firmly.
"Heh, well we will talk about that later. Now we are going to attack the Bull Eater group. Their number is lower than us, but their leader is quite powerful." Bull said.
'Bull Eater? Haha, is it safe for her to go there?' Vritra almost laughed at the name.
"And you want me to take the vanguard?" he interrupted.
It seemed they were lucky to have come here when these people were planning a war and could not afford variables.
Otherwise, this Bull would have attacked them directly.
"Smart too. That's right. Although it is dangerous, I can't allow you to stab us in the back.
But if you are in the front, you would have to fight for your own sake too." She nodded.
"Alright." Gritting his teeth, he nodded.

"Good, you are smart indeed. Go prepare and take a few weapons if you need. Also, tell Tat the superpowers of your group before leaving and don't lie!" she said, pointing towards a burly guy with the pet name Tat.
"Yeah, yeah..." Vritra walked out as Tat followed him, carrying a half torn page.
"There are ten of you. Tell me the abilities of everyone." Tat asked.
"Mine is strength. That bald guy can turn into a woman. The other guy can run really fast. While my women are all unawakened, they depend on me." Vritra said.
This made Tat frown. There was no way he could believe that. After more than six months of apocalypse, how could any woman be unawakened?
Aren't they just asking to die? Didn't they eat mutant meat at all?
"Stop lying!!" Tat shouted. He really couldn't understand why Bull would want such weak meat shields.
He really wanted to take those women away.
'Wait, now that I think about it, I also have Evomorph. What does that skill do?
Does it also only react when I am in danger? I should try it out.' Vritra thought as he turned and started walking.
"You think you can just ignore me?" Tat threw the paper away and suddenly charged at Vritra's back.
Tat wasn't as strong as Bull, but most of his stats were above 20, except spiritual and agility.
Vritra just tilted his head and the heavy arm breezed past without touching him.
"Go back, Bull wouldn't like internal battles now." Vritra said without stopping.
'H- He dodged me?' Tat was shocked. That agility was above 20.
'Didn't he say his ability is strength? Maybe it is speed, no way he have over 20 agility with group full of women. Yeah, I should report it.' Tat walked back.
Arriving back, Vritra spoke solemnly, "Let's eat and get ready for the battle ahead. Things will be becoming really dangerous."
"Together, we can overcome it. Don't worry, hubby." Yasmine said, but she missed the time from before.
She couldn't even have him fill her up for now. She could only wait until they were safer.
Not to mention, having a kid here would be too dangerous. Who knows how long they would stay here.
With each having thoughts of their own, they began to eat.

Good, all team leaders are here as well." She said, almost as if he was an important part of the group.
"So what instructions do you have for me?" he asked, stepping forward in front of Bull.
"Oh, straightforward?
Not bad.
Now that I can see you clearly, aren't you quite handsome?
How about becoming my boytoy?
I have quite a lot of food." She said.
Her voice was more manly than most men.
"No thanks." Vritra shook his head firmly.
"Heh, well we will talk about that later.
Now we are going to attack the Bull Eater group.
Their number is lower than us, but their leader is quite powerful." Bull said.
'Bull Eater?
Haha, is it safe for her to go there?' Vritra almost laughed at the name.
"And you want me to take the vanguard?" he interrupted.
It seemed they were lucky to have come here when these people were planning a war and could not afford variables.
Otherwise, this Bull would have attacked them directly.
"Smart too.
That's right.
Although it is dangerous, I can't allow you to stab us in the back.
But if you are in the front, you would have to fight for your own sake too." She nodded.
"Alright." Gritting his teeth, he nodded.
"Good, you are smart indeed.
Go prepare and take a few weapons if you need.
Also, tell Tat the superpowers of your group before leaving and don't lie!" she said, pointing towards a burly guy with the pet name Tat.
"Yeah, yeah..." Vritra walked out as Tat followed him, carrying a half torn page.
"There are ten of you.
Tell me the abilities of everyone." Tat asked.
"Mine is strength.
That bald guy can turn into a woman.
The other guy can run really fast.
While my women are all unawakened, they depend on me." Vritra said.
This made Tat frown.
There was no way he could believe that.
After more than six months of apocalypse, how could any woman be unawakened?
Aren't they just asking to die?
Didn't they eat mutant meat at all?
"Stop lying!!" Tat shouted.
He really couldn't understand why Bull would want such weak meat shields.
He really wanted to take those women away.
'Wait, now that I think about it, I also have Evomorph.
What does that skill do?
Does it also only react when I am in danger?
I should try it out.' Vritra thought as he turned and started walking.
"You think you can just ignore me?" Tat threw the paper away and suddenly charged at Vritra's back.
Tat wasn't as strong as Bull, but most of his stats were above 20, except spiritual and agility.
Vritra just tilted his head and the heavy arm breezed past without touching him.
"Go back, Bull wouldn't like internal battles now." Vritra said without stopping.
'H- He dodged me?' Tat was shocked.
That agility was above 20.
'Didn't he say his ability is strength?
Maybe it is speed, no way he have over 20 agility with group full of women.
Yeah, I should report it.' Tat walked back.
Arriving back, Vritra spoke solemnly, "Let's eat and get ready for the battle ahead.
Things will be becoming really dangerous."
"Together, we can overcome it.
Don't worry, hubby." Yasmine said, but she missed the time from before.
She couldn't even have him fill her up for now.
She could only wait until they were safer.
Not to mention, having a kid here would be too dangerous.
Who knows how long they would stay here.
With each having thoughts of their own, they began to eat.

chapters.title: Chapter 632 The Dragon
paragraphs: Vritra and the others followed Bull's group as they walked through the sewage passage. There was no waste and no stench.
Before long, a ladder appeared before them. Bull was the first to climb up.
Of course, the surface was covered in snow, but she pressed her hand up and flames burst out.
The snow melted quickly, pushing off the lid as she moved out.
Soon, the group consisting of a total of 82 people had gotten out. Vritra's group followed after them, and as they came out, they were surprised by the surroundings.
More than half of the buildings had collapsed and the ground appeared dug up.
In the distance, the signs of the blast caused by them yesterday were still visible.
"Looks like a powerful mutant passed through here." Bull said. This was good, those guys wouldn't expect an attack at this time.
"Let's keep moving, hurry up, we have to catch them by surprise!" she shouted, before fixing her gaze on Vritra.
"Adam, you will be taking the lead later on." She added.
Soon, the group started moving. Of course, such a big group was bound to attract surrounding mutants, but they just needed to look out for stronger ones.
Just a few moments later, several mutants rushed in their direction.
Vritra pulled out a machete, rushing forward at exceptional speed and cutting off their heads.
'Oh! Looks like he is trying to impress me. He is a smart guy, it wouldn't be bad to have him around if he becomes loyal.'
Bull saw this and made up her mind that if he could survive, she would definitely keep him close.
On the other hand, Vritra was just collecting some extra points, while also having another motive for this.
On the way ahead, he killed over twenty mutants.
Bull was quite impressed and convinced that he was just putting on a show for her.
Before the apocalypse, a handsome and tall guy like him wouldn't even look at her. She felt quite happy to have his attention.
"Good job, Adam. We are already quite close." She said, pointing to a school which was surrounded by a high wall.
The wall was clearly reinforced with more materials and traps.
"Take your positions, kill all men, leave none behind!!" she shouted, as the men arranged themselves into formation.
The wall was clearly reinforced with more materials and traps.
"Take your positions, kill all men, leave none behind!!" she shouted, as the men arranged themselves into formation.
Of course, Vritra and the nine others were positioned at the forefront. They would be the first to die.
The men looked sadly, not wanting those beautiful women to die just like this.
TRRRRRRRRR
Suddenly, the alarm inside the school began to ring. Before the attack even began, they were exposed.
"Damnit, which fucker dared to rat us out?" she looked around angrily but couldn't find anyone.
"Let's just charge!!" she roared.
"Wait, Bull! Are you sure you want to attack us? We are already prepared for this. Looks like your group isn't as united as you thought.
Anyway, if you attack, it will attract those giant mutants. Are you sure?" a tall man walked close to the boundary wall, smiling mockingly.
"You fucker, I am going to kill you today, no matter what. Even if I have to sacrifice all these pawns for that, I will not let you live." Bull shouted. It seemed they had great enmity between them.
'Sigh, when survival itself is already so difficult, these guys are playing revenge games without even having proper strength?' Vritra shook his head.
Then he stood beside Bull and said confidently.
"Don't worry, Bull, let me take care of him. I have a special move that will turn the tide of this war." He announced, surprising both sides.
"Huh? What do you- Alright, I trust you, Adam. Go ahead and show what you have got." Bull tried to act tough, even as doubts popped up in her mind.
'What's this guy planning now? Maybe he is still trying to impress me. Wasn't his ability just speed? What can he even do?' she wondered.
Vritra raised both his hands, his palms pointing towards the sky as if he was about to bring down a great calamity.
Getting the signal, the nine in his group secretly took a few steps back, ready to follow through with their plans.
"What is that guy doing? Did you catch a fraud? He surely is putting on quite a sho-"
But suddenly, everyone stared at the sky in bafflement as a large blood red dragon suddenly flew up from behind the group.
This was the reason Vritra was killing those mutants. He had collected the blood too.
The massive dragon was made entirely of mutant blood.
"Whoa, a dragon? H- How did he?" everyone was shocked as the majestic dragon flew high into the sky.
"A- Adam, you really have such an ability?!!" Bull suddenly felt this guy was too important to be wasted as cannon fodder.
She decided to give him the highest position in her group. With that powerful dragon, they were sure to win.
The enormous dragon flew around above them all. It scared both sides.
It suddenly opened its mouth wide as if to roar, making everyone's hearts freeze. Especially the Bull Eaters, they felt as if they were about to die.
BOOM
But suddenly, the dragon exploded as if it had run out of power.
"W- What? That's all? What is the meaning of this, Adam?!!" Bull was shocked and then angered.
"Hahahaha! So he really is a fraud. I won't lie, you really had me for a moment. Hahaha, such a good trick, Bull. What a great team!" the leader from the other side laughed madly.
She glared at him, then turned to look at Vritra, demanding answers.
TIP TIP TIP TIP
Suddenly, a bloody rain began to fall from the sky, drenching everyone in the stench of rotten blood.
Vritra had noticed one thing. Although mutants wouldn't eat one another, they were always attracted to blood.
Not a single drop of blood fell on him or anyone in his family, stopping right above their heads.
"What are you waiting for? RUN!!" Vritra shouted as he turned and ran at full speed. His family reacted instantly.
The people inside and outside the school were dazed for a moment before finally realizing it was blood.
"T- That bastard, he is trying to lure mutants here!!" they all realized. With so much blood, all the surrounding mutants would be attracted.
"ADAM!! YOU ARE GOING TO DIE!!" Bull screamed. She had started to like him, and he played such a trick.
Ignoring everything, she rushed in his direction, only to be bombarded by a mix of skills.
Her body grew weak, and she even got poisoned by the blood falling on her.
For an instant, her body froze before she broke free and tried to chase them.
Vritra had already instructed them about their escape plan. Just as he expected, after a few moments, a large number of mutants began heading in that direction.
All the people panicked and began to run around.
"Yenni, take them away to safety first. I will be there soon." He shouted, changing direction.
"Husband..." Yennefer looked reluctant, but she wasted no time as the ground began to sink rapidly, and within moments they were swallowed by the earth.
The surface closed, and they were gone without a trace.
A massive horde of mutants began rushing towards the blood.
'I can't let such a good chance go to waste. Let's see how much I can grow with this.' Vritra thought, but suddenly a wave of flames engulfed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 633 Flame Body
paragraphs: Vritra had just taken a few steps when a wave of flames struck his body from behind.
BOOM!
His body was blasted forward, his back badly burnt as he coughed blood, feeling pain all over.
'E- Evomorph, activate!' he thought, pushing himself up despite the burning pain.
[Evomorph Activated!]
Instantly, Vritra could feel his skin healing. The speed was slow at first but kept increasing rapidly.
As if his body itself was undergoing some sort of evolution.
The changes continued, and before long the burning sensation had reduced greatly.
Pulling out two machetes from his inventory, he flashed forward and cut off the heads of two mutants.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +59}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +56}
Bull didn't stop. Seeing that he was injured, she started chasing after him even more desperately.
'Add the three points to agility!' he instructed.
[Agility: 25.9]
Instantly, there was a big boost in his speed as he shot forward, staying away from the powerful mutants and killing the others.
Blood started to float around him, forming dozens of blades which kept shooting out like bullets.
Even as he killed the mutants, his stats and sin points kept increasing rapidly.
"You are going to die, Adam!! How dare you trick me!" Bull screamed. She had a very short temper, and once she hated someone, she would go to any length to take her revenge.
She felt that if she didn't kill him now, then it wouldn't be possible ever.
BOOM
A wave of flames struck Vritra again, but this time, because the distance was greater, he wasn't blasted away.
But the flames still began to burn his skin, only for his body to keep undergoing mutation.
The pain soon reduced quite a bit, and it felt like he had become a little resistant to fire.
[You have acquired Flame Body!]
'Hmm? Flame Body? Does it make me invincible against flames?" Vritra thought as he stabbed the machete into the head of one of the humans from the
Firebull group.
BOOM
Bull struck again. Vritra's body was instantly engulfed by flames, but not only did he not suffer, he could also feel a connection with the flames.
With a thought, the flames around his body converged into a fireball that floated before him.
'Whoa, so I can control flames too? This Evomorph has become even more powerful!!' he exclaimed. But it seemed for now he couldn't generate flames of his own.
Though he could turn blood into flames, making it even more deadly, with higher control than even Bull.
"W-What? My flames have no effect on him and he even controlled them?!! No, there is no way!" Bull refused to believe her eyes. This must be another one of his tricks.
But Vritra was just dashing around at full speed, killing mutants left and right.
Though the number was increasing too rapidly, before long even running would be impossible.
Suddenly, an idea struck his mind.
[Blood Manipulation Activated!]
From all the bodies piled around, blood suddenly started to fly up and then converged.
After a few moments, it took the shape of a blood dragon, even bigger than before.
"That trick again? Do you plan to attract more mutants? No matter what, you are going to die today!" Bull shouted, shooting out waves of flames.
His speed kept increasing too rapidly. She was finding it hard to keep up.
"Thanks for the flames." Vritra said as he abruptly stopped.
With one hand pointed towards the enormous dragon, the flames converged in front of his other hand.
As he pointed both his hands upward, the flames collided with the dragon.
Under Bull's disbelieving gaze, the body of the dragon was surrounded by
flames. It looked like a majestic flaming dragon.
Even many mutants paused to look at the terrifying figure.
Panic rose in her heart for a moment as she moved back, feeling that if it struck
her, she might be gravely injured.
Suddenly, Vritra brought the massive flaming dragon down near Bull and a large number of mutants, its mouth wide open as if roaring.
BOOOOM!!
The blood exploded like fuel. Both of Vritra's skills seemed to complement each other very well, even the nature of the blood had changed.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +63}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +55}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +69}
Messages after messages began to pop up. Vritra, who was feeling a bit exhausted, instantly felt a wave of warmth and relief engulf him.
His stats increased once again.
For a moment, he just stood there, gazing at the damage caused by his new
skill.
Quite a lot of mutants had just been killed, though there were still many left. Unfortunately, Bull wasn't dead, but fortunately, she was badly injured.
And Vritra wasn't going to let a future enemy escape.
Bringing out the machetes, he shot in her direction, killing mutants along the
way.
Bull lay on the ground, panting heavily, disbelief written all over her face.
'How is it possible? How could he use my ability? I have to escape!!' Urgency
rose in her mind. Pushing up her injured body, she looked around.
Her eyes widened as she saw Vritra heading in her direction.
Her flames no longer worked on him. Her strength might be a little higher, but
with his speed, she wouldn't even be able to touch him.
Now there was no way to kill him, but she was sure she could at least run.
"Hey, Bull, don't tell me you are thinking of running." Vritra said, slicing a mutant in half at the waist before cutting its head off.
"Let's forget our enmity. Soon, dangerous mutants will be here. If we fight, both
of us will just die needlessly. She muttered, gazing around for a way to escape.
He already knew about the underground space, so going there would be
useless.
"Even if that's the case, I can't let you leave." He said, dodging a mutant's attack from behind and plunging the blade into its brain.
"I can promise never to look for you..." gritting her teeth, she muttered.
"I don't believe it." Vritra said and charged forward, his speed far surpassing
Bull's.
Taking a metal pole from the ground, she waved it around messily while shooting out flame blasts.
Only the blasts could still injure him and buy her time.
BOOM
An attack grazed Vritra's shoulder, but the injury healed within moments.
"How is it possible? Just how many skills do you possess? I never harmed you
or your family. Just let me go." She muttered, feeling helpless.
But Vritra wasn't the only danger here.
BANG
A humanoid mutant whose body resembled a grasshopper suddenly jumped in
their direction, striking the two.
Vritra was fine, but Bull was bitten by it. Her arm started to bleed as the mutant
bit off a small chunk of her flesh.
"Ughh, damnit. Haa haa. I really have no chance of surviving now, do I?" Blasting
away the cricket, she mumbled.
After over six months of struggle, this was how her life was going to end.
The apocalypse really does change people. She had completely forgotten her original goals and methods.
And now, as life flashed before her eyes, Bull felt regret for quite a few things.

or your family.
Just let me go." She muttered, feeling helpless.
But Vritra wasn't the only danger here.
BANG
A humanoid mutant whose body resembled a grasshopper suddenly jumped in
their direction, striking the two.
Vritra was fine, but Bull was bitten by it.
Her arm started to bleed as the mutant
bit off a small chunk of her flesh.
"Ughh, damnit.
Haa haa.
I really have no chance of surviving now, do I?" Blasting
away the cricket, she mumbled.
After over six months of struggle, this was how her life was going to end.
The apocalypse really does change people.
She had completely forgotten her original goals and methods.
And now, as life flashed before her eyes, Bull felt regret for quite a few things.

chapters.title: Chapter 634 The Mutant Slaughter
paragraphs: 'Why does this apocalypse have to arrive, my life... was just starting to get better.' Bull sighed, she had seen the horrors of the apocalypse.
Humans became worse than animals; rape, murder, cannibalism, it all became normal.
A planet with no rules, with no right or wrong and with no fear of punishment.
But what was the point of thinking now, Bull looked at Vritra and asked:
"How did ughh you... survive this long?" Seeing their group, it didn't seem like she had even witnessed the tragedies of the apocalypse.
Vritra made the head of the grasshopper mutant explode, then looked back at her.
"Well, we just arrived here." After speaking, he walked towards her, holding the bloodied machetes.

"Haa survive this hell if y- you can, and if... you have enough strength p- please kill those bastards i- inside COUGH they k- killed my sister a- and they... did things to her..." she coughed violently, her skin turning black.
To maintain the big group, she had always acted tough and never showed vulnerability or talked about her past.
"Well, thanks for telling me, I need to harvest more points so I will clear them up while I am at it." Vritra muttered.
Any mutant who tried to get close had its head pierced by a blade made of blood.
"T- Thank you..." she muttered, closing her eyes. Her body was rapidly undergoing mutation; she too was turning into a mutant zombie.
For a few moments, Vritra stood still, then raising his hand, he slashed at her neck, killing Bull in a single strike.
"Sigh, all of this is happening just for someone's fun?" Vritra felt really annoyed, this normal planet had been turned into a playground.
The lives of all the people had no meaning except for being NPCs for the real players to level up.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +204}
'I should hurry over before more stronger mutants arrive.' He turned, but then pointed his hand towards Bull's corpse.
Blood suddenly enveloped her, then it started to burn. Within moments, Bull's body was cremated.
In the end, killing her gave him no satisfaction of victory. Some people were truly evil and some had changed slightly.
Bull was clearly not a bad person, still Vritra wasn't going to let her live after their conflict.
"Quite a lot of mutants have gathered already, the explosion was pretty loud. Let's spam it!" Rushing forward, his speed kept increasing.
His body soon looked like a blur as he moved among the horde of mutants, cutting their bodies apart.
And then another dragon started to take shape in the air.
He looked around at the place with the highest number of mutants and saw the entrance of the school.
Quite a lot of mutants were trying to enter.
"Perfect." Stomping his foot, his body shot upwards.
He stood atop the corpse of a fat mutant and ignited the surface of the blood giant.
"T- That guy again? What is he planning to do now?" the leader and the others inside saw the terrifying flame dragon, their hearts almost stopping.
The school was quite safe, they had even reinforced the walls, making it very difficult for anyone to enter.
The mutants were yet to break through the outer wall.
But they had limited space to escape too, if they truly got surrounded then most would certainly die.
With a wave of Vritra's hand, the blood giant descended.
BOOOOM!
Another big explosion took place, dozens upon dozens of mutants were swallowed by the explosion, many even burning to death.
Pieces of their bodies were scattered and the snow was starting to melt.
The wall had finally been broken, but it was covered by the corpses of the mutants.
'Why does it feel like the snowing is going to stop soon?' Vritra took a moment to look up at the sky, it wasn't snowing as heavily as before.
But he focused on the people inside the building, he couldn't let the mutants eat them up.
They were all sin points.
Vritra started running while slashing all the mutants around him.
The heads of many exploded suddenly, even his skill was getting stronger.
Another dragon started to take form in the sky, the people in the school were flabbergasted.
Wondering how he had so much energy, this was already the fourth dragon.
"GO!!" Vritra shouted as the flaming dragon flew low, but didn't explode this time.
With his constantly increasing strength, Vritra didn't need to make it explode and could make the dragon fly around for a while.
The dragon opened its mouth wide, devouring several people inside who helplessly launched attacks.
Over six men were swallowed by the flaming dragon, as their bodies started to burn at extreme temperatures.
It was like they were getting boiled alive.
After knowing that these people were scum, Vritra felt good killing them.
Several screams could be heard from inside the dragon's mouth as their bodies started to melt.
It was one of the most excruciating deaths.
Vritra jumped over the wall of corpses near the entrance of the school and moved inside.
Instantly, dozens of blades flew in his direction, those people understood they had to kill Vritra immediately before the dragon devoured them.
WHOOSH
BANG
With his high spiritual power, Vritra could clearly sense each blade and dodging was even easier.
He blocked a few in front with the machetes while running inside.
Suddenly, powerful laser light shot in his direction, almost taking Vritra by surprise.
Thankfully, his agility was very high, kicking off the ground he barely dodged.
He threw one of the blades towards the leader who was shooting lasers from his eyes, making him jump back in fright.
His physical stats weren't high, if not for the lasers, Bull would have killed him already.
Ignoring the others, Vritra flashed beside the leader.
SWISH
The feet of the leader were sliced off at the thighs, Vritra grabbed his head from the back as the leader screamed in madness.
ZRRRRRR
Lasers shot from his eyes as he flailed his arms around. Vritra held his head tightly, cutting off the limbs of all the members in his group but not killing them.
He even used the lasers to cut many mutants, leaving them barely alive.
'I wonder if I can use this skill too? But do I have to get hurt to learn it?' he wondered.
With some doubt, he brought his finger in front of the powerful laser, as it almost cut off his finger.
"Fuck!" pulling his hand back, he looked at his hand and saw his finger healing rapidly.
'Evomorph?' Sighing, he placed the blade at the side of the leader's head, then pushed forward with some strength.
The eyeballs and the nose of the leader were instantly cut off, as the lasers finally stopped, leaving the place full of groans and screams.
Vritra looked around at the brutal scene in which over fifty men lay broken and in pieces, yet not one of them was dead.
Throwing the leader's body up towards the dragon, Vritra ran towards the underlings.
MUNCH
The dragon caught the leader who was still screaming, and he too began to boil.
Running around, he cut off the heads of all the humans, without giving them any chance to fight back.
As the screams quieted down, Vritra could hear the faint, fearful voices of a few women from inside the building.
