chapters.title: Chapter 635 Monstrous Growth
paragraphs: Vritra heard the faint voices from inside the building.
They must have been the victims of this group.
He sighed; these women would certainly die if he just left.
So, he decided to help just a bit.
Vritra finally could no longer maintain the dragon; he made it crash into the distance.
BOOOM
Again, quite a few mutants had died.
The number had finally decreased quite a lot, but it seemed powerful ones were about to appear.
He ran into the building and found one room locked; with a slight twist, it broke.
The women screamed in terror, they were already frightened by the sounds of battle outside.
"Don't worry, those guys are dead, and if you want to survive, just stay hidden underground."
There were twenty or so of them, and Vritra found them pitiful.
The blade of the machete in his hand was suddenly covered by blood, as its size increased.
Then he turned it into a big drilling machine which rotated rapidly, digging a deep and large enough hole within moments.
"Hide there and don't come out for a while, not unless things are quiet." He said, before leaving them with some food and water.
There was a big stock in his inventory, and this much could last the group of women at least a year.
The rest they would have to figure out on their own; he would soon be leaving this planet after all.
As soon as he was done with his tasks, that is.
"T- Thank you..." one of the women finally managed to mutter, as they jumped into the hole with the help of the blood rope.
Vritra covered it up using materials from around, leaving enough space so that they wouldn't suffocate to death and could later leave.
Having killed several hundred mutants, he excitedly looked at his stats.
[Stats]
(Strength: 36.7)
(Endurance: 37.3)
(Agility: 42.3)
(Spiritual: 19.8)
{Free Attribute: 0}
{Sin Points: 32,660}
'Good, with such stats I could have easily killed that group before.' He thought, but he was not done yet.
"Draw rewards with 200 points, use all the points!" he said as the ethereal wheel took form before him.
[Congratulations, you have acquired a Machine Gun with 1000 Rounds.]
[Congratulations, you have acquired 100kg rice!]
[Congratulations, you have acquired a free attribute point!]
Quickly, 163 messages flashed before his eyes; there was a vast amount of supplies, to the point that it was overflowing.
He wouldn't be able to finish them in years.
But he focused on the main stuff first, the attribute points.
[5 Strength, 6 Agility, 6 Endurance, 9 Spiritual, 6 Free Attribute Points!]
Except for the free ones, all attributes were directly added, and Vritra felt a big change, his entire body engulfed by a comfortable sensation.
His muscles became firmer and his mind relaxed further; his stats had just crossed several bottlenecks, bringing a big qualitative leap.
(Strength: 41.7)
(Agility: 48.3)
(Endurance: 43.3)
(Spiritual: 28.8)
{Free Attribute: 6}
{Sin Points: 60}
Like before, he decided to keep the six free attribute points for now.
After leaving some extra supplies in the room, he left.
Walking out of the school, he let his senses spread far and wide, then activated blood manipulation.
All the blood started to fly up, and the dead bodies turned dry.
He walked away as the size of the dragon kept increasing; not a single corpse was left.
'I should return now, haa, this was a bit tiring.' He thought, making the dragon fly away, it would take away all the dangerous mutants.
This was rewarding, but the most dangerous mutants were yet to show up.
The blood dragon flew far enough and then burst into blood rain in an open area; soon the surroundings were covered by roars.
Vritra ran in the direction where Yennefer and the others were hidden.
Although they had not participated in the slaughter, their strength must have increased a little too.
"But how do I send the signal?" he paused, wondering.
THUMP THUMP THUMP
He stomped the ground as if knocking and waited.
After a minute, the ground parted slightly and Yennefer peeked out.
Upon seeing Vritra, she smiled, relief written all over her face.
"Husband, hurry inside."
The entrance opened as Vritra jumped inside.
Yennefer hugged him tightly; all of them had been so worried.
Soon they arrived several metres underground, where a room was built.
Everyone was waiting there.
"Honey!" all the women hugged him.
"How did it go, hubby?" Yasmine asked, clinging to his arm.
"Sigh..." after a deep sigh, Vritra explained everything.
Their expressions turned a bit gloomy; they had just arrived here and knew nothing of the horrors taking place.
"It's good that you killed them." Shit-Sonia said, feeling angry too.
"Anyway, we have to keep moving. We will head up soon." Vritra said, as he took out various food items, the ones he had just obtained.
Putting a table and several chairs around it, they all sat and began to eat while talking.
The sky outside had turned dark, and the snowfall had nearly stopped.
The ground trembled slightly, and then several figures moved out silently.
"Does it feel less cold than usual?" sensing the environment, Maeve spoke.
"Yeah, the climate must be pretty unstable here." Fiona said, this cold really didn't bother her.
"Let's walk a little and we will find some place to rest. It would be great if we can find a vehicle that can move over the snow." Vritra said.
They started walking over the snowy road silently, heading towards the tower.
"Master, how high were the stats of that giant mutant?" Maeve asked, walking beside Vritra.
None of them could see the mutant's stats but him.
"All its stats were above seventy. At my speed, I will be able to defeat that thing soon." Vritra answered with confidence.
"Husband, if we can find usable parts, I believe I can help build a powerful vehicle." Teresa spoke; her knowledge and genius were truly unmatched.
"Alright, Tess, we will need your help soon." Vritra said, patting her head.
The mutants in this area were mostly cleared up, so they walked undisturbed.
Plus, Maeve had covered them all with shadows, making them invisible.
AWOOOOO
Just then, they heard the howl of a beast.
The group stopped and stepped back, standing near a building.
"That sounded like a mutant beast, and it's coming closer?" Vanessa whispered, ready to use her abilities.
Vritra narrowed his eyes as he sensed several figures moving at high speed over the snowy road.
"There are at least ten presences." He added in a low voice; it didn't seem the other side had noticed them yet.
After a few tense moments, two big wolves came into view, and they were dragging what seemed to be a carriage.
There were around eight people in the carriage, which was also carrying some supplies.
They moved very quickly, passing by the ten of them and soon disappearing into the distance.
"Well, that's... also a way of transport." Maeve muttered, but unfortunately for them, no one possessed skills to tame beasts.
"Yeah, maybe we should catch a beast tamer or something, that way travelling will be faster." Vritra nodded.
Going by foot would take a very long time like this.
And they also needed someone who was used to these streets and the dangers here.
"Let's keep moving, ahead might be more survivors."
And so, the group continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 636 Butcher
paragraphs: Walking in the darkness, the group of ten crossed five kilometres before arriving in front of a long hanging bridge.
The river below was frozen, but the ice seemed thin, and there were a lot of vehicles covered by snow on the bridge.

"Looks like the bridge is over two kilometres long. Now that the ice is frozen, we could have walked over it, but for such low temperatures, the ice is too thin." Vritra muttered as they stopped before the bridge.
"Yes, I think there might be something dangerous in the water below, or it might just be filled with a lot of mutants." Yasmine spoke.
"If we take a detour, it will waste too much time." Fiona added. This was their best option, but for some reason, it felt dangerous.
"Let's cross while it's still dark."
After discussing, they decided to cross the bridge.
The snow had completely covered the vehicles, so walking over it was actually easier.
With the shadows covering them all, they began moving over the bridge, which was swaying lightly.
Many mutants were frozen in the snow, but there were still some dangerous ones.
'I need better weapons. Isn't there anything good in the Sin Wheel?' he wondered. Maybe he needed to use more points for that.
CRACK
Just after walking a hundred metres or so, they heard a faint noise of bone breaking and saw two mutants munching over a human skeleton.
Sighing, Vritra just used blood manipulation to make their brains explode.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +52}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +57}
"Haa, it's so high. I am afraid of heights..." Monk Shit-Sonia muttered, clinging to Onest.
This was also why he never liked flying.
"Would you rather prefer walking over that ice then?" Vritra asked, smiling.
"Ah, n- no, I guess this is fine." Shit-Sonia shook his head immediately. The river looked too scary.
He wasn't afraid of anything, but there was still so much evil he needed to commit.
How could he leave this world in others' irresponsible hands?
They walked forward carefully, but nothing special happened even after walking nearly a kilometre.
"Maybe we were just worried for nothing. What could go wro-" Onest was speaking, looking at the peaceful bridge.
But Vritra suddenly silenced him.
"Don't jinx it. If something does happen, I will be throwing you away first." He warned sternly. A jinx was the last thing he needed.
Onest gulped and nodded. He had almost forgotten about Vritra's great luck. He was a trouble magnet.
'Fuck, I almost got us wiped out.' Onest was covered in sweat.
Vritra became even more cautious. He killed a few more mutants along the way, keeping everything completely silent.
'I thought there would be more mutants here, but the bridge is quite empty. Did someone clear it before?'
They had crossed most of the bridge, and now only a quarter was left.
The other city was almost in view. Just a little longer, and they could have crossed the bridge peacefully.
Grrrr... Grrrr...
Just then, they heard loud breathing noises and soon noticed a big mutant covered by snow lying on the bridge.
It was asleep, its body quite enormous, maybe even larger than the one they had seen before.
With so much snow covering the mutant, it was hard to see it properly.
This mutant's neck was especially long, but it had a thin body. Thankfully, there was enough space to pass by.
Shh...
Vritra gestured to everyone. They couldn't fight this thing, especially not here.
'It looks like a heavy sleeper. I don't think it will notice us.'
Vritra calmed his rapidly beating heart, grabbing Teresa's and Yasmine's hands.
They walked extremely carefully, their speed slowing down even further.
"D- Did you hear that, husband?" Teresa whispered, feeling faint vibrations in the bridge.
"Yeah, something is coming." Vritra moved back, nearer to the railing of the bridge.
Just after a few minutes, they saw a familiar carriage.
'No, it is different from the previous one, but they must be from the same group.' Vritra concluded.
Over five wolves were dragging the large carriage, and it was carrying a large number of supplies.
Despite moving so fast, it wasn't releasing any noise.
If it wasn't for the faint vibrations, none of them would have even noticed this carriage.
Inside the carriage, a man in leather clothes with the appearance of a butcher and a bulky body sat with a woman on his lap.
"Boss, it seems we have looted most of the area in Dover, and the remaining area is already taken by strong groups." An underling spoke.
Aside from the butcher and the woman, there were three other men.
The woman looked nervous, uncomfortable and afraid.
She was only in her early twenties and looked pretty, but that was a curse in the apocalypse.
"Then we will loot another city next. This never gets boring, haha." The leader laughed, his hand roaming over the woman's thighs.
"We are now near the sleeping mutant boss." The person controlling the wolves said.
"Just continue. With my sound ability, we have nothing to fear." the butcher said.
Because of his appearance, he had gotten the same nickname.
After a few moments, one of the men in the carriage frowned and spoke, "Boss, I can sense several people here. There are nine of them."
"Oh? But I can't see anyone." The leader stepped over the seat and looked around from the sunroof, seeing nothing but darkness and snow.
"They must be hidden here." The other man said.
He was using his ability and could clearly sense them.
The carriage stopped.
Activating his ability, the butcher fixed his gaze on the spot pointed out by his underling and spoke.
"Hey guys, why stay hidden? Why don't you come out to greet us? Or are you afraid?"
Vritra frowned. This guy was trouble. He could feel that the man in leather was planning something.
Stepping out of the darkness, Vritra spoke with an expressionless face, "What do you want?"
'Huh? He was there too? I couldn't sense him. He is strong!' the man was shocked. He could still sense the other nine, but not Vritra.
He quickly told this to his leader.
"Haha, why don't I give you a ride back? I am sure you are heading to Linden as well. We can go together." the butcher said.
"It's alright. There is not much distance left. I can go by foot." Vritra replied, frowning.
"Anyway, who else is hidden with you, brother? Do you need some food? Or-" the butcher spoke with a big smile on his face.
"No. You can just leave." A red fluid started to flow around Vritra threateningly.
"Hey, hey, calm down, brother. I am not trying to pick a fight. We are leaving, don't worry." He chuckled before gesturing.
The wolves started moving again as the carriage began to leave.
Once they had moved a bit away, Vritra finally heaved a sigh of relief.
This place was full of scum.
But before they could even start moving, the butcher shouted from the distance.
"Brother, how about I leave this woman behind for you?
See, I only had good feelings towards you. This is our parting gift. Hope you enjoy it."
Right after speaking, he slit the throat of the woman in the carriage with a knife and threw her on the bridge, as the carriage quickly moved away.

chapters.title: Chapter 637 First Tragedy
paragraphs: Vritra and the others were shocked watching Butcher slit the woman's throat and then throw her on the bridge.
His laughter rang as the carriage drew away quickly.
"That bastard!" Vritra cursed before shouting: "RUN!"
Without caring about the darkness or anything, the group sprinted forward at full speed.
Pausing beside the woman, Diana tried healing her while Vritra quickly threw away the accumulated blood and stopped the bleeding.
"S- She is already dead..." Diana muttered, even if it's the apocalypse, how could a life become so cheap?
From the distance, Butcher who was still seeing them was shocked to see so many beautiful women there.
'What a waste, damnit I should have just killed him haa' Butcher felt really bad seeing that all those beauties were about to die.
They felt even more enraged towards that guy, but right now, they have to quickly leave or—
'Wait, did the snoring of the mutant pause?' Vritra's heart skipped a beat as he noticed it.
Without even glancing back, he created a blood rope which quickly tied around everyone's hand.
"Let's hurr—"
ROAARRRRRRR
A terrifying roar resounded far and wide as the noise of ice breaking sounded, the mutant was awake!!
Vritra, full of rage, pulled at the blood rope and sprinted forward at full speed.
But the mutant had already smelled the blood and was hungry.
Glancing back, he finally got to see the large mutant. Its body was thin but its arms had such long claws, it was impossible to relate it to any living thing.
Maybe it was a sea creature who had mutated and moved out, its body just looked like a large piece of meat wrapped by several layers of makeshift skin.
BANG BANG
The mutant swung its arms around, it had been asleep for too long and had now gone mad because of starvation.
The metallic ropes holding the hanging bridge began to snap one after another, the sharp claws even cut off a big part of the bridge.
This thing was too terrifying, despite Vritra's best effort he couldn't run far before the bridge began to swing violently.
It wouldn't be a problem if he was alone but carrying everyone else while making sure of their safety, greatly slowed him.
BOOOM
Finally unable to hold on, the bridge snapped around the tall mutant, and Vritra and all the others were thrown towards the river instantly.
They landed heavily onto the ice surface but it seemed the ice was not as thin as they expected.
Cracks appeared over it but it held on.
"Keep moving!" Vritra rose to his feet, but just then the large monster and a part of the bridge also landed heavily.
BAANNNGGGG
The ice finally snapped, and all ten of them were instantly drowned in the freezing water.
Quite a few mutant fishes and aquatic mutants rushed in their direction, attacking the humans and the large mutant.
They coughed, feeling the cold water rushing into their bodies.
All of them tried to rush up towards the surface, thankfully the blood rope still kept them all close.
[Evomorph Activated!]
Vritra suddenly felt a warm current pass through his body, his body undergoing a quick mutation.
Within moments, he could actually breathe under the water and felt quite agile.
Even his eyes adjusted and he also started to get used to the cold.
With urgency in his heart, he pulled at the blood rope to pull everyone.
SNAP
But somehow the rope snapped, and Vritra could feel the presence of a dangerous mutant there.
His heart thumping wildly, he swam at full speed.
Catching the ones closest to him first while making the heads of many mutant fishes explode.
Yennefer also used her water and air attributes and adjusted quickly, she saw the situation and began to help others.
Teresa created a room around her and held her breath, she glanced around but couldn't see anything.
Moving quickly, Vritra grabbed Fiona and Diana's hands before pulling them up.
He created a surface from blood and pushed them onto it.
Then he dived again.
Yennefer pulled Vanessa and Teresa, pushing the two onto the same platform.
"Haa haa" taking deep breaths, she too went back into the water.
Onest somehow managed to rise up to the surface, no creatures in the water could touch him.
Vritra swam towards Yasmine and Shitless while Yennefer swam towards Maeve.
A long arm which seemed like a tentacle suddenly appeared from the depths of the water, rushing quickly towards Yasmine.
'Noo!!' Vritra kicked hard, rushing in her direction while shooting out blades made of blood.
But that creature's defence was too high, the blades couldn't even cut through its skin.
Shitless was holding his breath, rapidly swinging his arms and legs to move up.
He too seemed to notice the tentacle. Turning with all his might, he pushed Yasmine away.
The tentacle wrapped around his feet and dragged him away into the darkness.
Vritra's eyes opened wide, he quickly held Yasmine before sending a rope made of blood forward.
But it wasn't fast enough, within moments, Shitless disappeared from his sight.
Swimming up, he brought the dragoness to the surface at the same time as Yennefer.
He quickly looked at them and saw that except Shitless, everyone had climbed up.
"Climb up, I will be back in a moment." Vritra said before going down at full speed.
"Wait husband—" Yennefer called out, but he was already gone.
She climbed onto the blood platform and began to help others.
Vritra killed dozens of mutant fishes, but earning sin points was the last thing on his mind.
He went deeper and searched around but there was no trace of Shitless.
As he moved deeper the number of mutants increased, and he began to feel uncomfortable because of the coldness and water pressure.
Vritra still kept searching, but Shitless was really gone.
After he couldn't hold on, Vritra moved back up.
HUFF HUFF
He took long breaths before climbing up to the platform, his mind feeling like a mess.
"W- Where is monk Shitless?" Yasmine asked, she knew it was him who saved her at the last moment.
"... I couldn't find him." Vritra said, a deep frown on his face and a terrible feeling settling in his heart.
Although Shitless was full of troubles, both Onest and he were his best friends, almost like brothers.
He had brought them here so they could grow as well and not lag behind, but now...
The big mutant had drowned into the water and had disappeared, though it probably wasn't dead.
"We... have to keep moving." Vritra said, he wanted to keep searching but that would put everyone in danger.
And Shitless might already be dead.
The mood of the group sank, Yasmine felt especially bad, he disappeared while saving her.
For a few moments all of them just sat there, their minds devoid of any thoughts.
Yennefer used the air attribute to push the blood platform forward as the group moved away from there.
They remained completely silent during the remaining short journey.
In such a short time and they had already lost someone, this was a harsh lesson of an apocalyptic planet.
And the treachery of the human heart, they all felt sad and angry.
Before long they had drifted to the land, Shitless the talkative member of the group was gone, and the group felt especially empty.

chapters.title: Chapter 638 The Intelligent Mutant
paragraphs: "Let's set a grave for him here."
The sky was already turning bright, after landing on the ground, they formed a grave right beside the bridge.
Vritra carved Shitless's name on the wood, and created the grave.
"..." after lingering there for a few moments, they turned and started to walk towards the new city.
Getting closer to their goal.
Vritra swore to find Butcher and torture him to his death.
"Let's find a building to rest, we will get sick if we continue." Vritra said in a low emotionless voice.
They walked away, before long finding a residential building.
But seeing its condition, it seemed to be full of mutants.
"Honey, let's clear a floor and rest in a room here." Vanessa said.
The snowfall had already stopped, but the accumulated snow was already quite high.
Moving towards the building, they decided to find a room on the fifth floor, staying too low could also be dangerous.
With Vritra's current strength, such weak mutants posed no threat.
The group killed the mutants and soon arrived at the 5th floor, they went through the few apartments.
There were no survivors on this floor.
Onest took the apartment opposite to Vritra's, giving them some alone time.
He too was feeling terrible, Shitless and he had been together for so long now.
With a dejected look, he changed up and lay on the bed, closing his eyes to sleep.
In the other apartment, they took bath and changed into another set of warm clothes.
Thankfully their attributes were high enough that no one fell ill despite falling into that freezing water.
"Let's eat together, I will call Onest over." Vritra said, walking out of the apartment.
"Okay, we will get the food ready." The goddess said, as they got busy.
Even the tasty and warm food didn't lift their mood, a feeling of urgency to grow stronger rose in their hearts.
'Divine, is there nothing I can do to bring Shitless back?' Vritra asked, divine was his last option.
"Haa I had informed you already, anyone who dies here could never be brought back. Just continue your journey, your goal is far more important than one life. It will be fine, don't worry."
The divine said, as if he doesn't really care about this matter.
'...' Vritra thought he would help, after all Shitless was helping his sister, but maybe even divine's strength was limited.
Sighing again, he absent mindedly glanced at his status panel, Vritra had killed quite a lot of mutants earlier in the water.
{Sin Points: 6,839}
[Stats]
(Strength: 42.9)
(Agility: 49.8)
(Endurance: 44.9)
(Spiritual: 29.4)
{Free Attribute: 6}
'My agility is close to fifty, I wonder if there will be any big changes after this bottleneck?' he wondered.
After eating, they rested for a while.
Vritra lay over the bed with his wives, just then he heard a faint knock on the door.
He frowned, upon sensing the presence, it didn't seem to be Onest.
'Did a mutant come from the upper floors?' without disturbing his sleeping wives, he got off the bed and silently approached the door.
Taking out a machete he looked through the peep hole while maintaining some safe distance.
And just as he thought, it indeed seemed to be a mutant.
It was covered in strange green vines, looking disgusting with its skin red as an apple.
'Looks like it's a mutant with high intelligence.' Vritra unlocked the door and swung the machete, aiming to cut its head off in one fluid motion without giving it any time.
"Kiyaaaaaa PITIFUL ONEEEE, ITS ME SHITLESSSSSS!!" The mutant suddenly screamed, jumping back in haste.
'What a cunning mutant, how did it even know Shitless? It could even make same noise and expression?' Vritra paused for a moment, then became even firm in his decision.
He can't let such smart mutant live, how could Shitless be alive after that.
He swung the machete again.
"W- Wait, it's me, Shit Sonia? Remember, I used to pee on the temples. Ughh cough I am Shitless!!" the mutant shouted.
Vritra paused, looking doubtfully at him.
"What is your favourite activity?" with a dubious expression he asked.
"S- Spreading evil, and going on rides with Bullo!!" the mutant answered, both its hands raised in fear.
The others woke up by the commotion and were shocked to see the mutant resembling Shitless.
"What?!! Did Shitless turn into a mutant or is it a mutant pretending to be Shitless?" Onest ran out and looked flabbergasted.
"This mutant is pretending to be Shitless." Vritra said, staring at the red creature, the blade inches away from its throat.
"I am real, this is Shitless!!" the mutant seemed really afraid.
"Hmm really? Then answer me, what happened when we were destroying that one temple with that big moustache priest?" Onest asked doubtfully.
"M- My ass was set on fire, a- and I rubbed the flames off to you. We almost became torches!" the mutant answered, honesty dripping from its face.
"No that's an easy question, recite the 29 times table?" Onest said, sternly.
"H- Huh? T- Twenty nine uh..." the mutant struggled.
"Forget it, here is a simpler question: If 29 zombies each bite 29 people, and each person then bites 29 more, how many people are turning into zombies?" Onest asked seriously.
"You mugger bastard, what kind of questions are these? Get your ass bit and check." The mutant cursed.
"Oh you want to bite my ass? Pfftt... hahaha" Onest could no longer hold back his laughter, pulling the wet Shitless into a tight hug.
Vritra too put away the machete, his heart finally feeling at ease. He had forgotten that Shitless could always return from the impossible situations, he somehow always survives.
"Are you alright? Why do you look like this? How did you survive and find us?" Vritra asked a lot of questions, hugging Shitless before moving back and looking him up and down.
"Haa I turned into Sonia and somehow that mutant threw me out with its poop, somehow my body became like that." While shivering Shitless explained.

"All mutants actually ignored me, they too believed I am a zombie. As for finding you, I just saw your tracks. Now that the snowfall has stopped, it wasn't difficult." Shitless said proudly, he used his brain after so long.
"Thank you." Yasmine walked forward and said earnestly, she was happy that he was alive and back.
"Haha Sister, don't worry, I am not easy to kill." Shitless chuckled, lightly punching his chest.
Vritra didn't really care much about how he survived, he was just happy that he was back.
The mood of the group was once again lifted up. Shitless took a bath and changed clothes, he wrapped himself into several layers of blanket and even while eating.
"Oh right while coming here I saw a tomb, guess what, someone here actually has same name as me!!" Shitless exclaimed, he never thought he would share his name with someone, much less a dead person.
"Yeah maybe that was your soulmate, sadly you didn't go up to meet that person." Vritra sighed, although he felt better now, a big weight lifted off his chest.
But his anger towards that group has not decreased in the slightest.
Before leaving this city, he planned to find them and kill those bastards.
But for now, he allowed himself to relax.

sentences.text: "Let's set a grave for him here."
The sky was already turning bright, after landing on the ground, they formed a grave right beside the bridge.
Vritra carved Shitless's name on the wood, and created the grave.
"..." after lingering there for a few moments, they turned and started to walk towards the new city.
Getting closer to their goal.
Vritra swore to find Butcher and torture him to his death.
"Let's find a building to rest, we will get sick if we continue." Vritra said in a low emotionless voice.
They walked away, before long finding a residential building.
But seeing its condition, it seemed to be full of mutants.
"Honey, let's clear a floor and rest in a room here." Vanessa said.
The snowfall had already stopped, but the accumulated snow was already quite high.
Moving towards the building, they decided to find a room on the fifth floor, staying too low could also be dangerous.
With Vritra's current strength, such weak mutants posed no threat.
The group killed the mutants and soon arrived at the 5th floor, they went through the few apartments.
There were no survivors on this floor.
Onest took the apartment opposite to Vritra's, giving them some alone time.
He too was feeling terrible, Shitless and he had been together for so long now.
With a dejected look, he changed up and lay on the bed, closing his eyes to sleep.
In the other apartment, they took bath and changed into another set of warm clothes.
Thankfully their attributes were high enough that no one fell ill despite falling into that freezing water.
"Let's eat together, I will call Onest over." Vritra said, walking out of the apartment.
"Okay, we will get the food ready." The goddess said, as they got busy.
Even the tasty and warm food didn't lift their mood, a feeling of urgency to grow stronger rose in their hearts.
'Divine, is there nothing I can do to bring Shitless back?' Vritra asked, divine was his last option.
"Haa I had informed you already, anyone who dies here could never be brought back.
Just continue your journey, your goal is far more important than one life.
It will be fine, don't worry."
The divine said, as if he doesn't really care about this matter.
'...' Vritra thought he would help, after all Shitless was helping his sister, but maybe even divine's strength was limited.
Sighing again, he absent mindedly glanced at his status panel, Vritra had killed quite a lot of mutants earlier in the water.
{Sin Points: 6,839}
[Stats]
(Strength: 42.9)
(Agility: 49.8)
(Endurance: 44.9)
(Spiritual: 29.4)
{Free Attribute: 6}
'My agility is close to fifty, I wonder if there will be any big changes after this bottleneck?' he wondered.

He frowned, upon sensing the presence, it didn't seem to be Onest.
'Did a mutant come from the upper floors?' without disturbing his sleeping wives, he got off the bed and silently approached the door.
Taking out a machete he looked through the peep hole while maintaining some safe distance.
And just as he thought, it indeed seemed to be a mutant.
It was covered in strange green vines, looking disgusting with its skin red as an apple.
'Looks like it's a mutant with high intelligence.' Vritra unlocked the door and swung the machete, aiming to cut its head off in one fluid motion without giving it any time.
"Kiyaaaaaa PITIFUL ONEEEE, ITS ME SHITLESSSSSS!!" The mutant suddenly screamed, jumping back in haste.
'What a cunning mutant, how did it even know Shitless?
It could even make same noise and expression?' Vritra paused for a moment, then became even firm in his decision.
He can't let such smart mutant live, how could Shitless be alive after that.
He swung the machete again.
"W- Wait, it's me, Shit Sonia?
Remember, I used to pee on the temples.
Ughh cough I am Shitless!!" the mutant shouted.
Vritra paused, looking doubtfully at him.
"What is your favourite activity?" with a dubious expression he asked.
"S- Spreading evil, and going on rides with Bullo!!" the mutant answered, both its hands raised in fear.
The others woke up by the commotion and were shocked to see the mutant resembling Shitless.
"What?!!
Did Shitless turn into a mutant or is it a mutant pretending to be Shitless?" Onest ran out and looked flabbergasted.

"M- My ass was set on fire, a- and I rubbed the flames off to you.
We almost became torches!" the mutant answered, honesty dripping from its face.
"No that's an easy question, recite the 29 times table?" Onest said, sternly.

T- Twenty nine uh..." the mutant struggled.

"You mugger bastard, what kind of questions are these?
Get your ass bit and check." The mutant cursed.
"Oh you want to bite my ass?
Pfftt... hahaha" Onest could no longer hold back his laughter, pulling the wet Shitless into a tight hug.

chapters.title: Chapter 639 Again?!
paragraphs: Vritra was drinking coffee while standing over the balcony, gazing at the fucked up surroundings.
He could see quite a few mutants roaming the streets.
"The sea is far more dangerous than the lands, it seems. I should stay away until my strength is high enough." Vritra thought, planning to kill a few powerful mutants.
Yasmine walked up to him. She hugged him from behind, she was pretty close to death the previous day.
"Wifey, some people of this world are just as evil as those evil organizations in the Zoratian planet. They really have lost all humanity." Vritra mumbled.
He sighed. That butcher had killed a woman just to kill them.
"Yeah hubby, it is lawless times like this that bring out their true desires, their true personality.
Well, they are a good source of sin points for you, so we can kill them without hesitation." Yasmine said.
They were pretty used to such crimes, but this planet was so similar to Earth. Vritra hadn't expected people to become demons.
"Oh right, I wonder if there are still an army or any defence still working to protect people. Should we try using a radio or something?" she asked.
"Forget it, it doesn't affect our goal whether they are or not. Let's first clear this building and then we will hea-" Vritra paused amidst speaking, as a bright reflection made him shut his eyes.
Raising his hand, he looked at the building on the opposite side of the road.
At the seventh floor, someone was standing and using a small mirror to grab his attention.
There was a difference of a hundred or so metres between the two buildings.
There were two teens standing on the balcony. The girl was using the mirror while the boy was swinging his arms urgently.
They were trying not to create any sound.
"Hmm, looks like they need help." Vritra spoke. He could see them pretty clearly.
On the other side of the building, the girl looked quite weak and nervous as she kept flashing the light.
"Gary, have they seen us?" the girl who appeared to be seventeen or eighteen years old asked.
"I think so, they are looking at us." Gary, her older brother, hurriedly waved his arms.
"B- But will or can they help us?" Mira, the weak girl asked.
"..." Gary paused at this question, uncertainty filling his eyes.
"Idiot, don't stop." she said hurriedly in a low voice.
They were quite excited to see people appear in that building, which was previously brimming with mutants.
Maybe they were just hidden before.
"N- No, they just left..." Mira became teary eyed as she lowered the mirror. She was so hungry.
"S- Should we try sneaking out? Maybe that mutant is gone." Gary spoke, looking at his sister in a fearful tone.
He was just nineteen.
"And what about those wolves? They still might be out, searching for us..." Tears streamed down her cheeks as she weakly sat down.
Thanks to his ability to turn invisible, they were able to sneak out of the Wolves base.
They even found some food in these buildings, but then a mutant was actually able to see them, forcing them to stay locked here.
Vritra and Yasmine walked back into the apartment. They shared the news with others.
"Should we save them?" Yasmine looked at Vritra. They would just follow what he decided.
Although they would like to save the kids if possible, it was not by putting the group at risk.
"Yes, we planned to clear up a couple of buildings anyway. Maybe we can find some information." Vritra said. With his senses, he could tell if there really was a powerful mutant.
"Get ready, we are heading out." He added after a moment.
"Alright honey, if we can, it is better to help others. Of course, with conditions attached." Vanessa said with a smile.
They were all well rested, so within moments they dressed up into warmer clothes. Shitless and Onest got ready too.
"Shitless, how long are you going to look like a mutant?" Vritra asked, looking at the monk with bright red skin and bulging eyes. He looked quite funny.
"I don't know, I am like this ever since that giant octopus threw me out with its poop." Shitless shrugged.
The mutants actually were no longer attacking him.
"Well, that works too. You will be our scout from now on." Vritra said.
"Alright, you can trust me. I am anything but brave- huh? No wait, that sounds wrong. I am hmm..." Shitless became confused.
Ignoring his usual mindless moments, they climbed down the stairs, killing a few mutants along the way.
The accumulated snow was pretty high here, almost covering the entire first floor.
Arriving close to the other building, Vritra scanned the surroundings and could sense quite a few mutants.
"Shitless, go up and check." Vritra gestured.
Monk Shitless wasted no time and hurried above. Even the mutants avoided him as if he was carrying some plague.
The sight made the group laugh. He was truly a walking circus.
If only Bully was here, their transport would be so easy.
After a couple of minutes, Shitless returned and spoke, "Most mutants are weak, but there is a strong one too. Its ability seems to be telekinesis, on the seventh floor."
"Let's go." Vritra nodded. They started moving up instantly.
Killing the mutants along the way, they quickly climbed up to the seventh floor.
They saw a mutant who looked like a thin old man with only bones. He was sitting with legs crossed in front of a door.
Debris and small stones kept floating around it.
It was because of this mutant's high spiritual stat that he could see the siblings.
Grrrrrr...
Right upon sensing them, the mutant growled and sent all sorts of objects at them like bullets.
Vritra created a blood wall, then created blood spears and killed the mutant pretty easily.
KNOCK KNOCK
He knocked on the door before speaking.
"Hey, it's me, the person from the opposite building."
After hesitating, Gary peeked out of the peephole and looked overjoyed upon seeing them.
But then he hesitated again. What if they were from the Wolves?
'No, there are so many women with him. He can't possibly be from the Wolves.' Gary concluded and opened the door. He hid Mira away.
"H- Hello, I am Gary. Thank you for saving me..." His eyes widened in shock, baffled by the beauty level of the women.
Then he jumped back upon seeing the red mutant.
"W- Watch out, there is a mutant!!" he shouted, disappearing.
"Sigh, it's fine. He is a human and with us. Now explain your situation." Vritra said. He could sense the girl but made no comment about it.
"O- Oh, I was actually taken in by a group called the Wolves..." He quickly went over his story.
The Wolves were actually using the radio to lure people. They had trapped quite a lot.
The two of them were lucky to have escaped, but they were still being chased.
Vritra remembered the wolves that butcher guy used, so he asked,
"A tall guy who looks like a butcher, is he the leader of the Wolves?"
"Ah, him? His name is actually Butcher, and no, he is not from the Wolves. He was given those wolves by his friend, the leader of the Wolves.
Butcher is the leader of a group called Big Bang Colony."
Vritra frowned, thinking, 'What the fuck? BBC again?'
"I see, tell me where I can find these bases?" Vritra asked.
"Uhm C- Can we travel with you?" Gary asked hesitatingly.
"No, at most I can give you some food. But I can't take responsibility for your life or that girl's, I am sure you can survive on your own just fine." Vritra said firmly.
"J- Just a bit far away from here, I heard there is an army camp, j- just bring us there. We were originally going there, but got locked. Please, it's not far and on the way." Gary knelt, pleading.
"First tell me more about all three bases." Vritra said, showing no pity.
This is a different planet, he needed to harden his heart or the lesson might cost him a life.
"O- Okay..." Gary nodded, telling whatever he knew about the Wolves and Big Bang Colony.
He knew little about the army base though.
Butcher and the leader of Wolves were very good friends, and both were scums, turning the lives of a lot of people into living hell.
"If that's the case, why is no one from that army base attacking either of them?" Fiona questioned.
"They have tried but the result was fruitless." Gary replied.
"What are your abilities?" Maeve questioned, maybe they are not dead weight.
"I- I... can turn anything invisible and my sister can make others fall asleep." Gary replied.
"Here, eat some." Vritra handed him some food item, deciding to discuss before making a decision.
He did plan to raid the Big Bang Colony at any cost though.
Gary ran back into the apartment, he shared the food with his sister as the two hungrily devoured it all.
"What do you all think?" Vritra looked at others and asked.
"If the army camp is not far away, we can take them along. Their abilities aren't completely useless either." Yasmine spoke.
"He wasn't lying, right?" the goddess asked, one could never be more careful in an apocalypse.
"Yeah he wasn't, I observed his heartbeat and his reactions, it was all true or what he believes is true." Vritra said.
"Could he be under some mind control?" Teresa wondered.
"Possible, wifey, try launching a weak spiritual attack on him later. It should break any spell he is under." He added.
Yasmine nodded, they didn't want to lose any member of the group by making any mistakes.

chapters.title: Chapter 640 The Shoes
paragraphs: After checking out several things, Gary and Mira were found to be two innocent teens.
After they were done eating, Vritra decided to continue the journey right away.
The more time they took, the stronger the opponent would get.
He was already lagging so much behind, although the sin wheel gave him an advantage, but who knows what abilities those ten players possessed.
"Stay close, and keep activating your skill if I tell you to." Vritra ordered as they all climbed down to the road.
"Y- Yes sir!" Gary nodded hastily, afraid of being left behind.
Mira was nervous at first but having other women close made her feel a bit calm.
"Let's go." Vritra turned as they started walking, he decided to take a few wolves as well.
[A Player has been detected in the Linden city!]
[Eliminating him will grant you his ability!]
[While if you get eliminated, your abilities will be stolen!]
Just then several messages popped in front of him, making Vritra pause.
"What's wrong, master?" Maeve asked, bumping into Vritra's back.
"There is a player in this city." Vritra said.
The growth of these players was higher than the people here, all of them also possessed cheats of their own.
"So, we have to kill him but does he also know of our presence?" Fiona questioned.

"No, but once we come across him, he might recognize us. These players are behind what happened on the Zoratian planet, we have to eliminate all ten of them." Vritra replied, he still felt unprepared.
"Let's clear the Wolves and Big Bang Colony, that will greatly increase our strength and kill other mutants along the way." He added.
"Alright hubby, less rest more fight!" Yasmine said, a fire burning in her eyes.
Then Vritra gestured towards Gary to lead the group, the teen nodded and started pointing the directions.
Before long they arrived at a junction with over a hundred mutants who were trying to enter a building.
They were probably chasing after some survivors, all of them were weak zombies.
Vritra paused and didn't attack immediately, he could use the blood manipulation to clear them out.
But after thinking he looked at Yasmine and asked: "Wifey, can you use your spiritual attack on me?"
"Uh... Okay." After slight hesitation she nodded, sure that he must have his reasons.
After concentrating, she used a weak spiritual attack on him.
Vritra instantly felt as if his head was tickled, it had no effect on him.
"Your spiritual attribute is lower than mine so just use full strength, don't worry, I will be fine." He spoke.
"..." Yasmine nodded and shot a full power spiritual attack.
This time Vritra felt as if his head was pricked by a needle, only feeling a fleeting pain.
[Evomorph Activated!]
[You have acquired Spiritual Burst!]
Vritra smiled in satisfaction, he was not sure it would work.
It was a great addition, since the spiritual attribute of most creatures was rather low.
[Spiritual Burst Activated!]
Turning to face the group of mutants who hadn't yet noticed them since they had turned invisible.
Vritra suddenly released a powerful mental attack.
BOOM
With a loud noise, the heads of nearly all the mutants exploded at once, while the remaining few died with their heads intact.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +53}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +51}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +50}
More than a hundred messages popped before him instantly, as warmth enveloped his body.
His family was also getting stronger just by being present there.
{Sin Points: 13,044}
[Stats]
(Strength: 45.2)
(Agility: 50.9)
(Endurance: 47.3)
(Spiritual: 30.6)
{Free Attribute: 6}
Vritra opened his status panel, his mind felt especially relaxed and cool after crossing the 30 point mark.
His agility had crossed 50 points, bringing a drastic increase.
The siblings were shocked to see so many mutants die at once, they looked at all the people and understood it must have been Vritra.
'H- He is strong?!!' they both exclaimed, feeling safer than before.
After a moment, he decided to use the sin wheel.
'Open rewards for 500 points with all my sin points.' he ordered as instantly a wheel started to spin before him.
[You have acquired 10,000 packets of instant noodles!]
[You have acquired the Chain of Calm!]
[You have acquired the Slippery Shoe!]
[You have acquired 2 Free Attributes!]
Instantly twenty six messages popped before him, giving him an even vast amount of supplies.
But this time, a few special items had come too.
[Chain of Calm]
[Description]: Wrap it around yourself and it will provide some level of protection against mental attacks. Can be used on a single entity or a group.
Vritra read the description and took out the Chain of Calm.
It was slightly milky in colour and quite light, nearly 30 centimetres in length.
Vritra wrapped it around his wrist and instantly felt a coolness wash over his mind.
'This is good, but with my high spiritual stat it won't be of much use to me.' He thought and looked over the stats of his family.
Vanessa and Yasmine both possessed high spiritual attributes.
Fiona, Diana and Teresa weren't lacking either.
Only Maeve was slightly lacking in mental defence.
Onest was fine too and Shitless, or rather the red mutant, didn't really need it.
"Foxie, this is for you." He called out, wrapping the chain around her delicate wrist.
"Thank you master." Maeve smiled happily, she loved getting gifts from her master.
[Slippery Shoe]
[Description]: A pair of boots that can momentarily increase your speed up to twice.
He took out the boots after reading the description, making the siblings wonder where he was taking them out from.
'How many abilities does he possess?'
'Can it increase my speed to 100?' Vritra wondered, if it could then this would be an even better treasure.
He quickly replaced his shoes with the Slippery Shoes, they fit perfectly and were quite light.
"Let's test." Activating the shoes, Vritra dashed forward at full speed.
BOOM
There was a sudden sonic boom as air splashed in all directions, it felt like Vritra had teleported.
His figure had travelled several hundred metres in moments.
He flashed back, a bit slower this time.
"Honey, these are great. We couldn't even see you." Vanessa said, both surprised and happy.
Vritra smiled, deciding to take the shoes for himself.
They would suit Onest too but with his high agility they were perfect for him.
He also got a few attribute points.
[2 agility, 2 Endurance, 4 Spiritual and 4 Free Attributes.]
{Sin Points: 44}
[Stats]
(Strength: 47.2)
(Agility: 50.9)
(Endurance: 49.3)
(Spiritual: 34.6)
{Free Attribute: 10}
"How far is the military base?" Vritra asked.
"It's just a kilometre or so ahead." Gary answered hastily, looking up to Vritra as if he was his idol.
Just being strong didn't mean much, there were quite a lot of such people.
But being strong and still being able to control one's emotions and behaviour, that was admirable.
Just after getting a little strength, the people here were committing all sorts of crimes.
Gary and Mira were sure, with the strength of Vritra's group they could wipe out the entire city, at least the humans.
Again, the group began to move.
"W- Wait, thank you for saving us!!" a head peeked out of the building all of a sudden.
And soon nearly fifty people walked out, looking fearful and relieved at the same time.

The more time they took, the stronger the opponent would get.

"Stay close, and keep activating your skill if I tell you to." Vritra ordered as they all climbed down to the road.

Mira was nervous at first but having other women close made her feel a bit calm.

These players are behind what happened on the Zoratian planet, we have to eliminate all ten of them." Vritra replied, he still felt unprepared.

They were probably chasing after some survivors, all of them were weak zombies.
Vritra paused and didn't attack immediately, he could use the blood manipulation to clear them out.

Okay." After slight hesitation she nodded, sure that he must have his reasons.

chapters.title: Chapter 641 The Military Base
paragraphs: Over fifty people looked at the corpses of the mutants and then back at Vritra's group.
"It's fine." Vritra said, turning to leave.
"W- Wait, if you don't mind-" the man at the front spoke with hesitation.

"I do mind, bringing such a large group, it will attract- hmm well that's fine I guess, sure you can follow but only till the military base." Vritra changed his mind upon realizing that he indeed wanted more mutants to come.
So if the bait was so willing, he would use these people to attract the mutants.
"R- Really? Thank you, sir, thank you very much!!" he knelt, and the others also thanked him profusely.
'He is indeed a good person.' Mira and Gary both thought.
"Alright, stop wasting time and get up, or we will leave." He said and started to walk away.
"Y- Yes!" the middle aged guy nodded hurriedly, gesturing for everyone to follow.
Before the apocalypse he held a high position in the military, but now money and connections were all gone.
All that mattered was strength.
As the group started to move, they all noticed a big cloud of blood moving along with them.
Of course it scared them.
"S- Sir, what is that?" the military man asked, speaking respectfully.
"Don't worry about that, stay close and report if you see any mutant horde." Vritra said dismissively.
The big group continued to move. Their numbers and the scent of blood soon attracted the attention of mutants.
KRRRRRRR
Terrifying screams rang out from all sides, mutants jumped down from the windows of the buildings.
It was a scene straight out of a horror movie.
But Vritra only felt happy to see more mutants rushing to give him sin points.
He did feel a little bad after all just a few months ago these were all normal people with families.
And now they were just mindless creatures, Vritra prayed that they would rest in peace at least after death.
BOOM
A fat mutant, whose body seemed like big lumps of meat, suddenly jumped in front of the group.
"This one is strong, even stronger than Bull." Vritra mumbled, but for the current him it was nothing.
[Blood Manipulation Activated!]
[Spiritual Burst Activated!]
He used both skills at once, making the fat mutant's eyes burst as it fell back but didn't die instantly.
'It is indeed tough.' Vritra nodded before plunging a blade directly into its skull.
While just one spiritual attack was enough to kill most others.
It wasn't long before they finally arrived near the military base and on the way Vritra had killed nearly two hundred mutants.
{Sin Points: 14,300}
The sin points rose and his stats as well, of course Vanessa and others weren't just staying still.
They were helping Vritra as much as they could, their strength also growing rapidly.
"This is the military base, thank you for bringing us here." The military guy nodded, he didn't know why but a lot of mutants attacked them.
"But is this place really safe?" Vritra asked, gazing at the military base from the distance.
"It should be, why don't you stay here as well, sir? I believe this is a good place to settle." He thought and spoke in a hurry.
"Well we aren't really looking for a place to settle." Vritra refused.
"Oh uhm then you can at least rest here." He added.
"Hmm. Let's check this place out." They walked closer to the military base.
The walls were well guarded with high defence, over twenty men patrolled from the top of the walls.
"Stop right there, who are you?" the patrolling men shouted, aiming guns at them.
"I am Sergeant Keg, 9th Platoon, Bravo Company, 2nd Battalion." Keg introduced himself, with his hands raised to indicate the absence of any weapon.
"Wait right there, I will call the General over." They were all dressed in military uniforms.
Seeing them, Vritra's gaze moved towards his wives. He couldn't help but imagine them wearing tight uniforms.
The thought instantly made him excited, he decided to try it out later on.
This was one of his recent kinks, for some reason, seeing them in formal uniforms made them appear even more hot and beautiful.
"General Peter, these are the survivors that have come." One of the men reported.
"At ease." The general said before turning to look at the big group.
"We welcome all the survivors but first you will have to be tested to make sure none of you are infected." The general spoke loudly.
"And how will we be tested?" Vritra asked, he didn't plan to stay there for long.
After some rest and taking a few uniforms away, he planned to leave the place.
"It is a basic thermal test, a doctor has awakened a special skill that can distinguish between the infected and uninfected, it is nothing severe, don't worry." The general said.
The gates opened slightly, just enough to let one person enter at a time.
"..." Vritra looked back at the red Shitless, and wondered if they would stop him.
The monk had covered himself up completely to not scare the mutants away.
As it turned out, many mutants were afraid of the almighty evil monk and dared not go close.
They started calling the people inside one by one and the female doctor just needed to hold their hand for a moment to know.
Once all the survivors were inside, Onest and Shitless entered.
"They pass, you can go in." thankfully the doctor didn't find any fault.
She didn't need direct skin contact it seemed.
Next it was Vritra and his wives, after all of them had passed, the doctor quickly rushed to the general and muttered something.
"Are you sure?" he asked in surprise.
"Yes I am certain." The doctor nodded.
"Brave survivors, I congratulate you all for making it here safely. In this base, we will provide you with safety, food, water and a place to live.
Of course, there are certain basic tasks you will have to do, which are necessary to run the base." The general gave a long speech then dismissed everyone.
The military soldiers began to help everyone to settle.
"Hello, how may I address you?" the general paused before Vritra with a friendly smile.
"I am Adam." Vritra said, there wasn't any real reason behind giving a false name.
"I see, so Adam, thank you for helping them all. I just heard about your might from them, you are a powerful fighter and I am glad to have you here.
The doctor told me that you possess a healing ability, is that true?" he asked, a strange glint in his eyes.
"Yes, why do you ask?" Vritra nodded, though it wasn't healing exactly.
"Can you heal others as well?" the general followed with a question.
"I am afraid not, it's just a basic self healing skill." Vritra shook his head, making the general sigh in disappointment.
"I see, then please let me show you to your tent. Will you be staying alone or..." he looked at the other people waiting for Vritra.
"No, my wives will be staying with me and those two will stay together." Vritra answered.
He couldn't help but feel a slight hint of hostility from him.
While walking, Vritra saw hundreds of tents occupied by thousands of survivors.
"Do you have enough food to feed them all?" he asked, surprised at the scale of the base.
"Yeah we are doing just fine with all the helping hands, thankfully we have not run out of food yet." The general replied strangely.

chapters.title: Chapter 642 Horror
paragraphs: Vritra and the general talked for a while, as he led them towards empty tents.
"You can stay here, tell me or any of the officers if you need anything." Peter spoke, with a friendly smile.
"Hmm. It seems this tent was being used not long ago, did you shift the residents?" Vritra glanced at the two big tents and spoke.
"Sigh. You know the condition here, there are always tragedies, how are we to get food otherwise?" the general replied.
Vritra had seen his fair share of movies and web series, and his senses were screaming that there was something wrong with this camp.
'Don't tell me, like in the movies they are performing cannibalism?' this thought made a frown appear on his face.
"Actually, if it's not a problem can I see your food supply, I can help you gather more food too." Vritra asked.
"Sure, why not, it's no big deal." Peter gestured for the group to follow him, and led them towards a warehouse.
"This here is nearly all the food we have, if nothing happens it should still last for a few months." Peter added.
'There is food here, so it's not a case of cannibalism.' Vritra thought, maybe he was just thinking too much.
"I see, thank you. On my way here I have found some food, I will give you its location later on." He spoke.
In any case, Vritra still was cautious.
They returned to their tents, both were quite spacious and had all the necessary stuff.
"Its not bad to see so many people, it almost feels like a world without apocalypse." Yasmine said as she sat down on the bed.
"You all must be feeling hungry, let's eat something." Vritra said, pulling out various things from his inventory.
All the others also had enough food in their inventories, but that was for emergency, in case they ended up separating.
"Foxie, come with me later in the night, I would like to check this place out." Vritra said, her ability made moving in night pretty easy.
As her strength was growing the shadow could do more than just hiding them.
"Okay master." Maeve nodded, drinking the warm soup.
The other survivors brought here by Vritra had also settled in nicely.
The sky was already turning dark by the time they finished eating, people started to return to their homes rather early.
Without electricity or internet, there wasn't much to do.
Of course, there was still electricity but very limited, since it was being generated by fuel, and fuel is limited.
Vritra and Maeve left the tent silently, their figures merging with the darkness perfectly.
They walked around the camp, finding patrolling soldiers, some people who were still out and talking.
Everything seemed pretty normal.
"Master, I think this place is fine, when do you plan to continue moving?" she asked.
"We will stay here one more day, there are a few things I need to get from here." Vritra said, thinking of the tight uniforms.
"Hehe. What are you planning, master~" Maeve asked in a playful tone before pausing abruptly, feeling as if she had said this before.
"What's wrong?" Vritra turned to face her, looking at her with worry.
"I..." doubt flashed through Maeve's eyes as the white chain on her wrist glowed for a moment.
"It's nothing master, do you want to continue or should we return now?" Maeve asked as she shook her head, smiling sweetly.
"Yeah let's go home, I am feeling a bit tired." He muttered, yawning.
THUD THUD
As they started walking, the two heard banging noises from not far away.
After a moment, they decided to go and check.
THUD
As they neared the wall, their eyes widened in shock.
A woman in her late thirties was striking her bloodied head against the wall again and again, a big red mark forming there.
Maeve moved and pulled her arm, looking at the woman with a questioning gaze, her forehead had a big wound.
"What are you doing?" She asked.
Despite the blood covering her face, Vritra recognized her as one of the women who had arrived here together with them.
The woman trembled as Maeve spoke, her eyes full of tears, though for a moment she seemed confused.
"I- I don't want to live SOB my husband died out there... I SOB" she started crying instantly, appearing pitiful.
Vritra's frown deepened, with his high spiritual value, if he saw something once he wouldn't forget it.
That's why he remembered each and every person in the group he met earlier today.
And this woman was clearly with a ten or so year old boy, there was also a man with her.
"Wasn't your husband with you earlier and even your kid?" Vritra asked, but the woman just kept crying.
A group of guards attracted by the sound arrived there, they looked quizzically.
They were no longer covered by the shadows so the guards could see them clearly.
Maeve explained the situation.
"Haa. Such situations have happened many times, some people just can't bear the loss of their loved ones and decide to end their lives.
But miss, you have to live for your son, you can't expect others to take care of him, right?" the soldier said sternly.
Then he faced Vritra and Maeve: "Don't worry, I will bring her back to her tent safely, and we will make sure she doesn't try this again."
"..." Vritra just nodded, but the feeling of unease increased in his heart.
The guards walked away, taking the woman along, leaving the two of them.
"Master, let's go back, I too feel this place is weird." Maeve said, pulling his arm, she wanted to get out of the settlement asap.
Vritra nodded, he looked at the blood stain on the wall then at the sky, where a round moon was visible.
"The moon looks pretty today." He commented, before walking away with Maeve.
A drop of blood dripped from the blood stain, flowing into the drain.
On the same wall, hundreds of similar looking blood stains could be seen, each present some distance from one another.
The scene was just horrifying.
Vritra and Maeve chatted, holding hands they walked back towards their tent.
He bumped into someone, shocked that he hadn't noticed a person standing there.
"Sorry." Vritra said, as he continued walking after a glance at the man who didn't react and was just staring up at the moon.
'Something is indeed going on here.' Vritra thought.
They continued walking no longer bumping into any of the survivors, the hundreds of them that just stood there and stared up.
Most of them had the same bloody marks on their foreheads.
They arrived at the tent where the women were talking and waiting for them.
"You are back. Honey, did you find something strange?" Vanessa asked, smiling lovingly.
"Hmm I am not really sure. We just saw a woman hitting her head on the wall, that certainly is strange." He replied.
"Oh I think we should leave this place as soon as tomorrow, could it be that general?" the goddess asked.
"I don't know, in any case, let's just sleep. Ughh it feels like I haven't rested for days, haa I feel exhausted..."
Vritra muttered as they all started walking to retire for the day and have quality sleeping.
Pausing right outside the tent, the group's expressions turned dull, standing there mindlessly as they stared up at the sky.

sentences.text: Vritra and the general talked for a while, as he led them towards empty tents.
"You can stay here, tell me or any of the officers if you need anything." Peter spoke, with a friendly smile.
"Hmm.
It seems this tent was being used not long ago, did you shift the residents?" Vritra glanced at the two big tents and spoke.
"Sigh.
You know the condition here, there are always tragedies, how are we to get food otherwise?" the general replied.
Vritra had seen his fair share of movies and web series, and his senses were screaming that there was something wrong with this camp.
'Don't tell me, like in the movies they are performing cannibalism?' this thought made a frown appear on his face.
"Actually, if it's not a problem can I see your food supply, I can help you gather more food too." Vritra asked.
"Sure, why not, it's no big deal." Peter gestured for the group to follow him, and led them towards a warehouse.
"This here is nearly all the food we have, if nothing happens it should still last for a few months." Peter added.
'There is food here, so it's not a case of cannibalism.' Vritra thought, maybe he was just thinking too much.
"I see, thank you.
On my way here I have found some food, I will give you its location later on." He spoke.
In any case, Vritra still was cautious.
They returned to their tents, both were quite spacious and had all the necessary stuff.
"Its not bad to see so many people, it almost feels like a world without apocalypse." Yasmine said as she sat down on the bed.
"You all must be feeling hungry, let's eat something." Vritra said, pulling out various things from his inventory.
All the others also had enough food in their inventories, but that was for emergency, in case they ended up separating.
"Foxie, come with me later in the night, I would like to check this place out." Vritra said, her ability made moving in night pretty easy.
As her strength was growing the shadow could do more than just hiding them.
"Okay master." Maeve nodded, drinking the warm soup.
The other survivors brought here by Vritra had also settled in nicely.
The sky was already turning dark by the time they finished eating, people started to return to their homes rather early.
Without electricity or internet, there wasn't much to do.
Of course, there was still electricity but very limited, since it was being generated by fuel, and fuel is limited.
Vritra and Maeve left the tent silently, their figures merging with the darkness perfectly.
They walked around the camp, finding patrolling soldiers, some people who were still out and talking.
Everything seemed pretty normal.
"Master, I think this place is fine, when do you plan to continue moving?" she asked.
"We will stay here one more day, there are a few things I need to get from here." Vritra said, thinking of the tight uniforms.
"Hehe.
What are you planning, master~" Maeve asked in a playful tone before pausing abruptly, feeling as if she had said this before.
"What's wrong?" Vritra turned to face her, looking at her with worry.
"I..." doubt flashed through Maeve's eyes as the white chain on her wrist glowed for a moment.
"It's nothing master, do you want to continue or should we return now?" Maeve asked as she shook her head, smiling sweetly.
"Yeah let's go home, I am feeling a bit tired." He muttered, yawning.
THUD THUD
As they started walking, the two heard banging noises from not far away.
After a moment, they decided to go and check.
THUD
As they neared the wall, their eyes widened in shock.
A woman in her late thirties was striking her bloodied head against the wall again and again, a big red mark forming there.
Maeve moved and pulled her arm, looking at the woman with a questioning gaze, her forehead had a big wound.
"What are you doing?" She asked.
Despite the blood covering her face, Vritra recognized her as one of the women who had arrived here together with them.
The woman trembled as Maeve spoke, her eyes full of tears, though for a moment she seemed confused.
"I- I don't want to live SOB my husband died out there...
I SOB" she started crying instantly, appearing pitiful.
Vritra's frown deepened, with his high spiritual value, if he saw something once he wouldn't forget it.
That's why he remembered each and every person in the group he met earlier today.
And this woman was clearly with a ten or so year old boy, there was also a man with her.
"Wasn't your husband with you earlier and even your kid?" Vritra asked, but the woman just kept crying.
A group of guards attracted by the sound arrived there, they looked quizzically.
They were no longer covered by the shadows so the guards could see them clearly.
Maeve explained the situation.
"Haa.
Such situations have happened many times, some people just can't bear the loss of their loved ones and decide to end their lives.
But miss, you have to live for your son, you can't expect others to take care of him, right?" the soldier said sternly.
Then he faced Vritra and Maeve: "Don't worry, I will bring her back to her tent safely, and we will make sure she doesn't try this again."
"..." Vritra just nodded, but the feeling of unease increased in his heart.
The guards walked away, taking the woman along, leaving the two of them.
"Master, let's go back, I too feel this place is weird." Maeve said, pulling his arm, she wanted to get out of the settlement asap.
Vritra nodded, he looked at the blood stain on the wall then at the sky, where a round moon was visible.
"The moon looks pretty today." He commented, before walking away with Maeve.

On the same wall, hundreds of similar looking blood stains could be seen, each present some distance from one another.
The scene was just horrifying.
Vritra and Maeve chatted, holding hands they walked back towards their tent.
He bumped into someone, shocked that he hadn't noticed a person standing there.
"Sorry." Vritra said, as he continued walking after a glance at the man who didn't react and was just staring up at the moon.
'Something is indeed going on here.' Vritra thought.
They continued walking no longer bumping into any of the survivors, the hundreds of them that just stood there and stared up.
Most of them had the same bloody marks on their foreheads.
They arrived at the tent where the women were talking and waiting for them.
