chapters.title: Chapter 643 Yawn
paragraphs: Vritra woke up early in the morning, instead of feeling refreshed he felt more tired.
Rubbing his sore eyes, he looked at his wives sleeping peacefully beside him on the bed.
He decided not to disturb them, after untangling himself he got off.
After taking a bath he dressed up, and decided to go meet the general.
By now, all the women had woken up too.
"Let's eat breakfast once I am back." Vritra said, as he turned and left the tent.
"Pitiful one!" Shitless called, his appearance still hidden under the clothes.
"How long are we going to stay here? It's already been quite long." The monk said, though he liked the safe environment here but they had a mission to complete.
"Quite long? We just came here yesterday, what are you talking about?" Vritra asked, then turning to look at the tired Onest.
There were big dark circles under his eyes, he looked as if he had not slept for weeks.
"Hey what happened to you?" Vritra asked in surprise.
"I don't know, maybe I caught some illness or something, I feel tired." He said, yawning.
"Maybe Diana could help, let her take a look later on." Vritra said, his condition didn't seem serious though.
Shitless was about to speak, Vritra turned and started walking towards Peter's tent.
"Well, I will talk to you later on." He spoke.
Upon arriving outside the general's tent, he saw two soldiers guarding the entrance.
"Aren't you the guy from yesterday, do you have something to ask?" one of the soldiers asked.
"I want to ask the general about something, is he inside?" Vritra asked.
"Yes I am." The general stepped out of the tent right at that moment, smiling.
"Tell me what do you have to ask?" Peter said, he was already dressed in his uniform.
"Let's walk and talk." Vritra gestured.
"Very well." Peter nodded and then the two started to walk towards the entrance of the base camp.
"I plan to leave this place today." Vritra spoke seriously.
"Oh that's a pity, your presence here would have been a great help, but don't worry I won't stop you against your wishes." Peter said.
"Hmm. But there is a favour I need, do you have spare uniforms? I believe they could be helpful in survival outside." Vritra added.
Peter didn't ask any questions, he laughed and nodded:
"That is fine, it's a small matter. Uniforms is one of the things we don't lack, you can take however many you want, we have various uniforms."
The general led Vritra towards another warehouse where a lot of uniforms for different posts were present, it wasn't just army uniforms, there were others like air force and such.
'Whoa!' Vritra's eyes shone, looking at these dresses he imagined his wives wearing them.
They would look even more sexy.
"Pick whichever you want, they are arranged by sizes." Peter said, giving instructions to the soldiers present there.
Vritra nodded and quickly took several uniforms, at least one for each of his wives.
In exchange, he decided to leave some food behind, it's not like he could finish that all even if he continued eating for years.
"I will be taking these." He said, carrying several bags.
"Alright, take them. Let one of the soldiers bring it to your tent, I have something to discuss with you." Peter spoke, rubbing his eyes, feeling a bit sleepy.
"I will meet you at the door, I still need to have breakfast with my family." Vritra said, before walking back.
After walking away he put the uniforms into his inventory, but then paused.
"Huh, why do I have so many uniforms...?" he had only taken seventeen or eighteen uniforms just now but there were a bit too many.
He yawned then shrugged his shoulders, walking back.
They ate breakfast together, while chatting about various things.
"Master, we are leaving today right?" Maeve asked, her eyes felt heavy, she wanted to sleep but couldn't.
"Yeah." Vritra nodded.
Soon after finishing the breakfast, he stayed around a bit longer before walking towards the entrance.
The general was present there, making some plan to go out in search of food.
"General, I am here, tell me what did you want to discuss?" Vritra called out.
"Ah Adam, please come here, you should listen to this." He gestured, there was a map spread over the table with various military people standing around it.
"We have observed intense movements from this area recently, many mutants have been arriving here. It seems a big wave of mutants will be attacking this base soon."
Peter started to explain from the start.
"..." Vritra stayed silent, hearing the report.

"If my observation is correct, they will be at our door in 2 or maybe 3 hours. If we can clear this wave, we will be able to search the opposite building for food, that area hasn't been looted by the Wolves or Big Bang Colony yet." He continued.
"So Vritra, if it's not a problem-" Peter looked up and began to speak, only to be interrupted.
"Huh, w- what did you just call me?" Vritra frowned, his head spinning, intense pain making him feel dizzy and the feeling of foreboding intensifying.
"What's wrong, Adam? Do you feel sick? This apocalypse has messed with all our minds, I have some pills that can help."
Peter looked at him with concern.
Vritra yawned, then shaking his head he spoke: "It's nothing, I just feel tired... so what were you saying?"

"I was asking if you can stay here for a few more hours and help us clear this wave, if we fail then everyone here will die. I beg of you please help us, in return you can even take the food." The general said.
"But general that's-" one of the soldiers frowned and tried to interrupt.
"Shut up, his strength is superior to you all combined, we need his help." Peter said before turning to look at Vritra.
"I see, okay, I will help you." Vritra nodded, he planned to kill a lot of mutants anyway, so it didn't misalign with his goal.
"Thank you, if we can survive this, I will fulfil any of your wishes." Peter said before sharing his plans.
After two hours, Vritra, Shitless, Onest, Peter and many other soldiers all stood over the boundary wall.
'Just how powerful will the wave be to make them so nervous?' Vritra wondered.
With his skills, even if it was a big wave, he could handle it.
It wasn't long before the mutants began to attack them just as Peter had anticipated.
Most were weak zombies but there were also some powerful ones mixed in.
'This is perfect, I can earn a lot of sin points this time.'
Vritra thought, he created arrows of blood and started shooting them at the approaching horde.
Shitless and Onest held guns, shooting madly.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +49}
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +51}
Messages started to pop before Vritra, motivating him to go all out.
He kept using the spiritual burst to make the heads of mutants explode or stun the stronger ones.
This wave was really quite big.
Many other soldiers were also using their skills, launching long distance attacks.
As the numbers increased and mutants started to attack the wall or even climb up.
Vritra jumped down, cutting them to pieces, while constantly using the blood manipulation and spiritual burst.
The soldiers were all shocked by his performance, he was like a killing machine left in the midst of hundreds of mutants.
No matter how many of the powerful mutants surrounded him, he slaughtered them all.
While Vritra just focused on earning sin points.
It wasn't long before the number of mutants decreased greatly, but the battle had lasted longer than they had expected.
Time flew so fast that by the time they were done cleaning up the lingering mutants, the sky was already darkening.
"Thank you very much for your help, if not for you, I don't know if we could have survived here."
The general thanked him. Even all the soldiers looked at him respectfully now.
They weren't sure about the trust Peter put in Vritra before but now they knew just how strong he is.
Vritra returned to the camp, where his wives had already prepared the dinner.
The group of ten ate together, as Vritra shared the news of his battle.
He had decided not to bring his wives during the battle for a few reasons.
"Hubby, now that this place is safe, I think we should leave as soon as possible." Yasmine said.
Vritra nodded: "I too feel there is something wrong about this place."
"Foxie, come with me later in the night, I would like to check this place out."
"Okay master." Maeve nodded, drinking the warm soup.
Then he added: "We will leave as early as tomorrow."
They chatted about various things and soon finished the dinner.
Once the surroundings were dark enough, Vritra and Maeve walked out of the tent, completely covered by the darkness.
They roamed around for a while and didn't see anything out of place.
"Master, I think this place is fine, when do you plan to continue moving?" she asked.
"We will stay here one more day, there are a few things I need to get from here." Vritra said.
"Hehe. What are you planning, master~" Maeve asked in a playful tone before pausing abruptly, a deep frown on her face.
"What's wrong?" Vritra turned to face her, looking at her with worry.
"I..." she appeared confused.
"It's nothing master, do you want to continue or should we return now?" Maeve asked as she shook her head, smiling sweetly.
"Yeah let's go home, I am feeling a bit tired." He muttered, yawning.
THUD THUD

chapters.title: Chapter 644 Sleepy
paragraphs: Both Vritra and Maeve paused upon hearing the constant thudding, they walked closer to the wall and saw a person striking their head against the wall.
A clear stain of blood could be seen, the two were shocked.
They walked closer and pulled the person back.
It was a man, Vritra focused on his face and felt it was familiar, maybe it was someone he had rescued earlier.
He yawned, but kept staring for a few more minutes.
"You are...?" he asked, the other person's eyes suddenly filled with tears as he began to mutter.
"I- I don't want to live SOB my wife died out there... I SOB" he started crying instantly, appearing pitiful.
Vritra frowned deeply, he tried harder to think and the young face before him seemed more and more familiar.
"Wasn't your name something like... On- honest or something? Hmm you are familiar..." Vritra's eyes narrowed further, straining his brain to the limit.
Then he yawned, and looked at the man with a bloody forehead.
A group of guards attracted by the sound arrived there, they looked quizzically.
They were no longer covered by the shadows so the guards could see them clearly.
Maeve explained the situation.
"Haa. Such situations have happened many times, some people just can't bear the loss of their loved ones and decide to end their lives.
But Sir, you have to live for your son, you can't expect others to take care of him, right?" the soldier said sternly.
Then he faced Vritra and Maeve: "Don't worry, I will bring him back to his tent safely, and we will make sure he doesn't try this again."
"..." Vritra just nodded, but the feeling of unease increased in his heart.
The guards walked away, taking the man along, leaving the two of them.
"Master, let's go back, I too feel this place is weird."
Maeve said, pulling his arm, she wanted to get out of the settlement asap.
Vritra nodded, he looked at the blood stain on the wall then at the sky, where a round moon was visible.
"The moon looks pretty today." He commented, before walking away with Maeve.
A drop of blood dripped from the blood stain, flowing into the drain.
Today there was a new mark on the wall, joining the hundreds of others.
Vritra and Maeve chatted as they walked back towards their tent, planning to leave as soon as tomorrow.
Of course, he still needed to take some important stuff from here, thinking of the uniforms he felt quite excited.
Suddenly, he bumped into someone, shocked that he hadn't noticed a person standing there.
"Sorry." Vritra said, as he continued walking.
"You are back. Honey, did you find something strange?" Vanessa asked, smiling lovingly.
"Hmm I am not really sure. We just saw a man hitting his head on the wall, that certainly is strange." He replied.
After a short talk they decided to go to sleep, walking towards the tent, the group paused outside and just stood there mindlessly.
Their expressions had turned dull.
Vritra woke up in the morning, feeling even more exhausted.
Without disturbing his wife he freshened up and then decided to go meet the general.
Upon arriving at Peter's tent he talked with the guard and finally met the general, when he asked for some uniforms, the general agreed with a laugh.
After he selected the uniforms, the general asked him to meet for an important matter.
Vritra agreed but told the general that he needed to have breakfast first.
He planned to leave today itself.
After eating breakfast, Vritra met with Peter where he got to know about the mutant wave that would be arriving soon.
And he decided to help.
They discussed and soon mutants arrived, together they killed all the mutants.
But it already got pretty late so Vritra decided to leave as early as tomorrow.
After eating dinner with his family, he decided to check this camp with Maeve and then...
THUD THUD
The feeling of uneasiness in Vritra's heart was pounding wildly, but his body just kept going on, as if following a routine again and again.
There were times when Maeve too felt quite confused, the chain on her wrist flickered but then she would forget everything.
This time again, Vritra and Maeve had gone out at night to check the surrounding.
"We will stay here one more day, there are a few things I need to get from here." Vritra said, thinking of the tight uniforms.
"Hehe. What are you planning, master~" Maeve asked in a playful tone before pausing abruptly, feeling as if she had said this before... many times.
"What's wrong?" Vritra turned to face her, looking at her with worry.
"I..." Maeve's face was full of confusion at first then horror, her lips parted as she quickly muttered something:
"S- Stat che- sta..." she yawned then just smiled and shook her head.
'Stat? what does she mean?' Vritra felt pain in his head, but then they continued.
Meeting a person hitting their head crazily, then going back to sleep.
Meeting Peter, taking uniform, participating in protecting the base again, they got late and decided to leave the next day.
But with each passing day, Vritra was feeling as if his mind was getting cut by knives.
They felt extremely tired as if they haven't taken a whiff of sleep for weeks.
This time again he was out with Maeve, observing the surrounding.
"Hehe. What are you planning, master~" Maeve asked in a playful tone before pausing abruptly, feeling as if she had said this before.
"What's wrong?" Vritra turned to face her, looking at her with worry.
"I..." Maeve's face appeared pale, her body shivered.
She quickly took off the chain from her wrist and tied it around Vritra's, as he looked back at her in confusion.
"What are you doing? This was for now." He said but didn't stop her, his bloodshot eyes looking down.
"Master, run-" Maeve suddenly yawned, and smiled, shaking her head she took his hand.
Vritra frowned, he looked down at the chain, and felt as if he was forgetting something or maybe a lot.
'Stat...' one word kept popping in his mind.
As he heard the thudding noise, the uncomfortable feeling heightened greatly.
The chain on his wrist buzzed and glowed faintly, bringing a moment of clarity to his mind.
"Stat!" he remembered suddenly and opened the status panel.
[Stats]
(Strength: 49.2)
(Agility: 50.9)
(Endurance: 51.3)
(Spiritual: 35.9)
{Free Attribute: 10}
All the stats looked exactly the same as before there was no change, he wondered what Maeve meant by this but then his gaze moved to sin points.
{Sin Points: 102,455}
'H- How can there be so many points? didn't we just arrive today? It should've been just 14,000!!' he exclaimed, feeling a strong urge to yawn.
As his thoughts began to turn messy, he hastily gave a couple of commands.
'Add all points to spiritual, draw 500 points rewards... use everything...'
YAWN
And he forgot everything, taking Maeve's hand he started to walk towards the thudding noise.
An ethereal wheel suddenly appeared in front of Vritra, he was confused, wondering if he activated the wheel?
But suddenly he froze as a cool feeling spread across his mind, making him feel relaxed.

sentences.text: Both Vritra and Maeve paused upon hearing the constant thudding, they walked closer to the wall and saw a person striking their head against the wall.
A clear stain of blood could be seen, the two were shocked.
They walked closer and pulled the person back.
It was a man, Vritra focused on his face and felt it was familiar, maybe it was someone he had rescued earlier.
He yawned, but kept staring for a few more minutes.
"You are...?" he asked, the other person's eyes suddenly filled with tears as he began to mutter.
"I- I don't want to live SOB my wife died out there...
I SOB" he started crying instantly, appearing pitiful.
Vritra frowned deeply, he tried harder to think and the young face before him seemed more and more familiar.
"Wasn't your name something like...
On- honest or something?
Hmm you are familiar..." Vritra's eyes narrowed further, straining his brain to the limit.
Then he yawned, and looked at the man with a bloody forehead.
A group of guards attracted by the sound arrived there, they looked quizzically.
They were no longer covered by the shadows so the guards could see them clearly.
Maeve explained the situation.
"Haa.
Such situations have happened many times, some people just can't bear the loss of their loved ones and decide to end their lives.
But Sir, you have to live for your son, you can't expect others to take care of him, right?" the soldier said sternly.
Then he faced Vritra and Maeve: "Don't worry, I will bring him back to his tent safely, and we will make sure he doesn't try this again."
"..." Vritra just nodded, but the feeling of unease increased in his heart.
The guards walked away, taking the man along, leaving the two of them.
"Master, let's go back, I too feel this place is weird."
Maeve said, pulling his arm, she wanted to get out of the settlement asap.
Vritra nodded, he looked at the blood stain on the wall then at the sky, where a round moon was visible.
"The moon looks pretty today." He commented, before walking away with Maeve.
A drop of blood dripped from the blood stain, flowing into the drain.
Today there was a new mark on the wall, joining the hundreds of others.
Vritra and Maeve chatted as they walked back towards their tent, planning to leave as soon as tomorrow.
Of course, he still needed to take some important stuff from here, thinking of the uniforms he felt quite excited.
Suddenly, he bumped into someone, shocked that he hadn't noticed a person standing there.
"Sorry." Vritra said, as he continued walking.
"You are back.
Honey, did you find something strange?" Vanessa asked, smiling lovingly.
"Hmm I am not really sure.
We just saw a man hitting his head on the wall, that certainly is strange." He replied.

And he decided to help.

But it already got pretty late so Vritra decided to leave as early as tomorrow.
After eating dinner with his family, he decided to check this camp with Maeve and then...
THUD THUD
The feeling of uneasiness in Vritra's heart was pounding wildly, but his body just kept going on, as if following a routine again and again.
There were times when Maeve too felt quite confused, the chain on her wrist flickered but then she would forget everything.
This time again, Vritra and Maeve had gone out at night to check the surrounding.

"Hehe.
What are you planning, master~" Maeve asked in a playful tone before pausing abruptly, feeling as if she had said this before... many times.
"What's wrong?" Vritra turned to face her, looking at her with worry.

"S- Stat che- sta..." she yawned then just smiled and shook her head.

Meeting a person hitting their head crazily, then going back to sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 645 Inside the Terror
paragraphs: The ten points were instantly added to spiritual attribute, and messages began to flood his vision.
A total of 204 messages popped and his body was engulfed by a soothing warmth, his mind relaxing further.
[You have acquired 1000 blankets.]
[You have acquired 1 Spiritual attribute point.]
[You have acquired 2 Spiritual attribute point.]
[You have acquired 2 Free attribute point.]
A flood of messages kept popping before him and Vritra just stood there, basking in the comfortable feeling.
After the drawing was complete, he glanced over the messages and saw he had received quite a few attribute points.
[9 Strength, 13 Agility, 14 Endurance, 21 Spiritual, 19 Free Attribute points.]
Vritra wasted no time and used the moment to push all free attributes into spiritual.
And once again opened his status panel, for a few moments, he forgot all about the world.
[Stats]
(Strength:81.6)
(Agility:84.4)
(Endurance:84.3)
(Spiritual:80.9)
{Free Attribute:0}
Vritra felt a shiver run through his body, his stats were way higher than what they should have been.
'This... doesn't make sense, I just saw my stats and even after addition of newer ones, they shouldn't be so high, no?' Vritra felt confused.
What if the stats he saw previous were completely wrong.
When did he even get all those sin points? wasn't it his first day here?
The milky chain on his wrist began to buzz violently, once again clearing his mind.
Vritra shook his head, looking around with a face full of bafflement.
"What the fuck?!! How long have we been here for?" he wondered, with his high stats, he could somewhat fight against the effect of whatever it was.
There were some additional rewards, like a spear which could cut through almost anything.
Its blade was extremely sharp. Vritra read its description and quickly pulled out the spear.
He took a few breaths and fought back the urge to yawn, as memories of before began to flood back.
He had been here already for nearly two weeks, repeating the same thing.
His spiritual attribute had increased to 80 already, but it was still so difficult for him to stay sane.
Whatever monster was present here, it was far too dangerous.
A sense of crisis rose in his heart.
It didn't attack directly but used these strange methods, controlling them all, not allowing anyone to sleep.
'Is this monster weak physically?' Vritra glanced up at the sky, and instantly felt dizzy.
He looked down hurriedly, feeling an intense urge to sleep.
'I have to stay up, I have to protect my family!!' Vritra thought as he grabbed Maeve's hand, giving her soft palm a tight squeeze.
"What's wrong master? Are you not feeling okay?" Maeve asked, there was a bloody wound on her forehead.
'Huh? She is injured?!!' Vritra instantly snapped back to his senses, the uncomfortable sensation pushing away everything.
"Foxie" Vritra pulled her closer, then he touched his own forehead, but there was nothing.
'Could it be because of my healing skill? That monster wasn't able to control me completely?' he had been feeling very strange all this time, and kept trying to break out.
But his spiritual attribute wasn't high enough, though now, he could somewhat hold on.
'We have to leave as soon as possible but where is that mutant present?' he looked around at the base, but couldn't understand.
'Could it be... the moon?' he wondered, but didn't look up.
He took out a knife from his inventory, and then with all his might he shot it into the direction of the moon.
WHOOSH
It shot up with an explosive force, his strength had increased to a very high level.
It flashed through the night sky, it should have just flown away into the sky but there was actually a loud cracking sound.
Vritra glanced up, his heart thumping violently, he stood before Maeve protectively.
The dark sky actually started to crack, and within moments, it all broke apart like glass shattering.
"What the fuck?!" Vritra cursed out loud, as he stared up at the sky, which was no longer sky.
It was as if they were inside some organism, a big flesh wall surrounded the whole base, in a semi sphere.
Veins and pulsing flesh, countless vein-like things hanging down and connecting to the foreheads of people.
The moon was replaced instead by a big round eye, a terrifying eye that stared at everything present in the camp.
It was pitch black, while the flesh walls were purplish in colour, the sight was terrifying.
Vritra couldn't understand what sort of creature it was even, but it made him feel fear, he could feel the difference.
Even now, he stood no chance against it.
At least it doesn't seem to be able to kill them directly.
Vritra looked around and saw several corpses lying there with their eyes open, still standing.
Their bodies had dried up.
'This monster feeds on our sleep and dreams!!' he realised, snapping the vein connecting to Maeve's head.
He wiped the fresh blood as Maeve fell into his arms, unconscious.
Without caring about the thudding noise, Vritra held her tightly in his arms and rushed quickly towards his tent.
Arriving there, he saw Onest standing outside with a dumb look, a vein connecting to his forehead too.
Vritra glanced inside and saw Shitless sleeping peacefully.
"This monk wasn't affected? Why didn't he do anything then?" Vritra first brought Maeve into the tent and put her on the bed gently.
He looked at his other wives, his heart ached as he saw the bloody wound on Yasmine, Fiona and Vanessa's forehead.
Teresa, Yennefer and Diana were yet to be affected like others.
Vritra wasted no time and removed the veins, they all fell unconscious.
"Diana, can you heal them?" Vritra asked, the goddess looked confused but nodded.
She began to heal them instantly, despite her mind being so foggy.
'Now, how do I escape? I don't know if I can maintain my sanity and for how long, can I kill it?' his heart was thumping wildly, he still held the spear tightly.
The knife had struck that eye but except for breaking the illusion of the night it didn't do much.
So that's not the weak point.
"Could it be near that wall?" his heart chilled, as he suddenly remembered.
Under the control of that mutant, he wasn't able to see it before but now, that sight was very clear.
The wall was full of bloody marks, spread over a large area, who knows how many people had already died here.
He glanced at his wives, thankfully they were getting better by Diana's treatment, the wounds started to disappear.
'Will this mutant do something now that we have all disconnected- hmm wait, healing...'
Suddenly he remembered when he had entered, the doctor and the general were strangely interested in his healing ability.
Can they help him find a clue to escape from here?
Healing...
He looked at the goddess again, thankfully no one here knew that she had this ability.
"I should go out and check things out." Vritra mumbled, then he walked out and headed towards the other tent.
He pulled the bedsheet, making monk Shitless fall off as he let out a feminine scream, but calmed upon seeing it was just Vritra.
"Protect the other tent, I need to check a few things." While speaking, he noticed that while others can't sleep, Shitless was sleeping a bit too much.

chapters.title: Chapter 646 The Healer
paragraphs: "Alright pitiful one, don't you worry." Shitless nodded as he got up and walk out.
'Maybe that creature just want to keep the monk away, even using its energy to keep Shitless asleep.' Vritra thought, even mutants hated this guy.
They would rather starve than steal energy from him, for a moment pity rose in his heart as he watched Shitless walk away.
'Sigh poor guy, he is meant to be alone. Or maybe, some mutant might really accept him.' Shaking his head, Vritra walking out.
He also put Onest to sleep by removing the vein.
He felt a chill just thinking of what has been happening here, and nearly two weeks have already passed.
What was even more terrifying was the thing that surrounded that entire base.
'It feels like I am inside a horror movie.' Vritra felt very tired and sleepy, but fighting all the urges, he ran towards Peter's tent.
If he hadn't gotten control back, they all might have just died without even knowing anything.
This mutant was truly horrifying.
"Stop! What are you doing here this late?" the guards questioned.
"Is the general here?" Vritra clenched his fists, the whole place was too dreadful.
People were just standing all over the place, swaying back and forth.
Even the guards had those veins attached to their foreheads.
"Who is it?" surprised voice of the general sounded from inside.
"It is Adam, general." The soldier said, stepping back as peter walked out of his tent, still wearing his military uniform.
'He is affected too!' Vritra saw the big dark circles under his eyes, he too hadn't slept for a long time it seemed.
"Oh Adam, tell me what is it? Did you need anything?" peter smiled and questioned.
"Yes, where is that doctor who checked us before? There is something I want to discuss with you both." Vritra replied, he held the spear.
"You want to see Aria? Sure, follow me, if she isn't asleep we can talk." Peter said and led Vritra away, making small talks while walking.
"This, here is her house." Peter said as he turned and pointed but was surprised upon noticing that Vritra wasn't walking beside him.
The general looked back and saw him frozen few steps away, a strange look on his face.
"What's wrong? Didn't you want to talk to the doc? Hmm?" peter asked, confused.
While Vritra gulped heavily, feeling goosebumps all over, since when have he been under the control of this monster?
When he entered, the doctor had her face covered, so he wasn't able to see her properly.
But what stood in front of the doctor's tent was far from what he expected.
It wasn't even human.
There stood a person with two head, a grotesque mess of flesh and organs, appearing completely broken.
One head belonged to a man and the other was a woman's, and Vritra recognized them both very well.
One was Gary and the other was Mira, the siblings he had seen before except, they looked to be in forties here, not the youngsters he saw before.
Vritra felt disturbed, his mind aching so badly and everything stopped making sense.
"Doc Aria, Adam has come to meet you, are you awake?" Peter called out in a sleepy tone.
"Oh, I am awake. Hello general and... Adam, what a handsome guy, tell me how can I help you?" aria turned to face Vritra.
Both the heads had strange flowers blooming over them, the area above the nose wasn't present and their strange looking brains were completely visible.
The flowers were then connected to the ceiling.
'W- Whoa, even a mutant praised me- anyway, this place is completely fucked! I have to escape asap!' Vritra thought, he wondered if cutting this doctor would help.
He felt if Yasmine was here she would definitely make the joke: 'She clearly doesn't have eyes hehe.'
"Uhm I wanted to ask something." Vritra started speaking while slipping back very subtly, so no one notice that, then he continued:
"You asked if I have the healing ability, if someone possess it. But I know someone who do possess healing ability." Vritra said, fully focussed on observing the monster before him.
The lips on both heads trembled suddenly, a crazed twisted smile appearing on them.
"Oh, who is it?" she asked in a calm tone.
YAWN
Vritra yawned and looked at them in confusion: "Huh? Who is what?"
"You were just mentioning something about a healer?" she urged, urgency in her voice.
"I was? when?" Vritra gave a strange look, playing the trick back at it.
"Just now you mentioned it!!" she said, sounding more pissed.
"Huh? I mentioned what?" Vritra looked more confused.
"The healer damnit, you said you know one. Tell me, where is the healer?" she practically screamed this time, showing how badly they wanted to find a healer.
"I said that? I don't know any healer YAWN why would I mention a healer." he said yawning.
"How can I know that? Then why the hell did you say it?!!" the doctor was trembling, as if wanting to attack him.
"What did I say?" Vritra tilted his head in confusion.
"The healer!!" she screamed.
"Oh right, the healer I remember now, I know one powerful healer!!" Vritra suddenly spoke, the strange creature before him became excited again.
"Hurry up tell me!!" she said.
"Huh? Tell you what? Doc, did you want something from me?" Vritra rage baited the creature and it really seemed very mad.
"THE HEALER!! YOU CAME HERE TO TALK!! Damnit, Peter, take him away!" unable to hold on, she screamed, scratching her own flesh.

'Looks like this mutant needs a strong healer desperately, I can't let it find about Diana. And it seems to be controlling this body, it doesn't seem killing it will kill the mutant.' Vritra thought, as he started walking away hurriedly.
Peter nodded and then followed appearing confused.
Vritra arrived back at the tent, Shitless was till guarding outside.
"Did you find anything? This place is strange..." Shitless muttered, his skin still just as red and eyes bulging.
'Two weeks have passed and he still looks like it, will he stay like this forever?' Vritra thought then patted his shoulder.
"It's fine, you will always be my friend, even if you look uglier than this- though that's not really possible anyway, we have to leave this wretched place."
Vritra spoke, it would be better if he can kill this thing if not just escaping is fine.
It's stats were over 100, of course not all, it had evolved into something strange.
'Looks like, everyone undergoes a big evolution after reaching 100% mutation.' It should still be physically weak, if I can find the weak spot, then killing it will be possible.
"Shitless, go around and see if you can find anything strange, we have to kill this monster." Vritra said, since Shitless was relatively immune, he would be a great help.
He healed into the tent and saw all his wives sleeping, all of them seemed free from the mutant's influence momentarily.
"Alright if nothing works, I will just smash everything, that always works." He said determined to protect them all.
A strong hatred rising in his heart at the memory of seeing wounds on his wives' foreheads.
Whether now or later he was going to kill it.
Vritra waited and soon Shitless ran back, appearing very excited.
"PITIFUL ONE, IT IS... IT IS... NOT A MUTANT!!" HE SHOUTED.

"Yes, where is that doctor who checked us before?
There is something I want to discuss with you both." Vritra replied, he held the spear.
"You want to see Aria?
Sure, follow me, if she isn't asleep we can talk." Peter said and led Vritra away, making small talks while walking.
"This, here is her house." Peter said as he turned and pointed but was surprised upon noticing that Vritra wasn't walking beside him.
The general looked back and saw him frozen few steps away, a strange look on his face.
"What's wrong?
Didn't you want to talk to the doc?
Hmm?" peter asked, confused.
While Vritra gulped heavily, feeling goosebumps all over, since when have he been under the control of this monster?
When he entered, the doctor had her face covered, so he wasn't able to see her properly.
But what stood in front of the doctor's tent was far from what he expected.
It wasn't even human.
There stood a person with two head, a grotesque mess of flesh and organs, appearing completely broken.
One head belonged to a man and the other was a woman's, and Vritra recognized them both very well.
One was Gary and the other was Mira, the siblings he had seen before except, they looked to be in forties here, not the youngsters he saw before.
Vritra felt disturbed, his mind aching so badly and everything stopped making sense.
"Doc Aria, Adam has come to meet you, are you awake?" Peter called out in a sleepy tone.
"Oh, I am awake.
Hello general and...
Adam, what a handsome guy, tell me how can I help you?" aria turned to face Vritra.
Both the heads had strange flowers blooming over them, the area above the nose wasn't present and their strange looking brains were completely visible.
The flowers were then connected to the ceiling.
'W- Whoa, even a mutant praised me- anyway, this place is completely fucked!
I have to escape asap!' Vritra thought, he wondered if cutting this doctor would help.
He felt if Yasmine was here she would definitely make the joke: 'She clearly doesn't have eyes hehe.'
"Uhm I wanted to ask something." Vritra started speaking while slipping back very subtly, so no one notice that, then he continued:
"You asked if I have the healing ability, if someone possess it.
But I know someone who do possess healing ability." Vritra said, fully focussed on observing the monster before him.
The lips on both heads trembled suddenly, a crazed twisted smile appearing on them.
"Oh, who is it?" she asked in a calm tone.
YAWN
Vritra yawned and looked at them in confusion: "Huh?
Who is what?"
"You were just mentioning something about a healer?" she urged, urgency in her voice.
"I was? when?" Vritra gave a strange look, playing the trick back at it.
"Just now you mentioned it!!" she said, sounding more pissed.
"Huh?
I mentioned what?" Vritra looked more confused.
"The healer damnit, you said you know one.
Tell me, where is the healer?" she practically screamed this time, showing how badly they wanted to find a healer.
"I said that?
I don't know any healer YAWN why would I mention a healer." he said yawning.
"How can I know that?
Then why the hell did you say it?!!" the doctor was trembling, as if wanting to attack him.
"What did I say?" Vritra tilted his head in confusion.
"The healer!!" she screamed.
"Oh right, the healer I remember now, I know one powerful healer!!" Vritra suddenly spoke, the strange creature before him became excited again.
"Hurry up tell me!!" she said.
"Huh?
Tell you what?
Doc, did you want something from me?" Vritra rage baited the creature and it really seemed very mad.
"THE HEALER!!
YOU CAME HERE TO TALK!!
Damnit, Peter, take him away!" unable to hold on, she screamed, scratching her own flesh.
'Looks like this mutant needs a strong healer desperately, I can't let it find about Diana.
And it seems to be controlling this body, it doesn't seem killing it will kill the mutant.' Vritra thought, as he started walking away hurriedly.
Peter nodded and then followed appearing confused.
Vritra arrived back at the tent, Shitless was till guarding outside.
"Did you find anything?
This place is strange..." Shitless muttered, his skin still just as red and eyes bulging.
'Two weeks have passed and he still looks like it, will he stay like this forever?' Vritra thought then patted his shoulder.
"It's fine, you will always be my friend, even if you look uglier than this- though that's not really possible anyway, we have to leave this wretched place."
Vritra spoke, it would be better if he can kill this thing if not just escaping is fine.
It's stats were over 100, of course not all, it had evolved into something strange.
'Looks like, everyone undergoes a big evolution after reaching 100% mutation.' It should still be physically weak, if I can find the weak spot, then killing it will be possible.
"Shitless, go around and see if you can find anything strange, we have to kill this monster." Vritra said, since Shitless was relatively immune, he would be a great help.
He healed into the tent and saw all his wives sleeping, all of them seemed free from the mutant's influence momentarily.
"Alright if nothing works, I will just smash everything, that always works." He said determined to protect them all.
A strong hatred rising in his heart at the memory of seeing wounds on his wives' foreheads.
Whether now or later he was going to kill it.
Vritra waited and soon Shitless ran back, appearing very excited.
"PITIFUL ONE, IT IS...
IT IS...
NOT A MUTANT!!" HE SHOUTED.

chapters.title: Chapter 647 The Mine
paragraphs: "PITIFUL ONE, IT IS... IT IS... NOT A MUTANT!!" the monk shouted hurriedly running in Vritra's direction.
He panted heavily, his already big eyes widened even further.
"Not a mutant? What do you mean?" Vritra asked, walking out of the tent.
"Yes, it's not a mutant, t- this place itself has become sentient, the camp itself!!" Shitless spoke, scratching his head.
"This place itself is the monster, what exactly did you find?" Vritra still found it hard to believe.
"Come with me, I will show you." The monk urged, but Vritra couldn't just leave his wives like that.
Although slow, Shitless understood, he spoke hurriedly: "How about I guard this place and you check out the doctor's tent, you will know once you are there."
Vritra nodded, as he ran in the direction of the doctor's tent.
It wasn't far and he arrived there quickly, but just as he was about to enter a voice called out:
"Pitiful one, what are you doing here?"
Vritra was startled as he turned and saw Shitless standing not too far away, there was no way he could have gotten here so quickly.
'Wait, who was at the tents just now then?' Vritra felt his body turn cold, he didn't stop to confirm if it was really Shitless or not and hurriedly ran back towards his family.
Extreme worry filled his heart, he should've waited until they woke up.
But when he arrived, he saw Shitless standing there and guarding the tent just like before.
"Did you see it? You came back very quickly." The monk was drawing something on the ground with his feet and jumped back in fright as Vritra appeared there suddenly.
"Huh? Is it you, Shitless?" Vritra frowned, his head hurting.
"Who else could it be if not the great me?" Shitless said proudly.
Vritra ran into the tent and was relieved to see all his wives sleeping peacefully.
He walked back out only to see two red mutant-like humans staring at one another.
"Whoa, it is another me, or is this a mirror?" Shitless on left spoke.
"Huh? Did I gain a special skill? I can become two now?" Shitless on right spoke.
'What the fuck is going on here? Which one is real?' Vritra looked at the two, they looked exactly the same.
"Shitless?" he called out but both responded at the same time.
"Yes?"
"Uh, are you Shit Sonia?" Vritra asked, guessing which is the real Shitless shouldn't be too hard.
"No, I am not!" the left one said.
"No!" the right one replied.
"What's your bull's name? Left one will answer me first." Vritra said, he held the spear tightly.
"Bullo!"
"What's my best friend's name? Right one will answer." Vritra continued.
"Zengis!"
"..." Vritra was at a loss of words, how could the fake know such things.
Then he thought of something and spoke: "Both of you, shake hands with each other, right now."
Both looked surprised, then they glanced at one another.
One appeared confused while the right one looked disgusted, as if someone had asked him to put his hand in the gutter.
Vritra wasted no time and stabbed the right one in the shoulder.
"Ughh, h- how did you..." he stumbled back and his form changed to that of the general.
"Peter?" Vritra was surprised, why was this guy doing this?
"What's going on? Why did you pretend to be Shitless?" he pressed the spear's blade against his throat and questioned.
"Haa. Just kill me, everyone here is going to die anyway, no one will survive. You should have never come here." He said, falling to the ground weakly.
Vritra didn't kill him immediately, waiting to know what he knew.
"Since you want to die anyway, why don't you tell me what you know?" Vritra said, pulling the spear back a bit.
"...Very well, I might as well put my last bet on you.
And by talking to that doc, you have put a target on your head, that's why she- or rather the thing controlling that body sent me here." Peter spoke.

"We operated this place to save lives upon the arrival of the apocalypse. But we didn't know that there was a mine under this base, and at some point the base itself had turned into this... this monster.
That thing lures more people here just to steal their sleep and dreams and become more alive.
The people with healing ability are the best meal, that it can directly possess, like those poor doctor siblings."
Vritra more or less got the gist of it.
'Looks like I will have to go visit this mine to solve the problem.' He thought, and with Shitless here the mutant cannot harm his family.
It even went as far as sending the general to imitate the monk to get him killed by Vritra, just how much do even mutants avoid the Shitless?
"Stay here, I will go take a look." Vritra said, he pulled the general to his feet.
"Help me, and I can save everyone here." He spoke in a solemn tone.
The general nodded, the wound wasn't too severe so it won't be a hindrance.
They quickly left, while Shitless stayed behind.
The doctor was pacing around outside her big tent, she seemed anxious.
"Doc, I am back." The general spoke, walking back calmly.
"How did it go? Did he get rid of that bald guy? He did, right? We can't have something like that here." She spoke.
"Yes, he is gone, but more importantly, there really is a healer here." Peter spoke.
"Really?!! Bring me there, right away."
The two left as Vritra finally came out, he walked into the tent and was surprised by what he saw.
Except for the big hole in the ground, there was nothing, and countless veins were going out of that hole.
"It really is a mine, will this thing die if I cut off all the veins?" he wondered but decided to first check it out.
Without touching any of the veins, he jumped into the mine which was deeper than he expected.
It was dimly lit and the walls were all covered with a lot of crystals.
The crystals were light blue, and were constantly emanating energy.
"So, this is its heart? There are quite a lot of crystals." Vritra walked closer to the wall and pulled one crystal.
With his high strength, it was not difficult.
He tried absorbing it, but nothing happened, with a frown he stared at the crystal.
Then he washed it and...
BITE
He bit the crystal, and it actually broke into two, as Vritra chewed it, the stone seemed to dissolve and disappeared completely right as he swallowed.
[You have obtained 1 spiritual attribute!]
"Whoa, I can gain attribute from this?!!" Vritra exclaimed, suddenly feeling very excited.
But then he wondered, if there are a few more caves like this then how strong would those humans become?
Especially those ten players, they already must be way stronger than him.
He needs to keep getting stronger, to the point he could easily kill them and this was just the beginning.
"This is all mine!!" he was sure if he could devour this all, the issue with the monster will be gone as well.
Wasting no time, Vritra began to munch on the crystals, pulling one after another from the wall.
CRACK CRACK

chapters.title: Chapter 648 A Close Call
paragraphs: CRACK CRACK
Vritra began to munch over one crystal after another, his hands moving quickly as he kept pulling them off the wall.
While messages kept popping before him.
[You have obtained 1 spiritual attribute!]
[You have obtained 1 spiritual attribute!]
[You have obtained 1 spiritual attribute!]
His mind was filled with a cool sensation, it felt so comfortable, the pain he had been feeling earlier slowly disappeared.
And his resistance increased greatly against the mind control.
But soon he noticed something.
'My spiritual attribute can't go past 100? Is that the limit before certain evolution or something?' he wondered, maybe once the mutation level reaches 100%, the body undergoes drastic changes.
Or maybe he would need something to continue further.
Whatever it might be, he would think about that later.
For now, he just continued devouring the crystals, the messages were still popping but his spiritual attribute was no longer increasing.
With so many crystals, his spiritual power would be greatly enhanced, though most of it would be locked for now.
CRUNCH CRUNCH
For a while, there were no changes, but soon the base's consciousness seemed to notice the changes.
'Just eating is too slow!' Vritra continued to devour while quickly throwing the stones into his inventory.
The veins trembled, many drying up and dying, while the others began to tremble violently.
KIIIIIIIIIIIIIIEEEE
A terrifying scream rang from the outside, like a ghost from horror movies.
"Oh, it has finally noticed me." Vritra mumbled, but he didn't care about them and continued with his task.
Instantly a wave of mental attack hit him, making him almost fall to the ground.
But gritting his teeth, he retaliated with a spiritual burst, increasing his speed.
He had already emptied half of the crystals, and kept releasing spiritual burst to fight against the brutal mental attacks.
THUD THUD
Several figures quickly jumped into the underground area, the one at the front was the doctor.
They all screamed like mindless mutants, pouncing at Vritra.
'Heh how can they compete with me in physical strength, none of them have attributes as high as mine.' Vritra scanned the crowd and relaxed.
His stats had greatly increased after coming to this place since the military base brought so many mutants for him to kill.
It was just making its prey healthy, but Vritra had obtained the highest benefits.
He kept pulling the crystal while using the blood bullets to send them flying, they fell unconscious instantly.
After devouring a lot of crystals, he felt that they had stopped having any effect on him, it was no longer capable of increasing his strength.
So he just put the rest into his storage, Yasmine and the others could use them.
"STOPPPPPP!!" the doctor with two heads screamed madly, it was the consciousness of the mine after all.
And Vritra was kind of taking its very life force, its strength was already weakening.
[Spiritual Burst!]
[Spiritual Burst!]
[Spiritual Burst!]
Vritra kept launching mental attacks, leaving the doctor completely paralyzed.
"Haa finally done..." Vritra wiped the sweat from his forehead, as he finally turned.
The veins were starting to rot away, this thing would not be able to live long without those crystals.
And it knew once the crystals were gone, its life would end that's why it was so desperately searching for a healer or going all out to get new prey.
[Stats]
(Strength: 81.6)
(Agility: 84.4)
(Endurance: 84.3)
(Spiritual: 100[Locked])
{Free Attribute: 0}
{Sin Points: 455}
"So, what did you want to talk about doc?" Vritra turned and looked at the fallen mutant.
On both the heads, the upper part was missing and just the lower part had such an ugly expression.
"How did you?!! Since when... You knew...?" it surely had a lot of questions.
So far none of the humans had managed to oppose it or even see past the illusions, they kept repeating the same routine every day.
Feeding their sleep and dreams to it, which greatly decreased the consumption of these crystals, increasing its life.
"Well, thank you for your hospitality, but I don't want to overstay my welcome. Enjoy your tragically short life." Vritra said as he started walking.
"AHHHHHH" the doctor screamed and attacked him from behind. As long as he was gone, it could get all crystals back.
But right after taking a couple of steps forward, its heads exploded, and the body went limp.
Vritra sprinted towards his tent and saw Shitless still guarding outside.
"Pitiful one, how did it go?" he asked in a hurry.
"We will be fine now, that thing will be dead very soon." Even while speaking, he kept launching mental attacks towards the consciousness of the base to exhaust it.
{Sin Point Gained: Killed a Mutant +3,002}
Before long, it finally died and the bright sky once again became visible.
Vritra barely glanced at the message since he was in a hurry and accidentally overlooked one message.
"Whoa, so many points? it really was too powerful, had I not gained my senses back, we all might have really just died here." Vritra exhaled a long breath, this thing was truly too terrifying.
Thankfully all of them had managed to survive, and he made a big gain.
"Go get some rest, we will be leaving this place soon." Vritra said and sighed, who knows how many times he had repeated this line.
Yet they had stayed nearly two weeks here.
Then he walked back into his tent, all the people previously controlled were now unconscious.
Vanessa, Yasmine, Fiona, Diana, Yennefer, Maeve and Teresa were all still sleeping.
Vritra was still feeling tired, he had not slept for two weeks, he fell onto the bed and soon drifted off to sleep.
After nearly twelve hours, Vritra stirred out of sleep when he felt movements beside him.
He opened his eyes and saw his wives had just woken up, they looked perfectly fine.
"Hubby, what happened?" Yasmine massaged her temples.
"Master, this place... it is haunted!!" Maeve finally remembered everything, she had broken out of the control many times because of that chain.
But was too weak.
"Everything is fine now, don't worry." Vritra said as he sat up and explained everything.
As they listened more their faces turned pale, a fear creeping into their hearts, they were all so close to death.
"Honey, we should leave this cursed place immediately, what if this is another of its illusion? What if that thing is still alive?" Vanessa said.
"It is fine mom, I have confirmed its death. We will leave soon, but not before taking something important from the general here." Vritra said with a smile.
Maeve's heart almost stopped beating as she heard that, Vritra had been repeating that line for more than ten days.
"M... Master, haven't you already... are you still under its control?" Maeve asked, the others were also frozen.
Vritra burst out laughing seeing their expressions, teasing them all was really fun.
"Hubby, don't scare us like that." Yasmine patted her chest.
"Husband, this is not good. I am going to punish you later on." Yennefer said with a pout.
"Oh right, I have something good for you all." Vritra said as he took out the crystals and handed them to his wives.
He kept some for Shitless and Onest too, still there were enough to increase everyone's spiritual power to a high level.
"Just eat it." He added, as his wives looked at him strangely, was their husband still under the influence after all?
